12/**
13 * @brief Implementation of \ref RuntimeWalltimeGuardParsePositiveSeconds().
14 * @details Full API contract (arguments, ownership, side effects) is documented with
15 * the header declaration in `include/setup.h`.
16 * @see RuntimeWalltimeGuardParsePositiveSeconds()
17 */
18PetscBool RuntimeWalltimeGuardParsePositiveSeconds(const char *text, PetscReal *seconds_out)
19{
20 char *endptr = NULL;
21 double parsed_value;
22
23 if (seconds_out) *seconds_out = 0.0;
24 if (!text || text[0] == '\0') return PETSC_FALSE;
25
26 errno = 0;
27 parsed_value = strtod(text, &endptr);
28 if (endptr == text || errno == ERANGE || !isfinite(parsed_value) || parsed_value <= 0.0) {
29 return PETSC_FALSE;
30 }
31
32 while (*endptr != '\0' && isspace((unsigned char)*endptr)) {
33 endptr++;
34 }
35 if (*endptr != '\0') return PETSC_FALSE;
36
37 if (seconds_out) *seconds_out = (PetscReal)parsed_value;
38 return PETSC_TRUE;
39}

41/**
42 * @brief Implementation of \ref InitializeSolutionConvergenceState().
43 * @details Full API contract (arguments, ownership, side effects) is documented with
44 * the header declaration in `include/setup.h`.
45 * @see InitializeSolutionConvergenceState()
46 */
47PetscErrorCode InitializeSolutionConvergenceState(SimCtx *simCtx)
48{
49 UserCtx *user = NULL;
50 PetscInt history_capacity = 0;
51
52 PetscFunctionBeginUser;
53 if (!simCtx) SETERRQ(PETSC_COMM_SELF, PETSC_ERR_ARG_NULL, "SimCtx cannot be NULL.");
54 if (simCtx->exec_mode != EXEC_MODE_SOLVER) PetscFunctionReturn(0);
55 if (!simCtx->usermg.mgctx) {
56 SETERRQ(PETSC_COMM_SELF, PETSC_ERR_ARG_WRONGSTATE,
57 "Multigrid hierarchy must exist before initializing solution convergence storage.");
58 }
59
60 user = simCtx->usermg.mgctx[simCtx->usermg.mglevels - 1].user;
61 if (!user) {
62 SETERRQ(PETSC_COMM_SELF, PETSC_ERR_ARG_WRONGSTATE,
63 "Finest-level UserCtx must exist before initializing solution convergence storage.");
64 }
65
66 simCtx->solutionConvergenceSamplesRecorded = 0;
67
68 if (simCtx->solutionConvergenceMode == SOLUTION_CONVERGENCE_PERIODIC_DETERMINISTIC) {
69 for (PetscInt bi = 0; bi < simCtx->block_number; ++bi) {
70 PetscCall(PetscCalloc1((size_t)simCtx->solutionConvergencePeriodSteps,
71 &user[bi].solutionConvergencePeriodicUcatRef));
72 PetscCall(PetscCalloc1((size_t)simCtx->solutionConvergencePeriodSteps,
73 &user[bi].solutionConvergencePeriodicPRef));
74 for (PetscInt phase = 0; phase < simCtx->solutionConvergencePeriodSteps; ++phase) {
75 PetscCall(VecDuplicate(user[bi].Ucat, &user[bi].solutionConvergencePeriodicUcatRef[phase]));
76 PetscCall(VecSet(user[bi].solutionConvergencePeriodicUcatRef[phase], 0.0));
77 PetscCall(VecDuplicate(user[bi].P, &user[bi].solutionConvergencePeriodicPRef[phase]));
78 PetscCall(VecSet(user[bi].solutionConvergencePeriodicPRef[phase], 0.0));
79 }
80 }
81 }
82
83 if (simCtx->solutionConvergenceMode == SOLUTION_CONVERGENCE_STATISTICAL_STEADY) {
84 history_capacity = 2 * simCtx->solutionConvergenceWindowSteps;
85 PetscCall(PetscCalloc1((size_t)history_capacity, &simCtx->solutionConvergenceMeanSpeedHistory));
86 PetscCall(PetscCalloc1((size_t)history_capacity, &simCtx->solutionConvergenceMeanKEHistory));
87 }
88
89 PetscFunctionReturn(0);
90}

92/**
93 * @brief Implementation of \ref DestroySolutionConvergenceState().
94 * @details Full API contract (arguments, ownership, side effects) is documented with
95 * the header declaration in `include/setup.h`.
96 * @see DestroySolutionConvergenceState()
97 */
98PetscErrorCode DestroySolutionConvergenceState(SimCtx *simCtx)
99{
100 UserCtx *user = NULL;
101
102 PetscFunctionBeginUser;
103 if (!simCtx || !simCtx->usermg.mgctx) PetscFunctionReturn(0);
104
105 user = simCtx->usermg.mgctx[simCtx->usermg.mglevels - 1].user;
106 if (user) {
107 for (PetscInt bi = 0; bi < simCtx->block_number; ++bi) {
108 if (user[bi].solutionConvergencePeriodicUcatRef) {
109 for (PetscInt phase = 0; phase < simCtx->solutionConvergencePeriodSteps; ++phase) {
110 if (user[bi].solutionConvergencePeriodicUcatRef[phase]) {
111 PetscCall(VecDestroy(&user[bi].solutionConvergencePeriodicUcatRef[phase]));
112 }
113 }
114 PetscCall(PetscFree(user[bi].solutionConvergencePeriodicUcatRef));
115 user[bi].solutionConvergencePeriodicUcatRef = NULL;
116 }
117 if (user[bi].solutionConvergencePeriodicPRef) {
118 for (PetscInt phase = 0; phase < simCtx->solutionConvergencePeriodSteps; ++phase) {
119 if (user[bi].solutionConvergencePeriodicPRef[phase]) {
120 PetscCall(VecDestroy(&user[bi].solutionConvergencePeriodicPRef[phase]));
121 }
122 }
123 PetscCall(PetscFree(user[bi].solutionConvergencePeriodicPRef));
124 user[bi].solutionConvergencePeriodicPRef = NULL;
125 }
126 }
127 }
128
129 if (simCtx->solutionConvergenceMeanSpeedHistory) {
130 PetscCall(PetscFree(simCtx->solutionConvergenceMeanSpeedHistory));
131 simCtx->solutionConvergenceMeanSpeedHistory = NULL;
132 }
133 if (simCtx->solutionConvergenceMeanKEHistory) {
134 PetscCall(PetscFree(simCtx->solutionConvergenceMeanKEHistory));
135 simCtx->solutionConvergenceMeanKEHistory = NULL;
136 }
137 simCtx->solutionConvergenceSamplesRecorded = 0;
138
139 PetscFunctionReturn(0);
140}

354 // === 2. Get MPI Info and Handle Config File =============================
355 // -- Group 1: Parallelism & MPI Information
356 ierr = MPI_Comm_rank(PETSC_COMM_WORLD, &simCtx->rank); CHKERRQ(ierr);
357 ierr = MPI_Comm_size(PETSC_COMM_WORLD, &simCtx->size); CHKERRQ(ierr);
358
359 // First, check if the -control_file argument was provided by the user/script.
360 ierr = PetscOptionsGetString(NULL, NULL, "-control_file", control_filename, sizeof(control_filename), &control_flg); CHKERRQ(ierr);
361
362 // If the flag is NOT present or the filename is empty, abort with a helpful error.
363 if (!control_flg || strlen(control_filename) == 0) {
364 SETERRQ(PETSC_COMM_WORLD, PETSC_ERR_ARG_WRONG,
365 "\n\n*** MANDATORY ARGUMENT MISSING ***\n"
366 "The -control_file argument was not provided.\n"
367 "This program must be launched with a configuration file.\n"
368 "Example: mpiexec -n 4 ./simulator -control_file /path/to/your/config.control\n"
369 "This is typically handled automatically by the 'picurv' script.\n");
370 }
371
372 // At this point, we have a valid filename. Attempt to load it.
373 LOG(GLOBAL, LOG_INFO, "Loading mandatory configuration from: %s\n", control_filename);
374 ierr = PetscOptionsInsertFile(PETSC_COMM_WORLD, NULL, control_filename, PETSC_FALSE);
375 if (ierr == PETSC_ERR_FILE_OPEN) {
376 SETERRQ(PETSC_COMM_WORLD, PETSC_ERR_FILE_OPEN, "The specified control file was not found or could not be opened: %s", control_filename);
377 }
378 CHKERRQ(ierr);
379
380 // === 3. A Configure Logging System ========================================
381 // This logic determines the logging configuration and STORES it in simCtx for
382 // later reference and cleanup.
383 ierr = PetscOptionsGetString(NULL, NULL, "-whitelist_config_file", simCtx->allowedFile, PETSC_MAX_PATH_LEN, &simCtx->useCfg); CHKERRQ(ierr);
384
385 if (simCtx->useCfg) {
386 ierr = LoadAllowedFunctionsFromFile(simCtx->allowedFile, &simCtx->allowedFuncs, &simCtx->nAllowed);
387 if (ierr) {
388 // Use direct PetscPrintf as logging system isn't fully active yet.
389 PetscPrintf(PETSC_COMM_SELF, "[%s] WARNING: Failed to load allowed functions from '%s'. Falling back to default list.\n", __func__, simCtx->allowedFile);
390 simCtx->useCfg = PETSC_FALSE; // Mark as failed.
391 ierr = 0; // Clear the error to allow fallback.
392 } else if (simCtx->nAllowed == 0) {
393 SETERRQ(PETSC_COMM_WORLD, PETSC_ERR_ARG_WRONG,
394 "Whitelist config file '%s' is empty. Omit -whitelist_config_file to use the default allow-list, or list at least one function.",
395 simCtx->allowedFile);
396 }
397 }
398 if (!simCtx->useCfg) {
399 // Fallback to default logging functions if no file was used or if loading failed.
400 simCtx->nAllowed = 2;
401 ierr = PetscMalloc1(simCtx->nAllowed, &simCtx->allowedFuncs); CHKERRQ(ierr);
402 ierr = PetscStrallocpy("main", &simCtx->allowedFuncs[0]); CHKERRQ(ierr);
403 ierr = PetscStrallocpy("CreateSimulationContext", &simCtx->allowedFuncs[1]); CHKERRQ(ierr);
404 }
405
406 // Activate the configuration by passing it to the logging module's setup function.
407 set_allowed_functions((const char**)simCtx->allowedFuncs, (size_t)simCtx->nAllowed);
408
409 // Now that the logger is configured, we can use it.
410 LOG_ALLOW_SYNC(LOCAL, LOG_INFO, "Context created. Initializing on rank %d of %d.\n", simCtx->rank, simCtx->size);
411 print_log_level(); // This will now correctly reflect the LOG_LEVEL environment variable.
412
413 // === 3.B Configure Profiling System ========================================
414 ierr = PetscOptionsGetString(NULL, NULL, "-profiling_timestep_mode", simCtx->profilingTimestepMode, sizeof(simCtx->profilingTimestepMode), NULL); CHKERRQ(ierr);
415 ierr = PetscOptionsGetString(NULL, NULL, "-profiling_timestep_file", simCtx->profilingTimestepFile, PETSC_MAX_PATH_LEN, NULL); CHKERRQ(ierr);
416 ierr = PetscOptionsGetBool(NULL, NULL, "-profiling_final_summary", &simCtx->profilingFinalSummary, NULL); CHKERRQ(ierr);
417 if (strcmp(simCtx->profilingTimestepMode, "off") != 0 &&
418 strcmp(simCtx->profilingTimestepMode, "selected") != 0 &&
419 strcmp(simCtx->profilingTimestepMode, "all") != 0) {
420 PetscPrintf(PETSC_COMM_SELF, "[%s] WARNING: Unknown profiling timestep mode '%s'. Falling back to 'selected'.\n", __func__, simCtx->profilingTimestepMode);
421 strcpy(simCtx->profilingTimestepMode, "selected");
422 }
423
424 if (strcmp(simCtx->profilingTimestepMode, "selected") == 0) {
425 ierr = PetscOptionsGetString(NULL, NULL, "-profile_config_file", simCtx->profilingSelectedFuncsFile, PETSC_MAX_PATH_LEN, &simCtx->useProfilingSelectedFuncsCfg); CHKERRQ(ierr);
426 if (simCtx->useProfilingSelectedFuncsCfg) {
427 ierr = LoadAllowedFunctionsFromFile(simCtx->profilingSelectedFuncsFile, &simCtx->profilingSelectedFuncs, &simCtx->nProfilingSelectedFuncs);
428 if (ierr) {
429 PetscPrintf(PETSC_COMM_SELF, "[%s] WARNING: Failed to load selected profiling functions from '%s'. Falling back to default list.\n", __func__, simCtx->profilingSelectedFuncsFile);
430 simCtx->useProfilingSelectedFuncsCfg = PETSC_FALSE;
431 ierr = 0;
432 }
433 }
434 if (!simCtx->useProfilingSelectedFuncsCfg) {
435 // Fallback to a hardcoded default list if no file was provided or loading failed.
436 simCtx->nProfilingSelectedFuncs = 4;
437 ierr = PetscMalloc1(simCtx->nProfilingSelectedFuncs, &simCtx->profilingSelectedFuncs); CHKERRQ(ierr);
438 ierr = PetscStrallocpy("FlowSolver", &simCtx->profilingSelectedFuncs[0]); CHKERRQ(ierr);
439 ierr = PetscStrallocpy("AdvanceSimulation", &simCtx->profilingSelectedFuncs[1]); CHKERRQ(ierr);
440 ierr = PetscStrallocpy("LocateAllParticlesInGrid", &simCtx->profilingSelectedFuncs[2]); CHKERRQ(ierr);
441 ierr = PetscStrallocpy("InterpolateAllFieldsToSwarm", &simCtx->profilingSelectedFuncs[3]); CHKERRQ(ierr);
442 }
443 }

481 }

484 }
485 if (simCtx->walltimeGuardMinSeconds <= 0.0) {
486 SETERRQ(PETSC_COMM_WORLD, PETSC_ERR_ARG_WRONG, "Invalid value for -walltime_guard_min_seconds: %.6f. Must be > 0.", (double)simCtx->walltimeGuardMinSeconds);
487 }

490 }
491
492 if(strcmp(simCtx->eulerianSource,"solve")!= 0 && strcmp(simCtx->eulerianSource,"load") != 0 && strcmp(simCtx->eulerianSource,"analytical")!=0){

496 const char *job_start_env = getenv("PICURV_JOB_START_EPOCH");
497 const char *limit_env = getenv("PICURV_WALLTIME_LIMIT_SECONDS");
498 PetscBool job_start_ok = RuntimeWalltimeGuardParsePositiveSeconds(job_start_env, &simCtx->walltimeGuardJobStartEpochSeconds);
499 PetscBool limit_ok = RuntimeWalltimeGuardParsePositiveSeconds(limit_env, &simCtx->walltimeGuardLimitSeconds);

501 if (!job_start_ok || !limit_ok) {
502 simCtx->walltimeGuardActive = PETSC_FALSE;
503 simCtx->walltimeGuardJobStartEpochSeconds = 0.0;
504 simCtx->walltimeGuardLimitSeconds = 0.0;
505 LOG_ALLOW(
506 GLOBAL,
507 LOG_WARNING,
508 "Runtime walltime guard enabled but %s/%s are missing or invalid. Falling back to external shutdown signals only.\n",
509 "PICURV_JOB_START_EPOCH",
510 "PICURV_WALLTIME_LIMIT_SECONDS"
511 );
512 } else {
513 simCtx->walltimeGuardActive = PETSC_TRUE;
514 }
515 }

575 // Keep parser acceptance aligned with the enum and FlowSolver dispatch.
576 if (mom_solver_type_flg) {
577 if(strcmp(mom_solver_type_char, "DUALTIME_PICARD_JAMESON_RK") == 0 ||
578 strcmp(mom_solver_type_char, "DUALTIME_PICARD_RK4") == 0) {
579 simCtx->mom_solver_type = MOMENTUM_SOLVER_DUALTIME_PICARD_JAMESON_RK;

581 simCtx->mom_solver_type = MOMENTUM_SOLVER_EXPLICIT_RK;
582 } else {
583 LOG(GLOBAL, LOG_ERROR, "Invalid value for -mom_solver_type: '%s'. Valid options are: 'DUALTIME_PICARD_JAMESON_RK', 'EXPLICIT_RK'.\n", mom_solver_type_char);
584 SETERRQ(PETSC_COMM_WORLD, PETSC_ERR_ARG_WRONG, "Invalid value for -mom_solver_type: '%s'.", mom_solver_type_char);
585 }
586 }
587
588 if (solution_convergence_mode_flg) {

590 simCtx->solutionConvergenceMode = SOLUTION_CONVERGENCE_STEADY_DETERMINISTIC;

732 simCtx->verificationDiffusivity.mode);
733 }
734 if (strcmp(simCtx->verificationDiffusivity.profile, "LINEAR_X") != 0) {
735 SETERRQ(PETSC_COMM_WORLD, PETSC_ERR_ARG_WRONG,
736 "Unsupported -verification_diffusivity_profile '%s'. Only 'LINEAR_X' is supported.",
737 simCtx->verificationDiffusivity.profile);
738 }
739 }
740 if (simCtx->verificationScalar.enabled) {
741 if (strcmp(simCtx->eulerianSource, "analytical") != 0) {
742 SETERRQ(PETSC_COMM_WORLD, PETSC_ERR_ARG_WRONGSTATE,
743 "verification scalar overrides require -euler_field_source \"analytical\".");
744 }
745 if (strcmp(simCtx->verificationScalar.mode, "analytical") != 0) {
746 SETERRQ(PETSC_COMM_WORLD, PETSC_ERR_ARG_WRONG,
747 "Unsupported -verification_scalar_mode '%s'. Only 'analytical' is supported.",
748 simCtx->verificationScalar.mode);
749 }
750 if (strcmp(simCtx->verificationScalar.profile, "CONSTANT") == 0) {
751 if (!verification_scalar_value_set) {
752 SETERRQ(PETSC_COMM_WORLD, PETSC_ERR_ARG_WRONG,
753 "verification scalar profile CONSTANT requires -verification_scalar_value.");
754 }
755 } else if (strcmp(simCtx->verificationScalar.profile, "LINEAR_X") == 0) {
756 if (!verification_scalar_phi0_set || !verification_scalar_slope_x_set) {
757 SETERRQ(PETSC_COMM_WORLD, PETSC_ERR_ARG_WRONG,
758 "verification scalar profile LINEAR_X requires -verification_scalar_phi0 and -verification_scalar_slope_x.");
759 }
760 } else if (strcmp(simCtx->verificationScalar.profile, "SIN_PRODUCT") == 0) {
761 if (!verification_scalar_amplitude_set || !verification_scalar_kx_set ||
762 !verification_scalar_ky_set || !verification_scalar_kz_set) {
763 SETERRQ(PETSC_COMM_WORLD, PETSC_ERR_ARG_WRONG,
764 "verification scalar profile SIN_PRODUCT requires -verification_scalar_amplitude, -verification_scalar_kx, -verification_scalar_ky, and -verification_scalar_kz.");
765 }
766 } else {
767 SETERRQ(PETSC_COMM_WORLD, PETSC_ERR_ARG_WRONG,
768 "Unsupported -verification_scalar_profile '%s'. Supported profiles: CONSTANT, LINEAR_X, SIN_PRODUCT.",
769 simCtx->verificationScalar.profile);
770 }
771 }
772 // NOTE: cdisx,cdisy,cdisz haven't been parsed, add if necessary.
773
774 // --- Group 6
775 LOG_ALLOW(GLOBAL,LOG_DEBUG, "Parsing Group 6: Physical & Geometric Parameters \n");
776 ierr = PetscOptionsGetReal(NULL,NULL,"-schmidt_number",&simCtx->schmidt_number,NULL);CHKERRQ(ierr);
777 ierr = PetscOptionsGetReal(NULL,NULL,"-turb_schmidt_number",&simCtx->Turbulent_schmidt_number,NULL);CHKERRQ(ierr);
778 ierr = PetscOptionsGetInt(NULL, NULL, "-no_of_bodies", &simCtx->NumberOfBodies, NULL); CHKERRQ(ierr);
779 ierr = PetscOptionsGetReal(NULL,NULL,"-wall_roughness",&simCtx->wall_roughness_height,NULL);CHKERRQ(ierr);
780 // NOTE: angle is not parsed in the original code, it set programmatically. We will follow that.
781 // NOTE: max_angle is calculated based on other flags (like MHV) in the legacy code.
782 // We will defer that logic to a later setup stage and not parse them directly.
783 // The Scaling Information is calculated here
784 ierr = ParseScalingInformation(simCtx); CHKERRQ(ierr);
785
786 // --- Group 7
787 LOG_ALLOW(GLOBAL,LOG_DEBUG, "Parsing Group 7: Grid, Domain, and Boundary Condition Settings \n");
788 ierr = PetscOptionsGetInt(NULL, NULL, "-nblk", &simCtx->block_number, NULL); CHKERRQ(ierr); // This is also a modern option
789 ierr = PetscOptionsGetInt(NULL, NULL, "-inlet", &simCtx->inletprofile, NULL); CHKERRQ(ierr);
790 ierr = PetscOptionsGetInt(NULL, NULL, "-Ogrid", &simCtx->Ogrid, NULL); CHKERRQ(ierr);
791 // NOTE: channelz was not parsed, likely set programmatically. We will omit its parsing call.
792 ierr = PetscOptionsGetInt(NULL, NULL, "-grid1d", &simCtx->grid1d, NULL); CHKERRQ(ierr);
793 ierr = PetscOptionsGetBool(NULL, NULL, "-grid", &simCtx->generate_grid, NULL); CHKERRQ(ierr);
794 ierr = PetscOptionsGetString(NULL, NULL, "-grid_file", simCtx->grid_file, PETSC_MAX_PATH_LEN, NULL); CHKERRQ(ierr);
795 ierr = PetscOptionsGetInt(NULL, NULL, "-da_processors_x", &simCtx->da_procs_x, NULL); CHKERRQ(ierr);
796 ierr = PetscOptionsGetInt(NULL, NULL, "-da_processors_y", &simCtx->da_procs_y, NULL); CHKERRQ(ierr);
797 ierr = PetscOptionsGetInt(NULL, NULL, "-da_processors_z", &simCtx->da_procs_z, NULL); CHKERRQ(ierr);
798 ierr = PetscOptionsGetInt(NULL, NULL, "-pbc_domain", &simCtx->blkpbc, NULL); CHKERRQ(ierr);
799 // NOTE: pseudo_periodic was not parsed. We will omit its parsing call.
800 ierr = PetscOptionsGetReal(NULL, NULL, "-grid_rotation_angle", &simCtx->grid_rotation_angle, NULL); CHKERRQ(ierr);
801 ierr = PetscOptionsGetReal(NULL, NULL, "-Croty", &simCtx->Croty, NULL); CHKERRQ(ierr);
802 ierr = PetscOptionsGetReal(NULL, NULL, "-Crotz", &simCtx->Crotz, NULL); CHKERRQ(ierr);
803 PetscBool bcs_flg;
804 char file_list_str[PETSC_MAX_PATH_LEN * 10]; // Buffer for comma-separated list
805
806 ierr = PetscOptionsGetString(NULL, NULL, "-bcs_files", file_list_str, sizeof(file_list_str), &bcs_flg); CHKERRQ(ierr);
807 ierr = PetscOptionsGetReal(NULL, NULL, "-U_bc", &simCtx->U_bc, NULL); CHKERRQ(ierr);
808
809 if (bcs_flg) {
810 LOG_ALLOW(GLOBAL, LOG_DEBUG, "Found -bcs_files option, overriding default.\n");
811
812 // A. Clean up the default memory we allocated in Phase 1.
813 ierr = PetscFree(simCtx->bcs_files[0]); CHKERRQ(ierr);
814 ierr = PetscFree(simCtx->bcs_files); CHKERRQ(ierr);
815 simCtx->num_bcs_files = 0;
816 simCtx->bcs_files = NULL;
817
818 // B. Parse the user-provided comma-separated list.
819 char *token;
820 char *str_copy;
821 ierr = PetscStrallocpy(file_list_str, &str_copy); CHKERRQ(ierr);
822
823 // First pass: count the number of files.
824 token = strtok(str_copy, ",");
825 while (token) {
826 simCtx->num_bcs_files++;
827 token = strtok(NULL, ",");
828 }
829 ierr = PetscFree(str_copy); CHKERRQ(ierr);
830
831 // Second pass: allocate memory and store the filenames.
832 ierr = PetscMalloc1(simCtx->num_bcs_files, &simCtx->bcs_files); CHKERRQ(ierr);
833 ierr = PetscStrallocpy(file_list_str, &str_copy); CHKERRQ(ierr);
834 token = strtok(str_copy, ",");
835 for (PetscInt i = 0; i < simCtx->num_bcs_files; i++) {
836 ierr = PetscStrallocpy(token, &simCtx->bcs_files[i]); CHKERRQ(ierr);
837 token = strtok(NULL, ",");
838 }
839 ierr = PetscFree(str_copy); CHKERRQ(ierr);
840 }
841
842
843 // --- Group 8
844 LOG_ALLOW(GLOBAL,LOG_DEBUG, "Parsing Group 8: Turbulence Modeling (LES/RANS) \n");
845 PetscInt temp_les_model;
846 ierr = PetscOptionsGetInt(NULL, NULL, "-les", &temp_les_model, NULL); CHKERRQ(ierr);
847 simCtx->les = (LESModelType)temp_les_model;
848 ierr = PetscOptionsGetInt(NULL, NULL, "-rans", &simCtx->rans, NULL); CHKERRQ(ierr);
849 ierr = PetscOptionsGetInt(NULL, NULL, "-wallfunction", &simCtx->wallfunction, NULL); CHKERRQ(ierr);
850 ierr = PetscOptionsGetInt(NULL, NULL, "-mixed", &simCtx->mixed, NULL); CHKERRQ(ierr);
851 ierr = PetscOptionsGetInt(NULL, NULL, "-clark", &simCtx->clark, NULL); CHKERRQ(ierr);
852 ierr = PetscOptionsGetInt(NULL, NULL, "-dynamic_freq", &simCtx->dynamic_freq, NULL); CHKERRQ(ierr);
853 ierr = PetscOptionsGetReal(NULL, NULL, "-max_cs", &simCtx->max_cs, NULL); CHKERRQ(ierr);
854 ierr = PetscOptionsGetReal(NULL, NULL, "-const_cs", &simCtx->Const_CS, NULL); CHKERRQ(ierr);
855 ierr = PetscOptionsGetInt(NULL, NULL, "-testfilter_ik", &simCtx->testfilter_ik, NULL); CHKERRQ(ierr);
856 ierr = PetscOptionsGetInt(NULL, NULL, "-testfilter_1d", &simCtx->testfilter_1d, NULL); CHKERRQ(ierr);
857 ierr = PetscOptionsGetInt(NULL, NULL, "-i_homo_filter", &simCtx->i_homo_filter, NULL); CHKERRQ(ierr);
858 ierr = PetscOptionsGetInt(NULL, NULL, "-j_homo_filter", &simCtx->j_homo_filter, NULL); CHKERRQ(ierr);
859 ierr = PetscOptionsGetInt(NULL, NULL, "-k_homo_filter", &simCtx->k_homo_filter, NULL); CHKERRQ(ierr);
860 ierr = PetscOptionsGetBool(NULL, NULL, "-averaging", &simCtx->averaging, NULL); CHKERRQ(ierr);
861
862 // --- Group 9
863 LOG_ALLOW(GLOBAL,LOG_DEBUG, "Parsing Group 9: Particle / DMSwarm Data & Settings \n");
864 ierr = PetscOptionsGetInt(NULL, NULL, "-numParticles", &simCtx->np, NULL); CHKERRQ(ierr);
865 ierr = PetscOptionsGetBool(NULL, NULL, "-read_fields", &simCtx->readFields, NULL); CHKERRQ(ierr);
866 PetscInt temp_pinit = (PetscInt)PARTICLE_INIT_SURFACE_RANDOM;
867 ierr = PetscOptionsGetInt(NULL, NULL, "-pinit", &temp_pinit, NULL); CHKERRQ(ierr);
868 simCtx->ParticleInitialization = (ParticleInitializationType)temp_pinit;
869 PetscInt temp_interp = (PetscInt)INTERP_TRILINEAR;
870 ierr = PetscOptionsGetInt(NULL, NULL, "-interpolation_method", &temp_interp, NULL); CHKERRQ(ierr);
871 simCtx->interpolationMethod = (InterpolationMethod)temp_interp;
872 LOG_ALLOW(GLOBAL, LOG_DEBUG, "Interpolation method: %s\n",
873 simCtx->interpolationMethod == INTERP_TRILINEAR ? "Trilinear (direct cell-center)" : "CornerAveraged (legacy)");
874 ierr = PetscOptionsGetReal(NULL, NULL, "-psrc_x", &simCtx->psrc_x, NULL); CHKERRQ(ierr);
875 ierr = PetscOptionsGetReal(NULL, NULL, "-psrc_y", &simCtx->psrc_y, NULL); CHKERRQ(ierr);
876 ierr = PetscOptionsGetReal(NULL, NULL, "-psrc_z", &simCtx->psrc_z, NULL); CHKERRQ(ierr);
877 LOG_ALLOW(GLOBAL, LOG_DEBUG, "Particle initialization mode: %s. Point source: (%.6f, %.6f, %.6f)\n",
878 ParticleInitializationToString(simCtx->ParticleInitialization),
879 simCtx->psrc_x, simCtx->psrc_y, simCtx->psrc_z);
880 ierr = PetscOptionsGetString(NULL,NULL,"-particle_restart_mode",simCtx->particleRestartMode,sizeof(simCtx->particleRestartMode),NULL); CHKERRQ(ierr);
881 // Validation for Particle Restart Mode
882 if (strcmp(simCtx->particleRestartMode, "load") != 0 && strcmp(simCtx->particleRestartMode, "init") != 0) {
883 SETERRQ(PETSC_COMM_WORLD, PETSC_ERR_ARG_WRONG, "Invalid value for -particle_restart_mode. Must be 'load' or 'init'. You provided '%s'.", simCtx->particleRestartMode);
884 }
885 ierr = InitializeBrownianRNG(simCtx); CHKERRQ(ierr);
886 // --- Group 10
887 LOG_ALLOW(GLOBAL,LOG_DEBUG, "Parsing Group 10: Immersed Boundary & FSI Data Object Pointers \n");
888 ierr = PetscOptionsGetBool(NULL, NULL, "-rs_fsi", &simCtx->rstart_fsi, NULL); CHKERRQ(ierr);
889 ierr = PetscOptionsGetInt(NULL, NULL, "-duplicate", &simCtx->duplicate, NULL); CHKERRQ(ierr);
890
891 // --- Group 11
892 LOG_ALLOW(GLOBAL,LOG_DEBUG, "Parsing Group 11: Top-Level Managers & Custom Configuration \n");
893 ierr = PetscOptionsGetInt(NULL, NULL, "-logfreq", &simCtx->LoggingFrequency, NULL); CHKERRQ(ierr);
894
895 if (simCtx->num_bcs_files != simCtx->block_number) {
896 SETERRQ(PETSC_COMM_WORLD, PETSC_ERR_ARG_INCOMP, "Number of BC files (%d) does not match number of blocks (%d). Use -bcs_files \"file1.dat,file2.dat,...\".", simCtx->num_bcs_files, simCtx->block_number);
897 }
898
899 // --- Group 12
900 LOG_ALLOW(GLOBAL,LOG_DEBUG, "Parsing Group 12: Post-Processing Information.\n");
901 // This logic determines the Post Processing configuration and STORES it in simCtx for later reference and cleanup.
902 ierr = PetscOptionsGetString(NULL,NULL,"-postprocessing_config_file",simCtx->PostprocessingControlFile,PETSC_MAX_PATH_LEN,NULL); CHKERRQ(ierr);
903 /* Parse post settings for both solver and post-processor binaries using the single pre-allocated pps object. */
904 ierr = ParsePostProcessingSettings(simCtx);
905
906 // === 5. Dependent Parameter Calculations ================================
907 // Some parameters depend on others, so we calculate them here.
908 simCtx->StartTime = (PetscReal)simCtx->StartStep*simCtx->dt;
909 simCtx->ti = simCtx->StartTime;
910 simCtx->step = simCtx->StartStep;
911
912 // === 5. Log Summary and Finalize Setup ==================================
913 LOG_ALLOW(GLOBAL, LOG_DEBUG, "-- Console Output Functions [Total : %d] : --\n", simCtx->nAllowed);
914 for (PetscInt i = 0; i < simCtx->nAllowed; ++i) {
915 LOG_ALLOW(GLOBAL, LOG_DEBUG, " [%2d] «%s»\n", i, simCtx->allowedFuncs[i]);
916 }
917
918 LOG_ALLOW(GLOBAL, LOG_INFO, "Configuration complete. Key parameters:\n");
919 LOG_ALLOW(GLOBAL, LOG_INFO, " - Run mode: %s\n", simCtx->OnlySetup ? "SETUP ONLY" : "Full Simulation");
920 LOG_ALLOW(GLOBAL, LOG_INFO, " - Time steps: %d (from %d to %d)\n", simCtx->StepsToRun, simCtx->StartStep, simCtx->StartStep + simCtx->StepsToRun);
921 LOG_ALLOW(GLOBAL, LOG_INFO, " - Time step size (dt): %g\n", simCtx->dt);
922 if (simCtx->tiout > 0) {
923 LOG_ALLOW(GLOBAL, LOG_INFO, " - Field/restart output cadence: every %d step(s)\n", simCtx->tiout);
924 } else {
925 LOG_ALLOW(GLOBAL, LOG_INFO, " - Field/restart output cadence: DISABLED\n");
926 }
927 LOG_ALLOW(GLOBAL, LOG_INFO, " - Immersed Boundary: %s\n", simCtx->immersed ? "ENABLED" : "DISABLED");
928 LOG_ALLOW(GLOBAL, LOG_INFO, " - Particles: %d\n", simCtx->np);
929 if (simCtx->np > 0) {
930 if (simCtx->particleConsoleOutputFreq > 0) {
931 LOG_ALLOW(GLOBAL, LOG_INFO, " - Particle console cadence: every %d step(s)\n", simCtx->particleConsoleOutputFreq);
932 } else {
933 LOG_ALLOW(GLOBAL, LOG_INFO, " - Particle console cadence: DISABLED\n");
934 }
935 LOG_ALLOW(GLOBAL, LOG_INFO, " - Particle console row subsampling: every %d particle(s)\n", simCtx->LoggingFrequency);
936 }
937 if (simCtx->StartStep > 0 && simCtx->np > 0) {
938 LOG_ALLOW(GLOBAL, LOG_INFO, " - Particle Restart Mode: %s\n", simCtx->particleRestartMode);
939 }
940
941 // --- Initialize PETSc's internal performance logging stage ---
942 ierr = PetscLogDefaultBegin(); CHKERRQ(ierr); // REDUNDANT but safe.
943 ierr = PetscMemorySetGetMaximumUsage(); CHKERRQ(ierr);
944
945 LOG_ALLOW(GLOBAL, LOG_DEBUG, "Finished CreateSimulationContext successfully on rank %d.\n", simCtx->rank);
946
947 PROFILE_FUNCTION_END;
948 PetscFunctionReturn(0);
949}
950
951#undef __FUNCT__
952#define __FUNCT__ "PetscMkdirRecursive"
953/**
954 * @brief Internal helper implementation: `PetscMkdirRecursive()`.
955 * @details Local to this translation unit.
956 */
957static PetscErrorCode PetscMkdirRecursive(const char *path)
958{
959 PetscErrorCode ierr;
960 char tmp_path[PETSC_MAX_PATH_LEN];
961 char *p = NULL;
962 size_t len;
963 PetscBool exists;
964
965 PetscFunctionBeginUser;
966
967 // Create a mutable copy of the path
968 len = strlen(path);
969 if (len >= sizeof(tmp_path)) {
970 SETERRQ(PETSC_COMM_SELF, PETSC_ERR_ARG_SIZ, "Path is too long to process: %s", path);
971 }
972 strcpy(tmp_path, path);
973
974 // If the path ends with a separator, remove it
975 if (tmp_path[len - 1] == '/') {
976 tmp_path[len - 1] = 0;
977 }
978
979 // Iterate through the path, creating each directory level
980 for (p = tmp_path + 1; *p; p++) {
981 if (*p == '/') {
982 *p = 0; // Temporarily terminate the string
983
984 // Check if this directory level exists
985 ierr = PetscTestDirectory(tmp_path, 'r', &exists); CHKERRQ(ierr);
986 if (!exists) {
987 ierr = PetscMkdir(tmp_path); CHKERRQ(ierr);
988 }
989
990 *p = '/'; // Restore the separator
991 }
992 }
993
994 // Create the final, full directory path
995 ierr = PetscTestDirectory(tmp_path, 'r', &exists); CHKERRQ(ierr);
996 if (!exists) {
997 ierr = PetscMkdir(tmp_path); CHKERRQ(ierr);
998 }
999
1000 PetscFunctionReturn(0);
1001}
1002
1003#undef __FUNCT__
1004#define __FUNCT__ "SetupSimulationEnvironment"
1005/**
1006 * @brief Internal helper implementation: `SetupSimulationEnvironment()`.
1007 * @details Local to this translation unit.
1008 */
1009PetscErrorCode SetupSimulationEnvironment(SimCtx *simCtx)
1010{
1011 PetscErrorCode ierr;
1012 PetscMPIInt rank;
1013 PetscBool exists;
1014
1015 PetscFunctionBeginUser;
1016 ierr = MPI_Comm_rank(PETSC_COMM_WORLD, &rank); CHKERRQ(ierr);
1017
1018 LOG_ALLOW(GLOBAL, LOG_INFO, "--- Setting up simulation environment ---\n");
1019
1020 /* =====================================================================
1021 * Phase 1: Check for all required and optional INPUT files.
1022 * ===================================================================== */
1023 LOG_ALLOW(GLOBAL, LOG_DEBUG, "Phase 1: Verifying input files...\n");
1024
1025 // --- Mandatory Inputs ---
1026 if (!simCtx->generate_grid) {
1027 ierr = VerifyPathExistence(simCtx->grid_file, PETSC_FALSE, PETSC_FALSE, "Grid file", &exists); CHKERRQ(ierr);
1028 }
1029 for (PetscInt i = 0; i < simCtx->num_bcs_files; i++) {
1030 char desc[128];
1031 ierr = PetscSNPrintf(desc, sizeof(desc), "BCS file #%d", i + 1); CHKERRQ(ierr);
1032 ierr = VerifyPathExistence(simCtx->bcs_files[i], PETSC_FALSE, PETSC_FALSE, desc, &exists); CHKERRQ(ierr);
1033 }
1034
1035 // --- Optional Inputs (these produce warnings if missing) ---
1036 if (simCtx->useCfg) {
1037 ierr = VerifyPathExistence(simCtx->allowedFile, PETSC_FALSE, PETSC_TRUE, "Whitelist config file", &exists); CHKERRQ(ierr);
1038 }
1039 if (simCtx->useProfilingSelectedFuncsCfg) {
1040 ierr = VerifyPathExistence(simCtx->profilingSelectedFuncsFile, PETSC_FALSE, PETSC_TRUE, "Profiling config file", &exists); CHKERRQ(ierr);
1041 }
1042 if (simCtx->exec_mode == EXEC_MODE_POSTPROCESSOR) {
1043 ierr = VerifyPathExistence(simCtx->PostprocessingControlFile, PETSC_FALSE, PETSC_TRUE, "Post-processing control file", &exists); CHKERRQ(ierr);
1044 }
1045
1046
1047 /* =====================================================================
1048 * Phase 2: Validate directories specific to the execution mode.
1049 * ===================================================================== */
1050 LOG_ALLOW(GLOBAL, LOG_DEBUG, "Phase 2: Verifying execution mode directories...\n");
1051 // The data source directory must exist if we intend to load any data from it.
1052 // This is true if:
1053 // 1. We are restarting from a previous time step (StartStep > 0), which implies
1054 // loading Eulerian fields and/or particle fields.
1055 // 2. We are starting from t=0 but are explicitly told to load the initial
1056 // Eulerian fields from a file (eulerianSource == "load").
1057 if (simCtx->StartStep > 0 || strcmp(simCtx->eulerianSource,"load")== 0){ // If this is a restart run
1058 ierr = VerifyPathExistence(simCtx->restart_dir, PETSC_TRUE, PETSC_FALSE, "Restart source directory", &exists); CHKERRQ(ierr);
1059 }
1060 if (simCtx->StartStep == 0 && strcmp(simCtx->eulerianSource, "solve") == 0 &&
1061 simCtx->initialConditionMode == IC_MODE_FILE) {
1062 ierr = VerifyPathExistence(simCtx->initialConditionDirectory, PETSC_TRUE, PETSC_FALSE,
1063 "Initial-condition source directory", &exists); CHKERRQ(ierr);
1064 }
1065 if (simCtx->exec_mode == EXEC_MODE_POSTPROCESSOR) {
1066 ierr = VerifyPathExistence(simCtx->pps->source_dir, PETSC_TRUE, PETSC_FALSE, "Post-processing source directory", &exists); CHKERRQ(ierr);
1067 }
1068
1069 /* =====================================================================
1070 * Phase 3: Create and prepare all OUTPUT directories.
1071 * ===================================================================== */
1072 LOG_ALLOW(GLOBAL, LOG_DEBUG, "Phase 3: Preparing output directories...\n");
1073
1074 if (rank == 0){
1075 if(simCtx->exec_mode == EXEC_MODE_SOLVER){
1076 // --- Prepare Log Directory ---
1077 if (!simCtx->continueMode) {
1078 // Only wipe logs on fresh runs; continue mode appends to existing logs.
1079 LOG_ALLOW(GLOBAL, LOG_DEBUG, "Creating/cleaning log directory: %s\n", simCtx->log_dir);
1080 ierr = PetscRMTree(simCtx->log_dir); // Wipes the directory and its contents
1081 if (ierr) { /* Ignore file-not-found error, but fail on others */
1082 PetscError(PETSC_COMM_SELF, __LINE__, __FUNCT__, __FILE__, ierr, PETSC_ERROR_INITIAL, "Could not remove existing log directory '%s'. Check permissions.", simCtx->log_dir);
1083 }
1084 ierr = PetscMkdir(simCtx->log_dir); CHKERRQ(ierr);
1085 } else {
1086 // In continue mode, ensure log directory exists but don't wipe it.
1087 LOG_ALLOW(GLOBAL, LOG_DEBUG, "Continue mode: preserving existing log directory: %s\n", simCtx->log_dir);
1088 ierr = PetscMkdir(simCtx->log_dir); CHKERRQ(ierr);
1089 }
1090
1091 // --- Prepare Output Directories ---
1092 char path_buffer[PETSC_MAX_PATH_LEN];
1093
1094 // 1. Check/Create the main output directory
1095 LOG_ALLOW(GLOBAL, LOG_DEBUG, "Verifying main output directory: %s\n", simCtx->output_dir);
1096 ierr = PetscTestDirectory(simCtx->output_dir, 'r', &exists); CHKERRQ(ierr);
1097 if (!exists) {
1098 LOG_ALLOW(GLOBAL, LOG_INFO, "Output directory not found. Creating: %s\n", simCtx->output_dir);
1099 ierr = PetscMkdir(simCtx->output_dir); CHKERRQ(ierr);
1100 }
1101
1102 // 2. Check/Create the Eulerian subdirectory
1103 ierr = PetscSNPrintf(path_buffer, sizeof(path_buffer), "%s/%s", simCtx->output_dir, simCtx->euler_subdir); CHKERRQ(ierr);
1104 LOG_ALLOW(GLOBAL, LOG_DEBUG, "Verifying Eulerian subdirectory: %s\n", path_buffer);
1105 ierr = PetscTestDirectory(path_buffer, 'r', &exists); CHKERRQ(ierr);
1106 if (!exists) {
1107 LOG_ALLOW(GLOBAL, LOG_INFO, "Eulerian subdirectory not found. Creating: %s\n", path_buffer);
1108 ierr = PetscMkdir(path_buffer); CHKERRQ(ierr);
1109 }
1110
1111 // 3. Check/Create the Particle subdirectory if needed
1112 if (simCtx->np > 0) {
1113 ierr = PetscSNPrintf(path_buffer, sizeof(path_buffer), "%s/%s", simCtx->output_dir, simCtx->particle_subdir); CHKERRQ(ierr);
1114 LOG_ALLOW(GLOBAL, LOG_DEBUG, "Verifying Particle subdirectory: %s\n", path_buffer);
1115 ierr = PetscTestDirectory(path_buffer, 'r', &exists); CHKERRQ(ierr);
1116 if (!exists) {
1117 LOG_ALLOW(GLOBAL, LOG_INFO, "Particle subdirectory not found. Creating: %s\n", path_buffer);
1118 ierr = PetscMkdir(path_buffer); CHKERRQ(ierr);
1119 }
1120 }
1121 } else if(simCtx->exec_mode == EXEC_MODE_POSTPROCESSOR){
1122 LOG_ALLOW(GLOBAL, LOG_DEBUG, "Preparing post-processing output directories ...\n");
1123
1124 PostProcessParams *pps = simCtx->pps;
1125 char path_buffer[PETSC_MAX_PATH_LEN];
1126
1127 const char *last_slash_euler = strrchr(pps->output_prefix, '/');
1128 if(last_slash_euler){
1129 size_t dir_len = last_slash_euler - pps->output_prefix;
1130 if(dir_len > 0){
1131 if(dir_len >= sizeof(path_buffer)) SETERRQ(PETSC_COMM_WORLD,PETSC_ERR_ARG_WRONG,"Post-processing output prefix path is too long.");
1132 strncpy(path_buffer, pps->output_prefix, dir_len);
1133 path_buffer[dir_len] = '\0';
1134
1135 ierr = PetscTestDirectory(path_buffer, 'r', &exists); CHKERRQ(ierr);
1136 if (!exists){
1137 LOG_ALLOW(GLOBAL, LOG_INFO, "Creating post-processing Eulerian output directory: %s\n", path_buffer);
1138 ierr = PetscMkdirRecursive(path_buffer); CHKERRQ(ierr);
1139 }
1140 }
1141 }
1142
1143 // Particle output directory
1144 if(pps->outputParticles){
1145 const char *last_slash_particle = strrchr(pps->particle_output_prefix, '/');
1146 if(last_slash_particle){
1147 size_t dir_len = last_slash_particle - pps->particle_output_prefix;
1148 if(dir_len > 0){
1149 if(dir_len > sizeof(path_buffer)) SETERRQ(PETSC_COMM_WORLD,PETSC_ERR_ARG_WRONG,"Post-processing particle output prefix path is too long.");
1150 strncpy(path_buffer, pps->particle_output_prefix, dir_len);
1151 path_buffer[dir_len] = '\0';
1152
1153 ierr = PetscTestDirectory(path_buffer, 'r', &exists); CHKERRQ(ierr);
1154
1155 if (!exists){
1156 LOG_ALLOW(GLOBAL, LOG_INFO, "Creating post-processing Particle output directory: %s\n", path_buffer);
1157 ierr = PetscMkdirRecursive(path_buffer); CHKERRQ(ierr);
1158 }
1159 }
1160 }
1161 }
1162
1163 // Statistics output directory
1164 if(pps->statistics_pipeline[0] != '\0'){
1165 const char *last_slash_stats = strrchr(pps->statistics_output_prefix, '/');
1166 if(last_slash_stats){
1167 size_t dir_len = last_slash_stats - pps->statistics_output_prefix;
1168 if(dir_len > 0){
1169 if(dir_len >= sizeof(path_buffer)) SETERRQ(PETSC_COMM_WORLD,PETSC_ERR_ARG_WRONG,"Post-processing statistics output prefix path is too long.");
1170 strncpy(path_buffer, pps->statistics_output_prefix, dir_len);
1171 path_buffer[dir_len] = '\0';
1172
1173 ierr = PetscTestDirectory(path_buffer, 'r', &exists); CHKERRQ(ierr);
1174 if (!exists){
1175 LOG_ALLOW(GLOBAL, LOG_INFO, "Creating post-processing Statistics output directory: %s\n", path_buffer);
1176 ierr = PetscMkdirRecursive(path_buffer); CHKERRQ(ierr);
1177 }
1178 }
1179 }
1180 }
1181 }
1182 }
1183
1184 // Synchronize all processes before proceeding
1185 ierr = MPI_Barrier(PETSC_COMM_WORLD); CHKERRMPI(ierr);
1186
1187 LOG_ALLOW(GLOBAL, LOG_INFO, "--- Environment setup complete ---\n");
1188
1189 PetscFunctionReturn(0);
1190}
1191
1192#undef __FUNCT__
1193#define __FUNCT__ "AllocateContextHeirarchy"
1194/**
1195 * @brief Internal helper implementation: `AllocateContextHierarchy()`.
1196 * @details Local to this translation unit.
1197 */
1198static PetscErrorCode AllocateContextHierarchy(SimCtx *simCtx)
1199{
1200 PetscErrorCode ierr;
1201 UserMG *usermg = &simCtx->usermg;
1202 MGCtx *mgctx;
1203 PetscInt nblk = simCtx->block_number;
1204 PetscBool found;
1205 PetscFunctionBeginUser;
1206 PROFILE_FUNCTION_BEGIN;
1207
1208 LOG_ALLOW(GLOBAL, LOG_INFO, "Allocating context hierarchy for %d levels and %d blocks...\n", simCtx->mglevels, nblk);
1209
1210 // Store the number of levels in the UserMG struct itself
1211 usermg->mglevels = simCtx->mglevels;
1212
1213 // --- 1. Allocate the array of MGCtx structs ---
1214 ierr = PetscMalloc(usermg->mglevels * sizeof(MGCtx), &usermg->mgctx); CHKERRQ(ierr);
1215 // Zero-initialize to ensure all pointers (especially packer) are NULL
1216 ierr = PetscMemzero(usermg->mgctx, usermg->mglevels * sizeof(MGCtx)); CHKERRQ(ierr);
1217 mgctx = usermg->mgctx;
1218 LOG_ALLOW(LOCAL, LOG_DEBUG, "Rank %d: Allocated MGCtx array of size %d.\n", simCtx->rank, usermg->mglevels);
1219
1220 // --- 2. Parse semi-coarsening options (logic from MG_Initial) ---
1221 // These flags determine if a dimension is coarsened in the multigrid hierarchy.
1222 PetscInt *isc, *jsc, *ksc;
1223 ierr = PetscMalloc3(nblk, &isc, nblk, &jsc, nblk, &ksc); CHKERRQ(ierr);
1224 // Set defaults to FALSE (full coarsening)
1225 for (PetscInt i = 0; i < nblk; ++i) {
1226 isc[i] = 0; jsc[i] = 0; ksc[i] = 0;
1227 }
1228
1229// Use a temporary variable for the 'count' argument to the parsing function.
1230 // This protects the original 'nblk' which is needed for the loop bounds.
1231 PetscInt n_opts_found = nblk;
1232 ierr = PetscOptionsGetIntArray(NULL, NULL, "-mg_i_semi", isc, &n_opts_found, &found); CHKERRQ(ierr);
1233
1234 n_opts_found = nblk; // Reset the temp variable before the next call
1235 ierr = PetscOptionsGetIntArray(NULL, NULL, "-mg_j_semi", jsc, &n_opts_found, &found); CHKERRQ(ierr);
1236
1237 n_opts_found = nblk; // Reset the temp variable before the next call
1238 ierr = PetscOptionsGetIntArray(NULL, NULL, "-mg_k_semi", ksc, &n_opts_found, &found); CHKERRQ(ierr);
1239
1240 // --- 3. Loop over levels and blocks to allocate UserCtx arrays ---
1241 for (PetscInt level = 0; level < simCtx->mglevels; level++) {
1242
1243 LOG_ALLOW(LOCAL, LOG_DEBUG, "Rank %d: Setting up MG Level %d...\n", simCtx->rank, level);
1244 // Allocate the array of UserCtx structs for this level
1245 ierr = PetscMalloc(nblk * sizeof(UserCtx), &mgctx[level].user); CHKERRQ(ierr);
1246 // It's good practice to zero out the memory to avoid uninitialized values
1247 ierr = PetscMemzero(mgctx[level].user, nblk * sizeof(UserCtx)); CHKERRQ(ierr);
1248 mgctx[level].thislevel = level;
1249
1250 for (PetscInt bi = 0; bi < nblk; bi++) {
1251 UserCtx *currentUser = &mgctx[level].user[bi];
1252 LOG_ALLOW(LOCAL, LOG_DEBUG, "Rank %d: Initializing UserCtx for Level %d, Block %d.\n", simCtx->rank, level, bi);
1253
1254 // --- CRITICAL STEP: Set the back-pointer to the master context ---
1255 currentUser->simCtx = simCtx;
1256
1257 // Initialize other per-context values
1258 currentUser->thislevel = level;
1259 currentUser->_this = bi; //
1260 currentUser->mglevels = usermg->mglevels;
1261
1262 // Assign semi-coarsening flags
1263 currentUser->isc = isc[bi];
1264 currentUser->jsc = jsc[bi];
1265 currentUser->ksc = ksc[bi];
1266
1267 // Link to finer/coarser contexts for multigrid operations
1268 if (level > 0) {
1269 currentUser->user_c = &mgctx[level-1].user[bi];
1270 LOG_ALLOW_SYNC(GLOBAL, LOG_DEBUG, "Rank %d: -> Linked to coarser context (user_c).\n", simCtx->rank);
1271 }
1272 if (level < usermg->mglevels - 1) {
1273 currentUser->user_f = &mgctx[level+1].user[bi];
1274 LOG_ALLOW_SYNC(GLOBAL, LOG_DEBUG, "Rank %d: -> Linked to finer context (user_f).\n", simCtx->rank);
1275 }
1276 }
1277 }
1278
1279 // Log a summary of the parsed flags on each rank.
1280 if (get_log_level() >= LOG_DEBUG && nblk > 0) {
1281 LOG_ALLOW(LOCAL, LOG_DEBUG, "Rank %d: Final semi-coarsening configuration view:\n", simCtx->rank);
1282 for (PetscInt bi = 0; bi < nblk; ++bi) {
1283 LOG_ALLOW(LOCAL, LOG_DEBUG, "Rank %d: Block %d: i-semi=%d, j-semi=%d, k-semi=%d\n", simCtx->rank, bi, isc[bi], jsc[bi], ksc[bi]);
1284 }
1285 }
1286
1287 // Clean up temporary arrays
1288 ierr = PetscFree3(isc, jsc, ksc); CHKERRQ(ierr);
1289
1290 LOG_ALLOW(GLOBAL, LOG_INFO, "Context hierarchy allocation complete.\n");
1291 PROFILE_FUNCTION_END;
1292 PetscFunctionReturn(0);
1293}
1294
1295#undef __FUNCT__
1296#define __FUNCT__ "SetupSolverParameters"
1297/**
1298 * @brief Internal helper implementation: `SetupSolverParameters()`.
1299 * @details Local to this translation unit.
1300 */
1301static PetscErrorCode SetupSolverParameters(SimCtx *simCtx){
1302
1303 PetscFunctionBeginUser;
1304 PROFILE_FUNCTION_BEGIN;
1305
1306 LOG_ALLOW(GLOBAL,LOG_INFO, " -- Setting up solver parameters -- .\n");
1307
1308 UserMG *usermg = &simCtx->usermg;
1309 MGCtx *mgctx = usermg->mgctx;
1310 PetscInt nblk = simCtx->block_number;
1311
1312 for (PetscInt level = usermg->mglevels-1; level >=0; level--) {
1313 for (PetscInt bi = 0; bi < nblk; bi++) {
1314 UserCtx *user = &mgctx[level].user[bi];
1315 LOG_ALLOW_SYNC(LOCAL, LOG_DEBUG, "Rank %d: Setting up parameters for level %d, block %d\n", simCtx->rank, level, bi);
1316
1317 user->assignedA = PETSC_FALSE;
1318 user->multinullspace = PETSC_FALSE;
1319 }
1320 }
1321 PROFILE_FUNCTION_END;
1322 PetscFunctionReturn(0);
1323}

1325#undef __FUNCT__
1326#define __FUNCT__ "SetupGridAndSolvers"
1327/**
1328 * @brief Implementation of \ref SetupGridAndSolvers().
1329 * @details Full API contract (arguments, ownership, side effects) is documented with
1330 * the header declaration in `include/setup.h`.
1331 * @see SetupGridAndSolvers()
1332 */
1333PetscErrorCode SetupGridAndSolvers(SimCtx *simCtx)
1334{
1335 PetscErrorCode ierr;
1336 PetscFunctionBeginUser;
1337
1338 PROFILE_FUNCTION_BEGIN;
1339
1340 LOG_ALLOW(GLOBAL, LOG_INFO, "--- Starting Grid and Solvers Setup ---\n");
1341
1342 // Phase 1: Allocate the UserMG and UserCtx hierarchy
1343 ierr = AllocateContextHierarchy(simCtx); CHKERRQ(ierr);
1344
1345 ierr = DefineAllGridDimensions(simCtx); CHKERRQ(ierr);
1346 ierr = InitializeAllGridDMs(simCtx); CHKERRQ(ierr);
1347 ierr = AssignAllGridCoordinates(simCtx); CHKERRQ(ierr);
1348 ierr = CreateAndInitializeAllVectors(simCtx); CHKERRQ(ierr);
1349 ierr = SetupSolverParameters(simCtx); CHKERRQ(ierr);
1350 ierr = InitializeSolutionConvergenceState(simCtx); CHKERRQ(ierr);
1351
1352 // NOTE: CalculateAllGridMetrics is now called inside SetupBoundaryConditions (not here) to ensure:
1353 // 1. Boundary condition configuration data (boundary_faces) is available for periodic BC corrections
1354 // 2. Computed metrics are available for inlet/outlet area calculations
1355 // This resolves the circular dependency between BC setup and metric calculations.
1356
1357 LOG_ALLOW(GLOBAL, LOG_INFO, "--- Grid and Solvers Setup Complete ---\n");
1358
1359 PROFILE_FUNCTION_END;
1360 PetscFunctionReturn(0);
1361}

1363
1364#undef __FUNCT__
1365#define __FUNCT__ "CreateAndInitializeAllVectors"
1366/**
1367 * @brief Internal helper implementation: `CreateAndInitializeAllVectors()`.
1368 * @details Local to this translation unit.
1369 */
1370PetscErrorCode CreateAndInitializeAllVectors(SimCtx *simCtx)
1371{
1372 PetscErrorCode ierr;
1373 UserMG *usermg = &simCtx->usermg;
1374 MGCtx *mgctx = usermg->mgctx;
1375 PetscInt nblk = simCtx->block_number;
1376
1377 PetscFunctionBeginUser;
1378
1379 PROFILE_FUNCTION_BEGIN;
1380
1381 LOG_ALLOW(GLOBAL, LOG_INFO, "Creating and initializing all simulation vectors...\n");
1382
1383 for (PetscInt level = usermg->mglevels-1; level >=0; level--) {
1384 for (PetscInt bi = 0; bi < nblk; bi++) {
1385 UserCtx *user = &mgctx[level].user[bi];
1386
1387 if(!user->da || !user->fda) {
1388 SETERRQ(PETSC_COMM_WORLD, PETSC_ERR_ARG_WRONGSTATE, "DMs not properly initialized in UserCtx before vector creation.");
1389 }
1390
1391 LOG_ALLOW_SYNC(LOCAL, LOG_DEBUG, "Rank %d: Creating vectors for level %d, block %d\n", simCtx->rank, level, bi);
1392
1393 // --- Group A: Primary Flow Fields (Global and Local) ---
1394 // These are the core solution variables.
1395 ierr = DMCreateGlobalVector(user->fda, &user->Ucont); CHKERRQ(ierr); ierr = VecSet(user->Ucont, 0.0); CHKERRQ(ierr);
1396 ierr = DMCreateGlobalVector(user->fda, &user->Ucat); CHKERRQ(ierr); ierr = VecSet(user->Ucat, 0.0); CHKERRQ(ierr);
1397 ierr = DMCreateGlobalVector(user->da, &user->P); CHKERRQ(ierr); ierr = VecSet(user->P, 0.0); CHKERRQ(ierr);
1398 ierr = DMCreateGlobalVector(user->da, &user->Nvert); CHKERRQ(ierr); ierr = VecSet(user->Nvert, 0.0); CHKERRQ(ierr);
1399
1400 ierr = DMCreateLocalVector(user->fda, &user->lUcont); CHKERRQ(ierr); ierr = VecSet(user->lUcont, 0.0); CHKERRQ(ierr);
1401 ierr = DMCreateLocalVector(user->fda, &user->lUcat); CHKERRQ(ierr); ierr = VecSet(user->lUcat, 0.0); CHKERRQ(ierr);
1402 ierr = DMCreateLocalVector(user->da, &user->lP); CHKERRQ(ierr); ierr = VecSet(user->lP, 0.0); CHKERRQ(ierr);
1403 ierr = DMCreateLocalVector(user->da, &user->lNvert); CHKERRQ(ierr); ierr = VecSet(user->lNvert, 0.0); CHKERRQ(ierr);
1404
1405 // -- Group A2: Derived Flow Fields (Global and Local) ---
1406 ierr = VecDuplicate(user->P,&user->Diffusivity); CHKERRQ(ierr); ierr = VecSet(user->Diffusivity, 0.0); CHKERRQ(ierr);
1407 ierr = VecDuplicate(user->lP,&user->lDiffusivity); CHKERRQ(ierr); ierr = VecSet(user->lDiffusivity, 0.0); CHKERRQ(ierr);
1408 ierr = VecDuplicate(user->Ucat,&user->DiffusivityGradient); CHKERRQ(ierr); ierr = VecSet(user->DiffusivityGradient, 0.0); CHKERRQ(ierr);
1409 ierr = VecDuplicate(user->lUcat,&user->lDiffusivityGradient); CHKERRQ(ierr); ierr = VecSet(user->lDiffusivityGradient, 0.0); CHKERRQ(ierr);
1410
1411 // -- Group B: Solver Work Vectors (Global and Local) ---
1412 ierr = VecDuplicate(user->P, &user->Phi); CHKERRQ(ierr); ierr = VecSet(user->Phi, 0.0); CHKERRQ(ierr);
1413 ierr = VecDuplicate(user->lP, &user->lPhi); CHKERRQ(ierr); ierr = VecSet(user->lPhi, 0.0); CHKERRQ(ierr);
1414
1415 // --- Group C: Time-Stepping & Workspace Fields (Finest Level Only) ---
1416 if (level == usermg->mglevels - 1) {
1417 ierr = VecDuplicate(user->Ucont, &user->Ucont_o); CHKERRQ(ierr); ierr = VecSet(user->Ucont_o, 0.0); CHKERRQ(ierr);
1418 ierr = VecDuplicate(user->Ucont, &user->Ucont_rm1); CHKERRQ(ierr); ierr = VecSet(user->Ucont_rm1, 0.0); CHKERRQ(ierr);
1419 ierr = VecDuplicate(user->Ucat, &user->Ucat_o); CHKERRQ(ierr); ierr = VecSet(user->Ucat_o, 0.0); CHKERRQ(ierr);
1420 ierr = VecDuplicate(user->P, &user->P_o); CHKERRQ(ierr); ierr = VecSet(user->P_o, 0.0); CHKERRQ(ierr);
1421 ierr = VecDuplicate(user->lUcont, &user->lUcont_o); CHKERRQ(ierr); ierr = VecSet(user->lUcont_o, 0.0); CHKERRQ(ierr);
1422 ierr = VecDuplicate(user->lUcont, &user->lUcont_rm1); CHKERRQ(ierr); ierr = VecSet(user->lUcont_rm1, 0.0); CHKERRQ(ierr);
1423 ierr = DMCreateLocalVector(user->da, &user->lNvert_o); CHKERRQ(ierr); ierr = VecSet(user->lNvert_o, 0.0); CHKERRQ(ierr);
1424 ierr = VecDuplicate(user->Nvert, &user->Nvert_o); CHKERRQ(ierr); ierr = VecSet(user->Nvert_o, 0.0); CHKERRQ(ierr);
1425 }
1426
1427 // --- Group D: Grid Metrics (Face-Centered) ---
1428 ierr = DMCreateGlobalVector(user->fda, &user->Csi); CHKERRQ(ierr); ierr = VecSet(user->Csi, 0.0); CHKERRQ(ierr);
1429 ierr = VecDuplicate(user->Csi, &user->Eta); CHKERRQ(ierr); ierr = VecSet(user->Eta, 0.0); CHKERRQ(ierr);
1430 ierr = VecDuplicate(user->Csi, &user->Zet); CHKERRQ(ierr); ierr = VecSet(user->Zet, 0.0); CHKERRQ(ierr);
1431 ierr = DMCreateGlobalVector(user->da, &user->Aj); CHKERRQ(ierr); ierr = VecSet(user->Aj, 0.0); CHKERRQ(ierr);
1432
1433 ierr = DMCreateLocalVector(user->fda, &user->lCsi); CHKERRQ(ierr); ierr = VecSet(user->lCsi, 0.0); CHKERRQ(ierr);
1434 ierr = VecDuplicate(user->lCsi, &user->lEta); CHKERRQ(ierr); ierr = VecSet(user->lEta, 0.0); CHKERRQ(ierr);
1435 ierr = VecDuplicate(user->lCsi, &user->lZet); CHKERRQ(ierr); ierr = VecSet(user->lZet, 0.0); CHKERRQ(ierr);
1436 ierr = DMCreateLocalVector(user->da, &user->lAj); CHKERRQ(ierr); ierr = VecSet(user->lAj, 0.0); CHKERRQ(ierr);
1437
1438
1439 // --- Group E: Grid Metrics (Face-Centered) ---
1440 // Vector metrics are duplicated from Csi (DOF=3, fda-based)
1441 ierr = VecDuplicate(user->Csi, &user->ICsi); CHKERRQ(ierr); ierr = VecSet(user->ICsi, 0.0); CHKERRQ(ierr);
1442 ierr = VecDuplicate(user->Csi, &user->IEta); CHKERRQ(ierr); ierr = VecSet(user->IEta, 0.0); CHKERRQ(ierr);
1443 ierr = VecDuplicate(user->Csi, &user->IZet); CHKERRQ(ierr); ierr = VecSet(user->IZet, 0.0); CHKERRQ(ierr);
1444 ierr = VecDuplicate(user->Csi, &user->JCsi); CHKERRQ(ierr); ierr = VecSet(user->JCsi, 0.0); CHKERRQ(ierr);
1445 ierr = VecDuplicate(user->Csi, &user->JEta); CHKERRQ(ierr); ierr = VecSet(user->JEta, 0.0); CHKERRQ(ierr);
1446 ierr = VecDuplicate(user->Csi, &user->JZet); CHKERRQ(ierr); ierr = VecSet(user->JZet, 0.0); CHKERRQ(ierr);
1447 ierr = VecDuplicate(user->Csi, &user->KCsi); CHKERRQ(ierr); ierr = VecSet(user->KCsi, 0.0); CHKERRQ(ierr);
1448 ierr = VecDuplicate(user->Csi, &user->KEta); CHKERRQ(ierr); ierr = VecSet(user->KEta, 0.0); CHKERRQ(ierr);
1449 ierr = VecDuplicate(user->Csi, &user->KZet); CHKERRQ(ierr); ierr = VecSet(user->KZet, 0.0); CHKERRQ(ierr);
1450 // Scalar metrics are duplicated from Aj (DOF=1, da-based)
1451 ierr = VecDuplicate(user->Aj, &user->IAj); CHKERRQ(ierr); ierr = VecSet(user->IAj, 0.0); CHKERRQ(ierr);
1452 ierr = VecDuplicate(user->Aj, &user->JAj); CHKERRQ(ierr); ierr = VecSet(user->JAj, 0.0); CHKERRQ(ierr);
1453 ierr = VecDuplicate(user->Aj, &user->KAj); CHKERRQ(ierr); ierr = VecSet(user->KAj, 0.0); CHKERRQ(ierr);
1454
1455 ierr = VecDuplicate(user->lCsi, &user->lICsi); CHKERRQ(ierr); ierr = VecSet(user->lICsi, 0.0); CHKERRQ(ierr);
1456 ierr = VecDuplicate(user->lCsi, &user->lIEta); CHKERRQ(ierr); ierr = VecSet(user->lIEta, 0.0); CHKERRQ(ierr);
1457 ierr = VecDuplicate(user->lCsi, &user->lIZet); CHKERRQ(ierr); ierr = VecSet(user->lIZet, 0.0); CHKERRQ(ierr);
1458 ierr = VecDuplicate(user->lCsi, &user->lJCsi); CHKERRQ(ierr); ierr = VecSet(user->lJCsi, 0.0); CHKERRQ(ierr);
1459 ierr = VecDuplicate(user->lCsi, &user->lJEta); CHKERRQ(ierr); ierr = VecSet(user->lJEta, 0.0); CHKERRQ(ierr);
1460 ierr = VecDuplicate(user->lCsi, &user->lJZet); CHKERRQ(ierr); ierr = VecSet(user->lJZet, 0.0); CHKERRQ(ierr);
1461 ierr = VecDuplicate(user->lCsi, &user->lKCsi); CHKERRQ(ierr); ierr = VecSet(user->lKCsi, 0.0); CHKERRQ(ierr);
1462 ierr = VecDuplicate(user->lCsi, &user->lKEta); CHKERRQ(ierr); ierr = VecSet(user->lKEta, 0.0); CHKERRQ(ierr);
1463 ierr = VecDuplicate(user->lCsi, &user->lKZet); CHKERRQ(ierr); ierr = VecSet(user->lKZet, 0.0); CHKERRQ(ierr);
1464
1465 ierr = VecDuplicate(user->lAj, &user->lIAj); CHKERRQ(ierr); ierr = VecSet(user->lIAj, 0.0); CHKERRQ(ierr);
1466 ierr = VecDuplicate(user->lAj, &user->lJAj); CHKERRQ(ierr); ierr = VecSet(user->lJAj, 0.0); CHKERRQ(ierr);
1467 ierr = VecDuplicate(user->lAj, &user->lKAj); CHKERRQ(ierr); ierr = VecSet(user->lKAj, 0.0); CHKERRQ(ierr);
1468
1469 // --- Group F: Cell/Face Center Coordinates and Grid Spacing ---
1470 ierr = DMCreateGlobalVector(user->fda, &user->Cent); CHKERRQ(ierr); ierr = VecSet(user->Cent, 0.0); CHKERRQ(ierr);
1471 ierr = DMCreateLocalVector(user->fda, &user->lCent); CHKERRQ(ierr); ierr = VecSet(user->lCent, 0.0); CHKERRQ(ierr);
1472
1473 ierr = VecDuplicate(user->Cent, &user->GridSpace); CHKERRQ(ierr); ierr = VecSet(user->GridSpace, 0.0); CHKERRQ(ierr);
1474 ierr = VecDuplicate(user->lCent, &user->lGridSpace); CHKERRQ(ierr); ierr = VecSet(user->lGridSpace, 0.0); CHKERRQ(ierr);
1475
1476 ierr = VecDuplicate(user->Cent, &user->Centx); CHKERRQ(ierr); ierr = VecSet(user->Centx, 0.0); CHKERRQ(ierr);
1477 ierr = VecDuplicate(user->Cent, &user->Centy); CHKERRQ(ierr); ierr = VecSet(user->Centy, 0.0); CHKERRQ(ierr);
1478 ierr = VecDuplicate(user->Cent, &user->Centz); CHKERRQ(ierr); ierr = VecSet(user->Centz, 0.0); CHKERRQ(ierr);
1479 ierr = VecDuplicate(user->lCent, &user->lCentx); CHKERRQ(ierr); ierr = VecSet(user->lCentx, 0.0); CHKERRQ(ierr);
1480 ierr = VecDuplicate(user->lCent, &user->lCenty); CHKERRQ(ierr); ierr = VecSet(user->lCenty, 0.0); CHKERRQ(ierr);
1481 ierr = VecDuplicate(user->lCent, &user->lCentz); CHKERRQ(ierr); ierr = VecSet(user->lCentz, 0.0); CHKERRQ(ierr);
1482
1483 if(level == usermg->mglevels -1){
1484 // --- Group G: Turbulence Models (Finest Level Only) ---
1485 if (simCtx->les || simCtx->rans) {
1486 ierr = DMCreateGlobalVector(user->da, &user->Nu_t); CHKERRQ(ierr); ierr = VecSet(user->Nu_t, 0.0); CHKERRQ(ierr);
1487 ierr = DMCreateLocalVector(user->da, &user->lNu_t); CHKERRQ(ierr); ierr = VecSet(user->lNu_t, 0.0); CHKERRQ(ierr);
1488 LOG_ALLOW(GLOBAL, LOG_DEBUG, "Turbulence viscosity (Nu_t) vectors created for LES/RANS model.\n");
1489 if(simCtx->les){
1490 ierr = DMCreateGlobalVector(user->da,&user->CS); CHKERRQ(ierr); ierr = VecSet(user->CS,0.0); CHKERRQ(ierr);
1491 ierr = DMCreateLocalVector(user->da,&user->lCs); CHKERRQ(ierr); ierr = VecSet(user->lCs,0.0); CHKERRQ(ierr);
1492 LOG_ALLOW(GLOBAL, LOG_DEBUG, "Smagorinsky constant (CS) vectors created for LES model.\n");
1493 }
1494
1495 if(simCtx->wallfunction){
1496 ierr = DMCreateLocalVector(user->fda,&user->lFriction_Velocity); CHKERRQ(ierr); ierr = VecSet(user->lFriction_Velocity,0.0);
1497 }
1498 // Add K_Omega etc. here as needed
1499
1500 // Note: Add any other vectors from the legacy MG_Initial here as needed.
1501 // For example: Rhs, Forcing, turbulence Vecs (K_Omega, Nu_t)...
1502
1503 }
1504 // --- Group H: Particle Methods
1505 if(simCtx->np>0){
1506 ierr = DMCreateGlobalVector(user->da,&user->ParticleCount); CHKERRQ(ierr); ierr = VecSet(user->ParticleCount,0.0); CHKERRQ(ierr);
1507 ierr = DMCreateLocalVector(user->da,&user->lParticleCount); CHKERRQ(ierr); ierr = VecSet(user->lParticleCount,0.0); CHKERRQ(ierr);
1508 // Scalar field to hold particle scalar property (e.g., temperature, concentration)
1509 ierr = DMCreateGlobalVector(user->da,&user->Psi); CHKERRQ(ierr); ierr = VecSet(user->Psi,0.0); CHKERRQ(ierr);
1510 ierr = DMCreateLocalVector(user->da,&user->lPsi); CHKERRQ(ierr); ierr = VecSet(user->lPsi,0.0); CHKERRQ(ierr);
1511 LOG_ALLOW(GLOBAL,LOG_DEBUG,"ParticleCount & Scalar(Psi) created for %d particles.\n",simCtx->np);
1512 }
1513 }
1514 // --- Group I: Boundary Condition vectors ---
1515 ierr = DMCreateGlobalVector(user->fda, &user->Bcs.Ubcs); CHKERRQ(ierr);
1516 ierr = VecSet(user->Bcs.Ubcs, 0.0); CHKERRQ(ierr);
1517 ierr = DMCreateGlobalVector(user->fda, &user->Bcs.Uch); CHKERRQ(ierr);
1518 ierr = VecSet(user->Bcs.Uch, 0.0); CHKERRQ(ierr);
1519
1520 if(level == usermg->mglevels - 1){
1521 if(simCtx->exec_mode == EXEC_MODE_POSTPROCESSOR){
1522 LOG_ALLOW(LOCAL, LOG_DEBUG, "Post-processor mode detected. Allocating derived field vectors.\n");
1523
1524 ierr = VecDuplicate(user->P, &user->P_nodal); CHKERRQ(ierr);
1525 ierr = VecSet(user->P_nodal, 0.0); CHKERRQ(ierr);
1526
1527 ierr = VecDuplicate(user->Ucat, &user->Ucat_nodal); CHKERRQ(ierr);
1528 ierr = VecSet(user->Ucat_nodal, 0.0); CHKERRQ(ierr);
1529
1530 ierr = VecDuplicate(user->P, &user->Qcrit); CHKERRQ(ierr);
1531 ierr = VecSet(user->Qcrit, 0.0); CHKERRQ(ierr);
1532
1533 LOG_ALLOW(LOCAL, LOG_DEBUG, "Derived field vectors P_nodal, Ucat_nodal, and Qcrit created.\n");
1534
1535 if(simCtx->np>0){
1536 ierr = VecDuplicate(user->Psi, &user->Psi_nodal); CHKERRQ(ierr);
1537 ierr = VecSet(user->Psi_nodal, 0.0); CHKERRQ(ierr);
1538
1539 LOG_ALLOW(LOCAL, LOG_DEBUG, "Derived field vector Psi_nodal created for particle scalar property.\n");
1540
1541 }
1542 }else{
1543 user->P_nodal = NULL;
1544 user->Ucat_nodal = NULL;
1545 user->Qcrit = NULL;
1546 user->Psi_nodal = NULL;
1547 }
1548 }
1549
1550 }
1551}
1552
1553 LOG_ALLOW(GLOBAL, LOG_INFO, "All simulation vectors created and initialized.\n");
1554
1555 PROFILE_FUNCTION_END;
1556 PetscFunctionReturn(0);
1557}

1559#undef __FUNCT__
1560#define __FUNCT__ "RepairPeriodicNormalFaceGhosts"
1561/**
1562 * @brief Repairs the adjacent normal ghost layer for periodic face-staggered data.
1563 *
1564 * PETSc wraps every component with cell-style indexing. A face family instead
1565 * needs its adjacent normal ghost shifted by one additional physical face. With
1566 * the width-three periodic DMDA, the required value is available in the deeper
1567 * PETSc ghost at -3 or n+2. Tangential ghosts retain PETSc's native wraparound.
1568 */
1569static PetscErrorCode RepairPeriodicNormalFaceGhosts(UserCtx *user, DM dm, Vec local_vec,
1570 PetscInt dof, char face_direction,
1571 PetscBool component_staggered)
1572{
1573 DMDALocalInfo info;
1574 PetscInt xs, xe, ys, ye, zs, ze;
1575 PetscInt gxs, gxe, gys, gye, gzs, gze;
1576 PetscInt mx, my, mz;
1577
1578 PetscFunctionBeginUser;
1579 if (!face_direction && !component_staggered) PetscFunctionReturn(0);
1580
1581 PetscCall(DMDAGetLocalInfo(dm, &info));
1582 xs = info.xs; xe = info.xs + info.xm;
1583 ys = info.ys; ye = info.ys + info.ym;
1584 zs = info.zs; ze = info.zs + info.zm;
1585 gxs = info.gxs; gxe = info.gxs + info.gxm;
1586 gys = info.gys; gye = info.gys + info.gym;
1587 gzs = info.gzs; gze = info.gzs + info.gzm;
1588 mx = info.mx; my = info.my; mz = info.mz;
1589
1590 if (component_staggered) {
1591 Cmpnts ***array;
1592 PetscCall(DMDAVecGetArray(dm, local_vec, &array));
1593
1594 if (user->boundary_faces[BC_FACE_NEG_X].mathematical_type == PERIODIC && xs == 0) {
1595 PetscCheck(gxs <= -3, PETSC_COMM_SELF, PETSC_ERR_ARG_SIZ,
1596 "Periodic Ucont.x ghost repair requires DMDA stencil width at least 3.");
1597 for (PetscInt k = gzs; k < gze; k++) for (PetscInt j = gys; j < gye; j++)
1598 array[k][j][-1].x = array[k][j][-3].x;
1599 }
1600 if (user->boundary_faces[BC_FACE_POS_X].mathematical_type == PERIODIC && xe == mx) {
1601 PetscCheck(gxe > mx + 2, PETSC_COMM_SELF, PETSC_ERR_ARG_SIZ,
1602 "Periodic Ucont.x ghost repair requires DMDA stencil width at least 3.");
1603 for (PetscInt k = gzs; k < gze; k++) for (PetscInt j = gys; j < gye; j++)
1604 array[k][j][mx].x = array[k][j][mx + 2].x;
1605 }
1606 if (user->boundary_faces[BC_FACE_NEG_Y].mathematical_type == PERIODIC && ys == 0) {
1607 PetscCheck(gys <= -3, PETSC_COMM_SELF, PETSC_ERR_ARG_SIZ,
1608 "Periodic Ucont.y ghost repair requires DMDA stencil width at least 3.");
1609 for (PetscInt k = gzs; k < gze; k++) for (PetscInt i = gxs; i < gxe; i++)
1610 array[k][-1][i].y = array[k][-3][i].y;
1611 }
1612 if (user->boundary_faces[BC_FACE_POS_Y].mathematical_type == PERIODIC && ye == my) {
1613 PetscCheck(gye > my + 2, PETSC_COMM_SELF, PETSC_ERR_ARG_SIZ,
1614 "Periodic Ucont.y ghost repair requires DMDA stencil width at least 3.");
1615 for (PetscInt k = gzs; k < gze; k++) for (PetscInt i = gxs; i < gxe; i++)
1616 array[k][my][i].y = array[k][my + 2][i].y;
1617 }
1618 if (user->boundary_faces[BC_FACE_NEG_Z].mathematical_type == PERIODIC && zs == 0) {
1619 PetscCheck(gzs <= -3, PETSC_COMM_SELF, PETSC_ERR_ARG_SIZ,
1620 "Periodic Ucont.z ghost repair requires DMDA stencil width at least 3.");
1621 for (PetscInt j = gys; j < gye; j++) for (PetscInt i = gxs; i < gxe; i++)
1622 array[-1][j][i].z = array[-3][j][i].z;
1623 }
1624 if (user->boundary_faces[BC_FACE_POS_Z].mathematical_type == PERIODIC && ze == mz) {
1625 PetscCheck(gze > mz + 2, PETSC_COMM_SELF, PETSC_ERR_ARG_SIZ,
1626 "Periodic Ucont.z ghost repair requires DMDA stencil width at least 3.");
1627 for (PetscInt j = gys; j < gye; j++) for (PetscInt i = gxs; i < gxe; i++)
1628 array[mz][j][i].z = array[mz + 2][j][i].z;
1629 }
1630
1631 PetscCall(DMDAVecRestoreArray(dm, local_vec, &array));
1632 PetscFunctionReturn(0);
1633 }
1634
1635 if (dof == 1) {
1636 PetscReal ***array;
1637 PetscCall(DMDAVecGetArray(dm, local_vec, &array));
1638
1639 if (face_direction == 'i') {
1640 if (user->boundary_faces[BC_FACE_NEG_X].mathematical_type == PERIODIC && xs == 0) {
1641 PetscCheck(gxs <= -3, PETSC_COMM_SELF, PETSC_ERR_ARG_SIZ,
1642 "Periodic I-face ghost repair requires DMDA stencil width at least 3.");
1643 for (PetscInt k = gzs; k < gze; k++) for (PetscInt j = gys; j < gye; j++)
1644 array[k][j][-1] = array[k][j][-3];
1645 }
1646 if (user->boundary_faces[BC_FACE_POS_X].mathematical_type == PERIODIC && xe == mx) {
1647 PetscCheck(gxe > mx + 2, PETSC_COMM_SELF, PETSC_ERR_ARG_SIZ,
1648 "Periodic I-face ghost repair requires DMDA stencil width at least 3.");
1649 for (PetscInt k = gzs; k < gze; k++) for (PetscInt j = gys; j < gye; j++)
1650 array[k][j][mx] = array[k][j][mx + 2];
1651 }
1652 } else if (face_direction == 'j') {
1653 if (user->boundary_faces[BC_FACE_NEG_Y].mathematical_type == PERIODIC && ys == 0) {
1654 PetscCheck(gys <= -3, PETSC_COMM_SELF, PETSC_ERR_ARG_SIZ,
1655 "Periodic J-face ghost repair requires DMDA stencil width at least 3.");
1656 for (PetscInt k = gzs; k < gze; k++) for (PetscInt i = gxs; i < gxe; i++)
1657 array[k][-1][i] = array[k][-3][i];
1658 }
1659 if (user->boundary_faces[BC_FACE_POS_Y].mathematical_type == PERIODIC && ye == my) {
1660 PetscCheck(gye > my + 2, PETSC_COMM_SELF, PETSC_ERR_ARG_SIZ,
1661 "Periodic J-face ghost repair requires DMDA stencil width at least 3.");
1662 for (PetscInt k = gzs; k < gze; k++) for (PetscInt i = gxs; i < gxe; i++)
1663 array[k][my][i] = array[k][my + 2][i];
1664 }
1665 } else if (face_direction == 'k') {
1666 if (user->boundary_faces[BC_FACE_NEG_Z].mathematical_type == PERIODIC && zs == 0) {
1667 PetscCheck(gzs <= -3, PETSC_COMM_SELF, PETSC_ERR_ARG_SIZ,
1668 "Periodic K-face ghost repair requires DMDA stencil width at least 3.");
1669 for (PetscInt j = gys; j < gye; j++) for (PetscInt i = gxs; i < gxe; i++)
1670 array[-1][j][i] = array[-3][j][i];
1671 }
1672 if (user->boundary_faces[BC_FACE_POS_Z].mathematical_type == PERIODIC && ze == mz) {
1673 PetscCheck(gze > mz + 2, PETSC_COMM_SELF, PETSC_ERR_ARG_SIZ,
1674 "Periodic K-face ghost repair requires DMDA stencil width at least 3.");
1675 for (PetscInt j = gys; j < gye; j++) for (PetscInt i = gxs; i < gxe; i++)
1676 array[mz][j][i] = array[mz + 2][j][i];
1677 }
1678 }
1679
1680 PetscCall(DMDAVecRestoreArray(dm, local_vec, &array));
1681 } else {
1682 Cmpnts ***array;
1683 PetscCall(DMDAVecGetArray(dm, local_vec, &array));
1684
1685 if (face_direction == 'i') {
1686 if (user->boundary_faces[BC_FACE_NEG_X].mathematical_type == PERIODIC && xs == 0) {
1687 PetscCheck(gxs <= -3, PETSC_COMM_SELF, PETSC_ERR_ARG_SIZ,
1688 "Periodic I-face ghost repair requires DMDA stencil width at least 3.");
1689 for (PetscInt k = gzs; k < gze; k++) for (PetscInt j = gys; j < gye; j++)
1690 array[k][j][-1] = array[k][j][-3];
1691 }
1692 if (user->boundary_faces[BC_FACE_POS_X].mathematical_type == PERIODIC && xe == mx) {
1693 PetscCheck(gxe > mx + 2, PETSC_COMM_SELF, PETSC_ERR_ARG_SIZ,
1694 "Periodic I-face ghost repair requires DMDA stencil width at least 3.");
1695 for (PetscInt k = gzs; k < gze; k++) for (PetscInt j = gys; j < gye; j++)
1696 array[k][j][mx] = array[k][j][mx + 2];
1697 }
1698 } else if (face_direction == 'j') {
1699 if (user->boundary_faces[BC_FACE_NEG_Y].mathematical_type == PERIODIC && ys == 0) {
1700 PetscCheck(gys <= -3, PETSC_COMM_SELF, PETSC_ERR_ARG_SIZ,
1701 "Periodic J-face ghost repair requires DMDA stencil width at least 3.");
1702 for (PetscInt k = gzs; k < gze; k++) for (PetscInt i = gxs; i < gxe; i++)
1703 array[k][-1][i] = array[k][-3][i];
1704 }
1705 if (user->boundary_faces[BC_FACE_POS_Y].mathematical_type == PERIODIC && ye == my) {
1706 PetscCheck(gye > my + 2, PETSC_COMM_SELF, PETSC_ERR_ARG_SIZ,
1707 "Periodic J-face ghost repair requires DMDA stencil width at least 3.");
1708 for (PetscInt k = gzs; k < gze; k++) for (PetscInt i = gxs; i < gxe; i++)
1709 array[k][my][i] = array[k][my + 2][i];
1710 }
1711 } else if (face_direction == 'k') {
1712 if (user->boundary_faces[BC_FACE_NEG_Z].mathematical_type == PERIODIC && zs == 0) {
1713 PetscCheck(gzs <= -3, PETSC_COMM_SELF, PETSC_ERR_ARG_SIZ,
1714 "Periodic K-face ghost repair requires DMDA stencil width at least 3.");
1715 for (PetscInt j = gys; j < gye; j++) for (PetscInt i = gxs; i < gxe; i++)
1716 array[-1][j][i] = array[-3][j][i];
1717 }
1718 if (user->boundary_faces[BC_FACE_POS_Z].mathematical_type == PERIODIC && ze == mz) {
1719 PetscCheck(gze > mz + 2, PETSC_COMM_SELF, PETSC_ERR_ARG_SIZ,
1720 "Periodic K-face ghost repair requires DMDA stencil width at least 3.");
1721 for (PetscInt j = gys; j < gye; j++) for (PetscInt i = gxs; i < gxe; i++)
1722 array[mz][j][i] = array[mz + 2][j][i];
1723 }
1724 }
1725
1726 PetscCall(DMDAVecRestoreArray(dm, local_vec, &array));
1727 }
1728
1729 PetscFunctionReturn(0);
1730}
