1732#undef __FUNCT__
1733#define __FUNCT__ "UpdateLocalGhosts"
1734/**
1735 * @brief Internal helper implementation: `UpdateLocalGhosts()`.
1736 * @details Local to this translation unit.
1737 */
1738PetscErrorCode UpdateLocalGhosts(UserCtx* user, const char *fieldName)
1739{
1740 PetscErrorCode ierr;
1741 PetscMPIInt rank;
1742 Vec globalVec = NULL;
1743 Vec localVec = NULL;
1744 DM dm = NULL; // The DM associated with this field pair
1745 PetscInt dof = 0;
1746 char face_direction = '\0';
1747 PetscBool component_staggered = PETSC_FALSE;
1748
1749 PetscFunctionBeginUser; // Use User version for application code
1750 PROFILE_FUNCTION_BEGIN;
1751 ierr = MPI_Comm_rank(PETSC_COMM_WORLD, &rank); CHKERRQ(ierr);
1752 LOG_ALLOW(GLOBAL, LOG_INFO, "Rank %d: Starting ghost update for field '%s'.\n", rank, fieldName);
1753
1754 // --- 1. Identify the correct Vectors and DM ---
1755 if (strcmp(fieldName, "Coordinates") == 0) {
1756 ierr = DMGetCoordinates(user->da, &globalVec); CHKERRQ(ierr);
1757 ierr = DMGetCoordinatesLocal(user->da, &localVec); CHKERRQ(ierr);
1758 dm = user->fda;
1759 dof = 3;
1760 } else if (strcmp(fieldName, "Ucat") == 0) {
1761 globalVec = user->Ucat;
1762 localVec = user->lUcat;
1763 dm = user->fda;
1764 dof = 3;
1765 } else if (strcmp(fieldName, "Ucont") == 0) {
1766 globalVec = user->Ucont;
1767 localVec = user->lUcont;
1768 dm = user->fda;
1769 dof = 3;
1770 component_staggered = PETSC_TRUE;
1771 } else if (strcmp(fieldName, "Ucont_o") == 0) {
1772 globalVec = user->Ucont_o;
1773 localVec = user->lUcont_o;
1774 dm = user->fda;
1775 dof = 3;
1776 component_staggered = PETSC_TRUE;
1777 } else if (strcmp(fieldName, "Ucont_rm1") == 0) {
1778 globalVec = user->Ucont_rm1;
1779 localVec = user->lUcont_rm1;
1780 dm = user->fda;
1781 dof = 3;
1782 component_staggered = PETSC_TRUE;
1783 } else if (strcmp(fieldName, "P") == 0) {
1784 globalVec = user->P;
1785 localVec = user->lP;
1786 dm = user->da;
1787 } else if (strcmp(fieldName, "Nu_t") == 0 || strcmp(fieldName, "Eddy Viscosity") == 0) {
1788 globalVec = user->Nu_t;
1789 localVec = user->lNu_t;
1790 dm = user->da;
1791 } else if (strcmp(fieldName, "CS") == 0 || strcmp(fieldName, "Cs") == 0) {
1792 globalVec = user->CS;
1793 localVec = user->lCs;
1794 dm = user->da;
1795 } else if (strcmp(fieldName, "Diffusivity") == 0) {
1796 globalVec = user->Diffusivity;
1797 localVec = user->lDiffusivity;
1798 dm = user->da;
1799 } else if (strcmp(fieldName, "DiffusivityGradient") == 0) {
1800 globalVec = user->DiffusivityGradient;
1801 localVec = user->lDiffusivityGradient;
1802 dm = user->fda;
1803 } else if (strcmp(fieldName, "Csi") == 0) {
1804 globalVec = user->Csi;
1805 localVec = user->lCsi;
1806 dm = user->fda;
1807 dof = 3;
1808 face_direction = 'i';
1809 } else if (strcmp(fieldName, "Eta") == 0) {
1810 globalVec = user->Eta;
1811 localVec = user->lEta;
1812 dm = user->fda;
1813 dof = 3;
1814 face_direction = 'j';
1815 } else if (strcmp(fieldName, "Zet") == 0) {
1816 globalVec = user->Zet;
1817 localVec = user->lZet;
1818 dm = user->fda;
1819 dof = 3;
1820 face_direction = 'k';
1821 }else if (strcmp(fieldName, "Nvert") == 0) {
1822 globalVec = user->Nvert;
1823 localVec = user->lNvert;
1824 dm = user->da;
1825 // Add other fields as needed
1826 } else if (strcmp(fieldName, "Aj") == 0) {
1827 globalVec = user->Aj;
1828 localVec = user->lAj;
1829 dm = user->da;
1830 } else if (strcmp(fieldName, "Cent") == 0) {
1831 globalVec = user->Cent;
1832 localVec = user->lCent;
1833 dm = user->fda;
1834 }else if (strcmp(fieldName, "GridSpace") == 0) {
1835 globalVec = user->GridSpace;
1836 localVec = user->lGridSpace;
1837 dm = user->fda;
1838 }else if (strcmp(fieldName, "Centx") == 0) {
1839 globalVec = user->Centx;
1840 localVec = user->lCentx;
1841 dm = user->fda;
1842 dof = 3;
1843 face_direction = 'i';
1844 }else if (strcmp(fieldName, "Centy") == 0) {
1845 globalVec = user->Centy;
1846 localVec = user->lCenty;
1847 dm = user->fda;
1848 dof = 3;
1849 face_direction = 'j';
1850 }else if (strcmp(fieldName, "Centz") == 0) {
1851 globalVec = user->Centz;
1852 localVec = user->lCentz;
1853 dm = user->fda;
1854 dof = 3;
1855 face_direction = 'k';
1856 }else if (strcmp(fieldName,"ICsi") == 0){
1857 globalVec = user->ICsi;
1858 localVec = user->lICsi;
1859 dm = user->fda;
1860 dof = 3;
1861 face_direction = 'i';
1862 }else if (strcmp(fieldName,"IEta") == 0){
1863 globalVec = user->IEta;
1864 localVec = user->lIEta;
1865 dm = user->fda;
1866 dof = 3;
1867 face_direction = 'i';
1868 }else if (strcmp(fieldName,"IZet") == 0){
1869 globalVec = user->IZet;
1870 localVec = user->lIZet;
1871 dm = user->fda;
1872 dof = 3;
1873 face_direction = 'i';
1874 }else if (strcmp(fieldName,"JCsi") == 0){
1875 globalVec = user->JCsi;
1876 localVec = user->lJCsi;
1877 dm = user->fda;
1878 dof = 3;
1879 face_direction = 'j';
1880 }else if (strcmp(fieldName,"JEta") == 0){
1881 globalVec = user->JEta;
1882 localVec = user->lJEta;
1883 dm = user->fda;
1884 dof = 3;
1885 face_direction = 'j';
1886 }else if (strcmp(fieldName,"JZet") == 0){
1887 globalVec = user->JZet;
1888 localVec = user->lJZet;
1889 dm = user->fda;
1890 dof = 3;
1891 face_direction = 'j';
1892 }else if (strcmp(fieldName,"KCsi") == 0){
1893 globalVec = user->KCsi;
1894 localVec = user->lKCsi;
1895 dm = user->fda;
1896 dof = 3;
1897 face_direction = 'k';
1898 }else if (strcmp(fieldName,"KEta") == 0){
1899 globalVec = user->KEta;
1900 localVec = user->lKEta;
1901 dm = user->fda;
1902 dof = 3;
1903 face_direction = 'k';
1904 }else if (strcmp(fieldName,"KZet") == 0){
1905 globalVec = user->KZet;
1906 localVec = user->lKZet;
1907 dm = user->fda;
1908 dof = 3;
1909 face_direction = 'k';
1910 }else if (strcmp(fieldName,"IAj") == 0){
1911 globalVec = user->IAj;
1912 localVec = user->lIAj;
1913 dm = user->da;
1914 dof = 1;
1915 face_direction = 'i';
1916 }else if (strcmp(fieldName,"JAj") == 0){
1917 globalVec = user->JAj;
1918 localVec = user->lJAj;
1919 dm = user->da;
1920 dof = 1;
1921 face_direction = 'j';
1922 }else if (strcmp(fieldName,"KAj") == 0){
1923 globalVec = user->KAj;
1924 localVec = user->lKAj;
1925 dm = user->da;
1926 dof = 1;
1927 face_direction = 'k';
1928 }else if (strcmp(fieldName,"Phi") == 0){ // Pressure correction term.
1929 globalVec = user->Phi;
1930 localVec = user->lPhi;
1931 dm = user->da;
1932 }else if (strcmp(fieldName,"Psi") == 0){ // Particle scalar property.
1933 globalVec = user->Psi;
1934 localVec = user->lPsi;
1935 dm = user->da;
1936 }else if (strcmp(fieldName,"Nvert_o") == 0){
1937 globalVec = user->Nvert_o;
1938 localVec = user->lNvert_o;
1939 dm = user->da;
1940 }else if (strcmp(fieldName,"ParticleCount") == 0){
1941 globalVec = user->ParticleCount;
1942 localVec = user->lParticleCount;
1943 dm = user->da;
1944 }else if (strcmp(fieldName,"K_Omega") == 0){
1945 globalVec = user->K_Omega;
1946 localVec = user->lK_Omega;
1947 dm = user->fda2;
1948 }else if (strcmp(fieldName,"K_Omega_o") == 0){
1949 globalVec = user->K_Omega_o;
1950 localVec = user->lK_Omega_o;
1951 dm = user->fda2;
1952 }else {
1953 SETERRQ(PETSC_COMM_SELF, PETSC_ERR_ARG_UNKNOWN_TYPE, "Field '%s' not recognized for ghost update.", fieldName);
1954 }
1955
1956 // --- 2. Check if components were found ---
1957 if (!globalVec) {
1958 SETERRQ(PETSC_COMM_SELF, PETSC_ERR_ARG_WRONGSTATE, "Global vector for field '%s' is NULL.", fieldName);
1959 }
1960 if (!localVec) {
1961 SETERRQ(PETSC_COMM_SELF, PETSC_ERR_ARG_WRONGSTATE, "Local vector for field '%s' is NULL.", fieldName);
1962 }
1963 if (!dm) {
1964 SETERRQ(PETSC_COMM_SELF, PETSC_ERR_ARG_WRONGSTATE, "DM for field '%s' is NULL.", fieldName);
1965 }
1966
1967 LOG_ALLOW(LOCAL, LOG_DEBUG, "Rank %d: Identified components for '%s': DM=%p, GlobalVec=%p, LocalVec=%p.\n",
1968 rank, fieldName, (void*)dm, (void*)globalVec, (void*)localVec);
1969
1970 // --- 3. Optional Debugging: Norm Before Update ---
1971 // Use your logging convention check
1972 // if (get_log_level() >= LOG_LEVEL_DEBUG && is_function_allowed("UpdateLocalGhosts")) { // Example check
1973 if(get_log_level() == LOG_DEBUG && is_function_allowed(__func__)){
1974 PetscReal norm_global_before;
1975 ierr = VecNorm(globalVec, NORM_INFINITY, &norm_global_before); CHKERRQ(ierr);
1976 LOG_ALLOW(GLOBAL, LOG_INFO,"Max norm '%s' (Global) BEFORE Ghost Update: %g\n", fieldName, norm_global_before);
1977 // Optional: Norm of local vector before update (might contain old ghost values)
1978 // PetscReal norm_local_before;
1979 // ierr = VecNorm(localVec, NORM_INFINITY, &norm_local_before); CHKERRQ(ierr);
1980 // LOG_ALLOW(GLOBAL, LOG_DEBUG,"Max norm '%s' (Local) BEFORE Ghost Update: %g\n", fieldName, norm_local_before);
1981 }
1982
1983 // --- 4. Perform the Global-to-Local Transfer (Ghost Update) ---
1984 LOG_ALLOW(LOCAL, LOG_DEBUG, "Rank %d: Calling DMGlobalToLocalBegin/End for '%s'.\n", rank, fieldName);
1985 ierr = DMGlobalToLocalBegin(dm, globalVec, INSERT_VALUES, localVec); CHKERRQ(ierr);
1986 ierr = DMGlobalToLocalEnd(dm, globalVec, INSERT_VALUES, localVec); CHKERRQ(ierr);
1987 ierr = RepairPeriodicNormalFaceGhosts(user, dm, localVec, dof, face_direction,
1988 component_staggered); CHKERRQ(ierr);
1989 LOG_ALLOW(LOCAL, LOG_DEBUG, "Rank %d: Completed DMGlobalToLocalBegin/End for '%s'.\n", rank, fieldName);
1990
1991 // --- 5. Optional Debugging: Norm After Update ---
1992 // Use your logging convention check
1993 // if (get_log_level() >= LOG_LEVEL_DEBUG && is_function_allowed("UpdateLocalGhosts")) { // Example check
1994 if(get_log_level() == LOG_DEBUG && is_function_allowed(__func__)){ // Using your specific check
1995 PetscReal norm_local_after;
1996 ierr = VecNorm(localVec, NORM_INFINITY, &norm_local_after); CHKERRQ(ierr);
1997 LOG_ALLOW(GLOBAL, LOG_INFO,"Max norm '%s' (Local) AFTER Ghost Update: %g\n", fieldName, norm_local_after);
1998
1999 // --- 6. Optional Debugging: Specific Point Checks (Example for Ucat on Rank 0/1) ---
2000 // (Keep this conditional if it's only for specific debug scenarios)
2001 if (strcmp(fieldName, "Ucat") == 0) { // Only do detailed checks for Ucat for now
2002 PetscMPIInt rank_test;
2003 MPI_Comm_rank(PETSC_COMM_WORLD, &rank_test);
2004
2005 // Get Local Info needed for indexing checks
2006 DMDALocalInfo info_check;
2007 ierr = DMDAGetLocalInfo(dm, &info_check); CHKERRQ(ierr); // Use the correct dm
2008
2009 // Buffer for array pointer
2010 Cmpnts ***lUcat_arr_test = NULL;
2011 PetscErrorCode ierr_test = 0;
2012
2013 LOG_ALLOW(LOCAL, LOG_DEBUG, "Rank %d: Testing '%s' access immediately after ghost update...\n", rank_test, fieldName);
2014 ierr_test = DMDAVecGetArrayDOFRead(dm, localVec, &lUcat_arr_test); // Use correct dm and localVec
2015
2016 if (ierr_test) {
2017 LOG_ALLOW(LOCAL, LOG_ERROR, "Rank %d: ERROR %d getting '%s' array after ghost update!\n", rank_test, ierr_test, fieldName);
2018 } else if (!lUcat_arr_test) {
2019 LOG_ALLOW(LOCAL, LOG_ERROR, "Rank %d: ERROR NULL pointer getting '%s' array after ghost update!\n", rank_test, fieldName);
2020 }
2021 else {
2022 // Check owned interior point (e.g., first interior point)
2023 PetscInt k_int = info_check.zs + (info_check.zm > 1 ? 1 : 0); // Global k index (at least zs+1 if possible)
2024 PetscInt j_int = info_check.ys + (info_check.ym > 1 ? 1 : 0); // Global j index
2025 PetscInt i_int = info_check.xs + (info_check.xm > 1 ? 1 : 0); // Global i index
2026 // Ensure indices are within global bounds if domain is very small
2027 //if (k_int >= info_check.mz-1) k_int = info_check.mz-2; if (k_int < 1) k_int = 1;
2028 //if (j_int >= info_check.my-1) j_int = info_check.my-2; if (j_int < 1) j_int = 1;
2029 // if (i_int >= info_check.mx-1) i_int = info_check.mx-2; if (i_int < 1) i_int = 1;
2030 // clamp k_int to [1 .. mz-2]
2031 if (k_int >= info_check.mz - 1) {
2032 k_int = info_check.mz - 2;
2033 }
2034 if (k_int < 1) {
2035 k_int = 1;
2036 }
2037
2038 // clamp j_int to [1 .. my-2]
2039 if (j_int >= info_check.my - 1) {
2040 j_int = info_check.my - 2;
2041 }
2042 if (j_int < 1) {
2043 j_int = 1;
2044 }
2045
2046 // clamp i_int to [1 .. mx-2]
2047 if (i_int >= info_check.mx - 1) {
2048 i_int = info_check.mx - 2;
2049 }
2050 if (i_int < 1) {
2051 i_int = 1;
2052 }
2053
2054 // Only attempt read if indices are actually owned (relevant for multi-rank)
2055 if (k_int >= info_check.zs && k_int < info_check.zs + info_check.zm &&
2056 j_int >= info_check.ys && j_int < info_check.ys + info_check.ym &&
2057 i_int >= info_check.xs && i_int < info_check.xs + info_check.xm)
2058 {
2059 LOG_ALLOW(LOCAL, LOG_DEBUG, "Rank %d: Attempting test read OWNED INTERIOR [%d][%d][%d] (Global)\n", rank_test, k_int, j_int, i_int);
2060 Cmpnts test_val_owned_interior = lUcat_arr_test[k_int][j_int][i_int];
2061 LOG_ALLOW(LOCAL, LOG_DEBUG, "Rank %d: SUCCESS reading owned interior: x=%g\n", rank_test, test_val_owned_interior.x);
2062 } else {
2063 LOG_ALLOW(LOCAL, LOG_DEBUG, "Rank %d: Skipping interior test read for non-owned index [%d][%d][%d].\n", rank_test, k_int, j_int, i_int);
2064 }
2065
2066
2067 // Check owned boundary point (e.g., first owned point)
2068 PetscInt k_bnd = info_check.zs; // Global k index
2069 PetscInt j_bnd = info_check.ys; // Global j index
2070 PetscInt i_bnd = info_check.xs; // Global i index
2071 LOG_ALLOW(LOCAL, LOG_DEBUG, "Rank %d: Attempting test read OWNED BOUNDARY [%d][%d][%d] (Global)\n", rank_test, k_bnd, j_bnd, i_bnd);
2072 Cmpnts test_val_owned_boundary = lUcat_arr_test[k_bnd][j_bnd][i_bnd];
2073 LOG_ALLOW(LOCAL, LOG_DEBUG, "Rank %d: SUCCESS reading owned boundary: x=%g\n", rank_test, test_val_owned_boundary.x);
2074
2075
2076 // Check ghost point (e.g., one layer below in k, if applicable)
2077 if (info_check.zs > 0) { // Only if there's a rank below
2078 PetscInt k_ghost = info_check.zs - 1;
2079 PetscInt j_ghost = info_check.ys; // Use start of owned y, simple example
2080 PetscInt i_ghost = info_check.xs; // Use start of owned x, simple example
2081 LOG_ALLOW(LOCAL, LOG_DEBUG, "Rank %d: Attempting test read GHOST [%d][%d][%d] (Global)\n", rank_test, k_ghost, j_ghost, i_ghost);
2082 Cmpnts test_val_ghost = lUcat_arr_test[k_ghost][j_ghost][i_ghost];
2083 LOG_ALLOW(LOCAL, LOG_DEBUG, "Rank %d: SUCCESS reading ghost: x=%g\n", rank_test, test_val_ghost.x);
2084 } else {
2085 LOG_ALLOW(LOCAL, LOG_DEBUG, "Rank %d: Skipping ghost test read (zs=0).\n", rank_test);
2086 }
2087
2088 // Restore the array
2089 ierr_test = DMDAVecRestoreArrayDOFRead(dm, localVec, &lUcat_arr_test);
2090 if(ierr_test){ LOG_ALLOW(LOCAL, LOG_ERROR, "Rank %d: ERROR %d restoring '%s' array after test read!\n", rank_test, ierr_test, fieldName); }
2091 LOG_ALLOW(LOCAL, LOG_DEBUG, "Rank %d: Finished testing '%s' access.\n", rank_test, fieldName);
2092 }
2093 } // end if Ucat
2094 } // end debug logging check
2095
2096 LOG_ALLOW(GLOBAL, LOG_INFO, "Rank %d: Completed ghost update for field '%s'.\n", rank, fieldName);
2097 PROFILE_FUNCTION_END;
2098 PetscFunctionReturn(0);
2099}

2101#undef __FUNCT__
2102#define __FUNCT__ "SetupBoundaryConditions"
2103/**
2104 * @brief Internal helper implementation: `SetupBoundaryConditions()`.
2105 * @details Local to this translation unit.
2106 */
2107PetscErrorCode SetupBoundaryConditions(SimCtx *simCtx)
2108{
2109 PetscErrorCode ierr;
2110 PetscFunctionBeginUser;
2111
2112 PROFILE_FUNCTION_BEGIN;
2113
2114 LOG_ALLOW(GLOBAL,LOG_INFO, "--- Setting up Boundary Conditions ---\n");
2115 // --- Phase 1: Parse and initialize BC configuration for all blocks ---
2116 LOG_ALLOW(GLOBAL,LOG_INFO,"Parsing BC configuration files and initializing boundary condition data structures.\n");
2117 UserCtx *user_finest = simCtx->usermg.mgctx[simCtx->usermg.mglevels-1].user;
2118 for (PetscInt bi = 0; bi < simCtx->block_number; bi++) {
2119 LOG_ALLOW(GLOBAL,LOG_DEBUG, " -> Processing Block %d:\n", bi);
2120
2121 // --- Generate the filename for the current block ---
2122 const char *current_bc_filename = simCtx->bcs_files[bi];
2123 LOG_ALLOW(GLOBAL,LOG_DEBUG," -> Processing Block %d using config file '%s'\n", bi, current_bc_filename);
2124 // This will populate user_finest[bi].boundary_faces
2125
2126 //ierr = ParseAllBoundaryConditions(&user_finest[bi],current_bc_filename); CHKERRQ(ierr);
2127
2128 ierr = BoundarySystem_Initialize(&user_finest[bi], current_bc_filename); CHKERRQ(ierr);
2129 }
2130
2131 // Propogate BC Configuration to coarser levels.
2132 ierr = PropagateBoundaryConfigToCoarserLevels(simCtx); CHKERRQ(ierr);
2133
2134 // Validate the geometric contract before any metric consumes periodic geometry.
2135 for (PetscInt level = simCtx->usermg.mglevels - 1; level >= 0; level--) {
2136 UserCtx *level_users = simCtx->usermg.mgctx[level].user;
2137 for (PetscInt bi = 0; bi < simCtx->block_number; bi++) {
2138 ierr = ValidatePeriodicGeometry(&level_users[bi]); CHKERRQ(ierr);
2139 }
2140 }
2141
2142 // --- Calculate Grid Metrics (requires BC configuration) ---
2143 // NOTE: This MUST be called here (after BC initialization but before inlet/outlet calculations) because:
2144 // 1. Periodic BC corrections in metric calculations need boundary_faces data to be populated
2145 // 2. Inlet/Outlet area calculations (below) require computed metrics (Csi, Eta, Zet) to be available
2146 // Previously this was in SetupGridAndSolvers, but that caused metrics to be computed without BC info.
2147 LOG_ALLOW(GLOBAL,LOG_INFO,"Computing grid metrics with boundary condition information.\n");
2148 ierr = CalculateAllGridMetrics(simCtx); CHKERRQ(ierr);
2149
2150 // --- Phase 2: Calculate inlet/outlet properties (requires computed metrics) ---
2151 LOG_ALLOW(GLOBAL,LOG_INFO,"Calculating inlet and outlet face properties.\n");
2152 for (PetscInt bi = 0; bi < simCtx->block_number; bi++) {
2153 // Call the function to calculate the center of the inlet face & the inlet area, which may be used to calculate Boundary values.
2154 ierr = CalculateInletProperties(&user_finest[bi]); CHKERRQ(ierr);
2155
2156 // Call the function to calculate the center of the outlet face & the outlet area, which may be used to calculate Boundary values.
2157 ierr = CalculateOutletProperties(&user_finest[bi]); CHKERRQ(ierr);
2158 }
2159
2160 LOG_ALLOW(GLOBAL,LOG_INFO, "--- Boundary Conditions setup complete ---\n");
2161
2162
2163 PROFILE_FUNCTION_END;
2164 PetscFunctionReturn(0);
2165}

2167/**
2168 * @brief Internal helper implementation: `Allocate3DArrayScalar()`.
2169 * @details Local to this translation unit.
2170 */
2171PetscErrorCode Allocate3DArrayScalar(PetscReal ****array, PetscInt nz, PetscInt ny, PetscInt nx)
2172{
2173 PetscErrorCode ierr;
2174 PetscReal ***data;
2175 PetscReal *dataContiguous;
2176 PetscInt k, j;
2177
2178 PetscFunctionBegin;
2179 /* Step 1: Allocate memory for an array of nz layer pointers (zero-initialized) */
2180 ierr = PetscCalloc1(nz, &data); CHKERRQ(ierr);
2181
2182 /* Step 2: Allocate memory for all row pointers (nz * ny pointers) */
2183 ierr = PetscCalloc1(nz * ny, &data[0]); CHKERRQ(ierr);
2184 for (k = 1; k < nz; k++) {
2185 data[k] = data[0] + k * ny;
2186 }
2187
2188 /* Step 3: Allocate one contiguous block for all data elements (nz*ny*nx) */
2189 ierr = PetscCalloc1(nz * ny * nx, &dataContiguous); CHKERRQ(ierr);
2190
2191 /* Build the 3D pointer structure: each row pointer gets the correct segment of data */
2192 for (k = 0; k < nz; k++) {
2193 for (j = 0; j < ny; j++) {
2194 data[k][j] = dataContiguous + (k * ny + j) * nx;
2195 /* Memory is already zeroed by PetscCalloc1, so no manual initialization is needed */
2196 }
2197 }
2198 *array = data;
2199 PetscFunctionReturn(0);
2200}
2201
2202/**
2203 * @brief Internal helper implementation: `Deallocate3DArrayScalar()`.
2204 * @details Local to this translation unit.
2205 */
2206PetscErrorCode Deallocate3DArrayScalar(PetscReal ***array, PetscInt nz, PetscInt ny)
2207{
2208 PetscErrorCode ierr;
2209 (void)nz;
2210 (void)ny;
2211
2212 PetscFunctionBegin;
2213 if (!array || !array[0] || !array[0][0] ) { // Added more robust check
2214 LOG_ALLOW(GLOBAL, LOG_WARNING, "Deallocate3DArrayScalar called with potentially unallocated or NULL array.\n");
2215 if (array) {
2216 if (array[0]) { // Check if row pointers might exist
2217 // Cannot safely access array[0][0] if array[0] might be invalid/freed
2218 // Standard deallocation below assumes valid pointers.
2219 ierr = PetscFree(array[0]); CHKERRQ(ierr); // Free row pointers if they exist
2220 }
2221 ierr = PetscFree(array); CHKERRQ(ierr); // Free layer pointers if they exist
2222 }
2223 PetscFunctionReturn(0);
2224 }
2225
2226 // --- Standard Deallocation (assuming valid allocation) ---
2227
2228 /* 1. Free the contiguous block of PetscReal values.
2229 The starting address was stored in array[0][0]. */
2230 ierr = PetscFree(array[0][0]); CHKERRQ(ierr); // Free the ACTUAL DATA
2231
2232 /* 2. Free the contiguous block of row pointers.
2233 The starting address was stored in array[0]. */
2234 ierr = PetscFree(array[0]); CHKERRQ(ierr); // Free the ROW POINTERS
2235
2236 /* 3. Free the layer pointer array.
2237 The starting address is 'array' itself. */
2238 ierr = PetscFree(array); CHKERRQ(ierr); // Free the LAYER POINTERS
2239
2240 PetscFunctionReturn(0);
2241}

2243/**
2244 * @brief Implementation of \ref Allocate3DArrayVector().
2245 * @details Full API contract (arguments, ownership, side effects) is documented with
2246 * the header declaration in `include/setup.h`.
2247 * @see Allocate3DArrayVector()
2248 */
2249PetscErrorCode Allocate3DArrayVector(Cmpnts ****array, PetscInt nz, PetscInt ny, PetscInt nx)
2250{
2251 PetscErrorCode ierr;
2252 Cmpnts ***data;
2253 Cmpnts *dataContiguous;
2254 PetscInt k, j;
2255 PetscMPIInt rank;
2256
2257 PetscFunctionBegin;
2258
2259 ierr = MPI_Comm_rank(PETSC_COMM_WORLD,&rank);
2260
2261 /* Step 1: Allocate memory for nz layer pointers (zeroed) */
2262 ierr = PetscCalloc1(nz, &data); CHKERRQ(ierr);
2263
2264 LOG_ALLOW(LOCAL,LOG_DEBUG," [Rank %d] memory allocated for outermost layer (%d k-layer pointers).\n",rank,nz);
2265
2266 /* Step 2: Allocate memory for all row pointers (nz * ny pointers) */
2267 ierr = PetscCalloc1(nz * ny, &data[0]); CHKERRQ(ierr);
2268 for (k = 1; k < nz; k++) {
2269 data[k] = data[0] + k * ny;
2270 }
2271
2272 LOG_ALLOW(LOCAL,LOG_DEBUG,"[Rank %d] memory allocated for %dx%d row pointers.\n",rank,nz,ny);
2273
2274 /* Step 3: Allocate one contiguous block for nz*ny*nx Cmpnts structures (zeroed) */
2275 ierr = PetscCalloc1(nz * ny * nx, &dataContiguous); CHKERRQ(ierr);
2276
2277 LOG_ALLOW(GLOBAL,LOG_DEBUG,"[Rank %d] memory allocated for contigous block of %dx%dx%d Cmpnts structures).\n",rank,nz,ny,nx);
2278
2279 /* Build the 3D pointer structure for vector data */
2280 for (k = 0; k < nz; k++) {
2281 for (j = 0; j < ny; j++) {
2282 data[k][j] = dataContiguous + (k * ny + j) * nx;
2283 /* The PetscCalloc1 call has already initialized each Cmpnts to zero. */
2284 }
2285 }
2286
2287 LOG_ALLOW(GLOBAL,LOG_DEBUG,"[Rank %d] 3D pointer structure for vector data created. \n",rank);
2288
2289 *array = data;
2290 PetscFunctionReturn(0);
2291}

2293/**
2294 * @brief Implementation of \ref Deallocate3DArrayVector().
2295 * @details Full API contract (arguments, ownership, side effects) is documented with
2296 * the header declaration in `include/setup.h`.
2297 * @see Deallocate3DArrayVector()
2298 */
2299 PetscErrorCode Deallocate3DArrayVector(Cmpnts ***array, PetscInt nz, PetscInt ny)
2300{
2301 PetscErrorCode ierr;
2302 (void)nz;
2303 (void)ny;
2304
2305 PetscFunctionBegin;
2306 // If array is NULL or hasn't been allocated properly, just return.
2307 if (!array || !array[0] || !array[0][0] ) {
2308 LOG_ALLOW(GLOBAL, LOG_WARNING, "Deallocate3DArrayVector called with potentially unallocated or NULL array.\n");
2309 // Attempt to free what might exist, but be cautious
2310 if (array) {
2311 if (array[0]) { // Check if row pointers were allocated
2312 // We don't have a direct pointer to the contiguous data block
2313 // saved separately in this allocation scheme. The allocation relies
2314 // on array[0][0] pointing to it. If array[0] was freed first,
2315 // accessing array[0][0] is unsafe.
2316 // The allocation scheme where the contiguous data block is not
2317 // stored separately makes safe deallocation tricky if freeing
2318 // happens out of order or if parts are NULL.
2319
2320 // A SAFER ALLOCATION/DEALLOCATION would store the data pointer separately.
2321 // Given the current allocation scheme, the order MUST be:
2322 // 1. Free the data block (pointed to by array[0][0])
2323 // 2. Free the row pointer block (pointed to by array[0])
2324 // 3. Free the layer pointer block (pointed to by array)
2325
2326 // Let's assume the allocation was successful and pointers are valid.
2327 // Get pointer to the contiguous data block *before* freeing row pointers
2328 Cmpnts *dataContiguous = array[0][0];
2329 ierr = PetscFree(dataContiguous); CHKERRQ(ierr); // Free data block
2330
2331 // Now free the row pointers block
2332 ierr = PetscFree(array[0]); CHKERRQ(ierr); // Free row pointers
2333
2334 }
2335 // Finally, free the array of layer pointers
2336 ierr = PetscFree(array); CHKERRQ(ierr);
2337 }
2338 PetscFunctionReturn(0); // Return gracefully if input was NULL initially
2339 }
2340
2341
2342 // --- Standard Deallocation (assuming valid allocation) ---
2343
2344 /* 1. Free the contiguous block of Cmpnts structures.
2345 The starting address was stored in array[0][0] by Allocate3DArrayVector. */
2346 ierr = PetscFree(array[0][0]); CHKERRQ(ierr); // Free the ACTUAL DATA
2347
2348 /* 2. Free the contiguous block of row pointers.
2349 The starting address was stored in array[0]. */
2350 ierr = PetscFree(array[0]); CHKERRQ(ierr); // Free the ROW POINTERS
2351
2352 /* 3. Free the layer pointer array.
2353 The starting address is 'array' itself. */
2354 ierr = PetscFree(array); CHKERRQ(ierr); // Free the LAYER POINTERS
2355
2356 PetscFunctionReturn(0);
2357}

2359#undef __FUNCT__
2360#define __FUNCT__ "GetOwnedCellRange"
2361/**
2362 * @brief Internal helper implementation: `GetOwnedCellRange()`.
2363 * @details Local to this translation unit.
2364 */
2365PetscErrorCode GetOwnedCellRange(const DMDALocalInfo *info_nodes,
2366 PetscInt dim,
2367 PetscInt *xs_cell_global_out,
2368 PetscInt *xm_cell_local_out)
2369{
2370 PetscErrorCode ierr = 0; // Standard PETSc error code, not explicitly set here but good practice.
2371 PetscInt xs_node_global_rank; // Global index of the first node owned by this rank in the specified dimension.
2372 PetscInt num_nodes_owned_rank; // Number of nodes owned by this rank in this dimension (local count, excluding ghosts).
2373 PetscInt GlobalNodesInDim_from_info; // Total number of DA points in this dimension, from DMDALocalInfo.
2374
2375 PetscFunctionBeginUser;
2376
2377 // --- 1. Input Validation ---
2378 if (!info_nodes || !xs_cell_global_out || !xm_cell_local_out) {
2379 SETERRQ(PETSC_COMM_SELF, PETSC_ERR_ARG_NULL, "Null pointer passed to GetOwnedCellRange.");
2380 }
2381
2382 // --- 2. Extract Node Ownership and Global Dimension Information from DMDALocalInfo ---
2383 if (dim == 0) { // I-direction
2384 xs_node_global_rank = info_nodes->xs;
2385 num_nodes_owned_rank = info_nodes->xm;
2386 GlobalNodesInDim_from_info = info_nodes->mx;
2387 } else if (dim == 1) { // J-direction
2388 xs_node_global_rank = info_nodes->ys;
2389 num_nodes_owned_rank = info_nodes->ym;
2390 GlobalNodesInDim_from_info = info_nodes->my;
2391 } else if (dim == 2) { // K-direction
2392 xs_node_global_rank = info_nodes->zs;
2393 num_nodes_owned_rank = info_nodes->zm;
2394 GlobalNodesInDim_from_info = info_nodes->mz;
2395 } else {
2396 SETERRQ(PETSC_COMM_SELF, PETSC_ERR_ARG_OUTOFRANGE, "Invalid dimension %d in GetOwnedCellRange. Must be 0, 1, or 2.", dim);
2397 }
2398
2399 // --- 3. Correct for User-Defined Ghost Node ---
2400 // Per the function's contract (@warning), the DA size includes an extra, non-physical
2401 // node. We subtract 1 to get the true number of physical nodes for cell calculations.
2402 const PetscInt physical_nodes_in_dim = GlobalNodesInDim_from_info - 1;
2403
2404 // --- 4. Handle Edge Cases for Physical Domain Size ---
2405 // If the physical domain has 0 or 1 node, no cells can be formed.
2406 if (physical_nodes_in_dim <= 1) {
2407 *xs_cell_global_out = xs_node_global_rank; // Still report the rank's starting node
2408 *xm_cell_local_out = 0; // But 0 cells
2409 PetscFunctionReturn(0);
2410 }
2411
2412 // --- 5. Determine Cell Ownership Based on Corrected Node Ownership ---
2413 // The first cell this rank *could* define has its origin at the first node this rank owns.
2414 *xs_cell_global_out = xs_node_global_rank;
2415
2416 // If the rank owns no nodes in this dimension, it can't form any cell origins.
2417 if (num_nodes_owned_rank == 0) {
2418 *xm_cell_local_out = 0;
2419 } else {
2420 // --- BUG FIX APPLIED HERE ---
2421 // The previous logic incorrectly assumed a cell's end node (N_{k+1}) must be on the
2422 // same rank as its origin node (N_k). The correct logic is to find the intersection
2423 // between the nodes this rank owns and the nodes that are valid origins globally.
2424
2425 // The first node owned by the rank is its first potential origin.
2426 PetscInt first_owned_origin = xs_node_global_rank;
2427
2428 // The absolute last node owned by this rank. Any node up to and including this one
2429 // is a potential cell origin from this rank's perspective.
2430 PetscInt last_node_owned_by_rank = xs_node_global_rank + num_nodes_owned_rank - 1;
2431
2432 // The absolute last node in the entire PHYSICAL domain that can serve as a cell origin.
2433 // If there are `N` physical nodes (0 to N-1), this index is `N-2`.
2434 PetscInt last_possible_origin_global_idx = physical_nodes_in_dim - 2;
2435
2436 // The actual last origin this rank can provide is the *minimum* of what it owns
2437 // and what is globally possible. This correctly handles both ranks in the middle of
2438 // the domain and the very last rank.
2439 PetscInt actual_last_origin_this_rank_can_form = PetscMin(last_node_owned_by_rank, last_possible_origin_global_idx);
2440
2441 // If the first potential origin this rank owns is already beyond the actual last
2442 // origin it can form, then this rank forms no valid cell origins. This happens if
2443 // the rank only owns the very last physical node.
2444 if (first_owned_origin > actual_last_origin_this_rank_can_form) {
2445 *xm_cell_local_out = 0;
2446 } else {
2447 // The number of cells is the count of valid origins this rank owns.
2448 // (Count = Last Index - First Index + 1)
2449 *xm_cell_local_out = actual_last_origin_this_rank_can_form - first_owned_origin + 1;
2450 }
2451 }
2452
2453 PetscFunctionReturn(ierr);
2454}
2455
2456#undef __FUNCT__
2457#define __FUNCT__ "ComputeAndStoreNeighborRanks"
2458/**
2459 * @brief Internal helper implementation: `ComputeAndStoreNeighborRanks()`.
2460 * @details Local to this translation unit.
2461 */
2462PetscErrorCode ComputeAndStoreNeighborRanks(UserCtx *user)
2463{
2464 PetscErrorCode ierr;
2465 PetscMPIInt rank;
2466 PetscMPIInt size; // MPI communicator size
2467 const PetscMPIInt *neighbor_ranks_ptr; // Pointer to raw neighbor data from PETSc
2468
2469 PetscFunctionBeginUser;
2470 PROFILE_FUNCTION_BEGIN;
2471 ierr = MPI_Comm_rank(PETSC_COMM_WORLD, &rank); CHKERRQ(ierr);
2472 ierr = MPI_Comm_size(PETSC_COMM_WORLD, &size); CHKERRQ(ierr); // Get MPI size for validation
2473
2474 LOG_ALLOW(GLOBAL, LOG_INFO, "Rank %d: Computing DMDA neighbor ranks.\n", rank);
2475
2476 if (!user || !user->da) {
2477 SETERRQ(PETSC_COMM_SELF, PETSC_ERR_ARG_NULL, "UserCtx or user->da is NULL in ComputeAndStoreNeighborRanks.");
2478 }
2479
2480 // Get the neighbor information from the DMDA
2481 // neighbor_ranks_ptr will point to an internal PETSc array of 27 ranks.
2482 ierr = DMDAGetNeighbors(user->da, &neighbor_ranks_ptr); CHKERRQ(ierr);
2483
2484 // Log the raw values from DMDAGetNeighbors for boundary-relevant directions for debugging
2485 LOG_ALLOW_SYNC(GLOBAL, LOG_DEBUG, "[Rank %d]Raw DMDAGetNeighbors: xm_raw=%d, xp_raw=%d, ym_raw=%d, yp_raw=%d, zm_raw=%d, zp_raw=%d. MPI_PROC_NULL is %d.\n",
2486 rank,
2487 neighbor_ranks_ptr[12], neighbor_ranks_ptr[14],
2488 neighbor_ranks_ptr[10], neighbor_ranks_ptr[16],
2489 neighbor_ranks_ptr[4], neighbor_ranks_ptr[22],
2490 (int)MPI_PROC_NULL);
2491
2492 // PETSc standard indices for 3D face neighbors from the 27-point stencil:
2493 // Index = k_offset*9 + j_offset*3 + i_offset (where offsets -1,0,1 map to 0,1,2)
2494 // Center: (i_off=1, j_off=1, k_off=1) => 1*9 + 1*3 + 1 = 13
2495 // X-min: (i_off=0, j_off=1, k_off=1) => 1*9 + 1*3 + 0 = 12
2496 // X-plus: (i_off=2, j_off=1, k_off=1) => 1*9 + 1*3 + 2 = 14
2497 // Y-min: (i_off=1, j_off=0, k_off=1) => 1*9 + 0*3 + 1 = 10
2498 // Y-plus: (i_off=1, j_off=2, k_off=1) => 1*9 + 2*3 + 1 = 16
2499 // Z-min: (i_off=1, j_off=1, k_off=0) => 0*9 + 1*3 + 1 = 4
2500 // Z-plus: (i_off=1, j_off=1, k_off=2) => 2*9 + 1*3 + 1 = 22
2501
2502 if (neighbor_ranks_ptr[13] != rank) {
2503 LOG_ALLOW(GLOBAL, LOG_WARNING, "Rank %d: DMDAGetNeighbors center index (13) is %d, expected current rank %d. Neighbor indexing might be non-standard or DMDA small.\n",
2504 rank, neighbor_ranks_ptr[13], rank);
2505 // This warning is important. If the center isn't the current rank, the offsets are likely wrong.
2506 // However, PETSc should ensure this unless the DM is too small for a 3x3x3 stencil.
2507 }
2508
2509 // Assign and sanitize each neighbor rank
2510 PetscMPIInt temp_neighbor;
2511
2512 temp_neighbor = neighbor_ranks_ptr[12]; // xm
2513 if (temp_neighbor < 0 || temp_neighbor >= size) {
2514 LOG_ALLOW(GLOBAL, LOG_WARNING, "[Rank %d] Correcting invalid xm neighbor %d to MPI_PROC_NULL (%d).\n", rank, temp_neighbor, (int)MPI_PROC_NULL);
2515 user->neighbors.rank_xm = MPI_PROC_NULL;
2516 } else {
2517 user->neighbors.rank_xm = temp_neighbor;
2518 }
2519
2520 temp_neighbor = neighbor_ranks_ptr[14]; // xp
2521 if (temp_neighbor < 0 || temp_neighbor >= size) {
2522 LOG_ALLOW(GLOBAL, LOG_WARNING, "[Rank %d] Correcting invalid xp neighbor %d to MPI_PROC_NULL (%d).\n", rank, temp_neighbor, (int)MPI_PROC_NULL);
2523 user->neighbors.rank_xp = MPI_PROC_NULL;
2524 } else {
2525 user->neighbors.rank_xp = temp_neighbor;
2526 }
2527
2528 temp_neighbor = neighbor_ranks_ptr[10]; // ym
2529 if (temp_neighbor < 0 || temp_neighbor >= size) {
2530 LOG_ALLOW(GLOBAL, LOG_WARNING, "[Rank %d] Correcting invalid ym neighbor %d to MPI_PROC_NULL (%d).\n", rank, temp_neighbor, (int)MPI_PROC_NULL);
2531 user->neighbors.rank_ym = MPI_PROC_NULL;
2532 } else {
2533 user->neighbors.rank_ym = temp_neighbor;
2534 }
2535
2536 temp_neighbor = neighbor_ranks_ptr[16]; // yp
2537 if (temp_neighbor < 0 || temp_neighbor >= size) {
2538 // The log for index 16 was "zm" in your output, should be yp
2539 LOG_ALLOW(GLOBAL, LOG_WARNING, "[Rank %d] Correcting invalid yp neighbor (raw index 16) %d to MPI_PROC_NULL (%d).\n", rank, temp_neighbor, (int)MPI_PROC_NULL);
2540 user->neighbors.rank_yp = MPI_PROC_NULL;
2541 } else {
2542 user->neighbors.rank_yp = temp_neighbor;
2543 }
2544
2545 temp_neighbor = neighbor_ranks_ptr[4]; // zm
2546 if (temp_neighbor < 0 || temp_neighbor >= size) {
2547 LOG_ALLOW(GLOBAL, LOG_WARNING, "[Rank %d] Correcting invalid zm neighbor %d to MPI_PROC_NULL (%d).\n", rank, temp_neighbor, (int)MPI_PROC_NULL);
2548 user->neighbors.rank_zm = MPI_PROC_NULL;
2549 } else {
2550 user->neighbors.rank_zm = temp_neighbor;
2551 }
2552
2553 temp_neighbor = neighbor_ranks_ptr[22]; // zp
2554 if (temp_neighbor < 0 || temp_neighbor >= size) {
2555 LOG_ALLOW(GLOBAL, LOG_WARNING, "[Rank %d] Correcting invalid zp neighbor %d to MPI_PROC_NULL (%d).\n", rank, temp_neighbor, (int)MPI_PROC_NULL);
2556 user->neighbors.rank_zp = MPI_PROC_NULL;
2557 } else {
2558 user->neighbors.rank_zp = temp_neighbor;
2559 }
2560
2561 LOG_ALLOW_SYNC(GLOBAL, LOG_DEBUG, "[Rank %d] Stored user->neighbors: xm=%d, xp=%d, ym=%d, yp=%d, zm=%d, zp=%d\n", rank,
2562 user->neighbors.rank_xm, user->neighbors.rank_xp,
2563 user->neighbors.rank_ym, user->neighbors.rank_yp,
2564 user->neighbors.rank_zm, user->neighbors.rank_zp);
2565 PetscSynchronizedFlush(PETSC_COMM_WORLD, PETSC_STDOUT); // Ensure logs are flushed
2566
2567 // Note: neighbor_ranks_ptr memory is managed by PETSc, do not free it.
2568 PROFILE_FUNCTION_END;
2569 PetscFunctionReturn(0);
2570}
2571
2572#undef __FUNCT__
2573#define __FUNCT__ "SetDMDAProcLayout"
2574/**
2575 * @brief Internal helper implementation: `SetDMDAProcLayout()`.
2576 * @details Local to this translation unit.
2577 */
2578PetscErrorCode SetDMDAProcLayout(DM dm, UserCtx *user)
2579{
2580 PetscErrorCode ierr;
2581 PetscMPIInt size, rank;
2582 PetscInt px = PETSC_DECIDE, py = PETSC_DECIDE, pz = PETSC_DECIDE;
2583 PetscBool px_set = PETSC_FALSE, py_set = PETSC_FALSE, pz_set = PETSC_FALSE;
2584 SimCtx *simCtx = user->simCtx;
2585
2586 // Set no.of processors in direction 1
2587 if(simCtx->da_procs_x) {
2588 px_set = PETSC_TRUE;
2589 px = simCtx->da_procs_x;
2590 }
2591 // Set no.of processors in direction 2
2592 if(simCtx->da_procs_y) {
2593 py_set = PETSC_TRUE;
2594 py = simCtx->da_procs_y;
2595 }
2596 // Set no.of processors in direction 1
2597 if(simCtx->da_procs_z) {
2598 pz_set = PETSC_TRUE;
2599 pz = simCtx->da_procs_z;
2600 }
2601
2602 PetscFunctionBeginUser;
2603 PROFILE_FUNCTION_BEGIN;
2604 ierr = MPI_Comm_size(PetscObjectComm((PetscObject)dm), &size); CHKERRQ(ierr);
2605 ierr = MPI_Comm_rank(PetscObjectComm((PetscObject)dm), &rank); CHKERRQ(ierr);
2606 LOG_ALLOW(GLOBAL, LOG_INFO, "Rank %d: Configuring DMDA processor layout for %d total processes.\n", rank, size);
2607
2608 // --- Validate User Input (Optional but Recommended) ---
2609 // Check if specified processor counts multiply to the total MPI size
2610 if (px_set && py_set && pz_set) {
2611 if (px * py * pz != size) {
2612 SETERRQ(PetscObjectComm((PetscObject)dm), PETSC_ERR_ARG_INCOMP,
2613 "Specified processor layout %d x %d x %d = %d does not match MPI size %d",
2614 px, py, pz, px * py * pz, size);
2615 }
2616 LOG_ALLOW(GLOBAL, LOG_INFO, "Using specified processor layout: %d x %d x %d\n", px, py, pz);
2617 } else if (px_set || py_set || pz_set) {
2618 // If only some are set, PETSC_DECIDE will be used for others
2619 LOG_ALLOW(GLOBAL, LOG_INFO, "Using partially specified processor layout: %d x %d x %d (PETSC_DECIDE for unspecified)\n", px, py, pz);
2620 } else {
2621 LOG_ALLOW(GLOBAL, LOG_INFO, "Using fully automatic processor layout (PETSC_DECIDE x PETSC_DECIDE x PETSC_DECIDE)\n");
2622 }
2623 // Additional checks: Ensure px, py, pz are positive if set
2624 if ((px_set && px <= 0) || (py_set && py <= 0) || (pz_set && pz <= 0)) {
2625 SETERRQ(PetscObjectComm((PetscObject)dm), PETSC_ERR_ARG_OUTOFRANGE, "Specified processor counts must be positive.");
2626 }
2627
2628
2629 // --- Apply the layout to the DMDA ---
2630 ierr = DMDASetNumProcs(dm, px, py, pz); CHKERRQ(ierr);
2631 LOG_ALLOW(GLOBAL, LOG_DEBUG, "Rank %d: DMDASetNumProcs called with px=%d, py=%d, pz=%d.\n", rank, px, py, pz);
2632
2633 // --- Store the values in UserCtx (Optional) ---
2634 // Note: If PETSC_DECIDE was used, PETSc calculates the actual values during DMSetUp.
2635 // We store the *requested* values here. To get the *actual* values used,
2636 // you would need to call DMDAGetInfo after DMSetUp.
2637 /*
2638 if (user) {
2639 user->procs_x = px;
2640 user->procs_y = py;
2641 user->procs_z = pz;
2642 }
2643 */
2644 PROFILE_FUNCTION_END;
2645 PetscFunctionReturn(0);
2646}
2647
2648#undef __FUNCT__
2649#define __FUNCT__ "SetupDomainRankInfo"
2650/**
2651 * @brief Implementation of \ref SetupDomainRankInfo().
2652 * @details Full API contract (arguments, ownership, side effects) is documented with
2653 * the header declaration in `include/setup.h`.
2654 * @see SetupDomainRankInfo()
2655 */
2656PetscErrorCode SetupDomainRankInfo(SimCtx *simCtx)
2657{
2658 PetscErrorCode ierr;
2659 PetscInt nblk = simCtx->block_number;
2660 PetscInt size = simCtx->size;
2661 BoundingBox *final_bboxlist = NULL;
2662
2663 PetscFunctionBeginUser;
2664 PROFILE_FUNCTION_BEGIN;
2665
2666 LOG_ALLOW(GLOBAL, LOG_INFO, "Starting full rank communication setup for %d block(s).\n", nblk);
2667
2668 UserCtx *user_finest = simCtx->usermg.mgctx[simCtx->usermg.mglevels - 1].user;
2669
2670 // --- Step 1: Compute neighbor ranks (unchanged) ---
2671 for (int bi = 0; bi < nblk; bi++) {
2672 ierr = ComputeAndStoreNeighborRanks(&user_finest[bi]); CHKERRQ(ierr);
2673 }
2674 LOG_ALLOW(GLOBAL, LOG_INFO, "Neighbor ranks computed and stored for all blocks.\n");
2675
2676 // --- Step 2: Allocate the final, unified list on ALL ranks ---
2677 // Every rank will build this list in parallel.
2678 ierr = PetscMalloc1(size * nblk, &final_bboxlist); CHKERRQ(ierr);
2679
2680 // --- Step 3: Loop through each block, gather then broadcast its bbox list ---
2681 for (int bi = 0; bi < nblk; bi++) {
2682 // This is a temporary pointer for the current block's list.
2683 BoundingBox *block_bboxlist = NULL;
2684
2685 LOG_ALLOW(GLOBAL, LOG_INFO, "Processing bounding boxes for block %d...\n", bi);
2686
2687 // A) GATHER: On rank 0, block_bboxlist is allocated and filled. On others, it's NULL.
2688 ierr = GatherAllBoundingBoxes(&user_finest[bi], &block_bboxlist); CHKERRQ(ierr);
2689 LOG_ALLOW(GLOBAL, LOG_DEBUG, " -> Gather complete for block %d.\n", bi);
2690
2691 // B) BROADCAST: On non-root ranks, block_bboxlist is allocated. Then, the data
2692 // from rank 0 is broadcast to all ranks. After this call, ALL ranks have
2693 // an identical, complete copy of the bounding boxes for the current block.
2694 ierr = BroadcastAllBoundingBoxes(&user_finest[bi], &block_bboxlist); CHKERRQ(ierr);
2695 LOG_ALLOW(GLOBAL, LOG_DEBUG, " -> Broadcast complete for block %d.\n", bi);
2696
2697 // C) ASSEMBLE: Every rank now copies the data for this block into the
2698 // correct segment of its final, unified list.
2699 for (int r = 0; r < size; r++) {
2700 // The layout is [r0b0, r1b0, ..., r(size-1)b0, r0b1, r1b1, ...]
2701 final_bboxlist[bi * size + r] = block_bboxlist[r];
2702 }
2703 LOG_ALLOW(GLOBAL, LOG_DEBUG, " -> Assembly into final list complete for block %d.\n", bi);
2704
2705 // D) CLEANUP: Free the temporary list for this block on ALL ranks before the next iteration.
2706 // Your helper functions use malloc, so we must use free.
2707 free(block_bboxlist);
2708 }
2709
2710 // --- Step 4: Assign the final pointer and run the last setup step ---
2711 simCtx->bboxlist = final_bboxlist;
2712 LOG_ALLOW(GLOBAL, LOG_INFO, "Final unified bboxlist created on all ranks and stored in SimCtx.\n");
2713
2714 ierr = SetupDomainCellDecompositionMap(&user_finest[0]); CHKERRQ(ierr);
2715 LOG_ALLOW(GLOBAL, LOG_INFO, "Domain Cell Composition set and broadcasted.\n");
2716
2717 LOG_ALLOW(GLOBAL, LOG_INFO, "SetupDomainRankInfo: Completed successfully.\n");
2718
2719 PROFILE_FUNCTION_END;
2720 PetscFunctionReturn(0);
2721}
2722
2723#undef __FUNCT__
2724#define __FUNCT__ "Contra2Cart"
2725/**
2726 * @brief Internal helper implementation: `Contra2Cart()`.
2727 * @details Local to this translation unit.
2728 */
2729PetscErrorCode Contra2Cart(UserCtx *user)
2730{
2731 PetscErrorCode ierr;
2732 DMDALocalInfo info;
2733 Cmpnts ***lcsi_arr, ***leta_arr, ***lzet_arr; // Local metric arrays
2734 Cmpnts ***lucont_arr; // Local contravariant velocity array
2735 Cmpnts ***gucat_arr; // Global Cartesian velocity array
2736 PetscReal ***lnvert_arr; // Local Nvert array
2737 PetscReal ***laj_arr; // Local Jacobian Determinant inverse array
2738
2739 PetscFunctionBeginUser;
2740 PROFILE_FUNCTION_BEGIN;
2741 LOG_ALLOW(GLOBAL, LOG_DEBUG, "Starting Contravariant-to-Cartesian velocity transformation.\n");
2742
2743 // --- 1. Get DMDA Info and Check for Valid Inputs ---
2744 // All inputs (lUcont, lCsi, etc.) and outputs (Ucat) are on DMs from the UserCtx.
2745 // We get local info from fda, which governs the layout of most arrays here.
2746 ierr = DMDAGetLocalInfo(user->fda, &info); CHKERRQ(ierr);
2747 if (!user->lUcont || !user->lCsi || !user->lEta || !user->lZet || !user->lNvert || !user->Ucat) {
2748 SETERRQ(PETSC_COMM_SELF, PETSC_ERR_ARG_WRONGSTATE, "Contra2Cart requires lUcont, lCsi/Eta/Zet, lNvert, and Ucat to be non-NULL.");
2749 }
2750
2751
2752 // --- 2. Get Read-Only Array Access to Local Input Vectors (with ghosts) ---
2753 ierr = DMDAVecGetArrayRead(user->fda, user->lUcont, &lucont_arr); CHKERRQ(ierr);
2754 ierr = DMDAVecGetArrayRead(user->fda, user->lCsi, &lcsi_arr); CHKERRQ(ierr);
2755 ierr = DMDAVecGetArrayRead(user->fda, user->lEta, &leta_arr); CHKERRQ(ierr);
2756 ierr = DMDAVecGetArrayRead(user->fda, user->lZet, &lzet_arr); CHKERRQ(ierr);
2757 ierr = DMDAVecGetArrayRead(user->da, user->lNvert, &lnvert_arr); CHKERRQ(ierr);
2758 ierr = DMDAVecGetArrayRead(user->da, user->lAj, &laj_arr); CHKERRQ(ierr);
2759
2760 // --- 3. Get Write-Only Array Access to the Global Output Vector ---
2761 // We compute for local owned cells and write into the global vector.
2762 // PETSc handles mapping the global indices to the correct local memory locations.
2763 ierr = DMDAVecGetArray(user->fda, user->Ucat, &gucat_arr); CHKERRQ(ierr);
2764
2765
2766 // --- 4. Define Loop Bounds for INTERIOR Cells ---
2767 // We use adjusted bounds to avoid calculating Ucat on the physical domain boundaries,
2768 // as these are typically set explicitly by boundary condition functions.
2769 // The stencils use indices like i-1, j-1, k-1, so we must start loops at least at index 1.
2770 PetscInt i_start = (info.xs == 0) ? info.xs + 1 : info.xs;
2771 PetscInt i_end = (info.xs + info.xm == info.mx) ? info.xs + info.xm - 1 : info.xs + info.xm;
2772
2773 PetscInt j_start = (info.ys == 0) ? info.ys + 1 : info.ys;
2774 PetscInt j_end = (info.ys + info.ym == info.my) ? info.ys + info.ym - 1 : info.ys + info.ym;
2775
2776 PetscInt k_start = (info.zs == 0) ? info.zs + 1 : info.zs;
2777 PetscInt k_end = (info.zs + info.zm == info.mz) ? info.zs + info.zm - 1 : info.zs + info.zm;
2778
2779 // --- 5. Main Computation Loop ---
2780 // Loops over the GLOBAL indices of interior cells owned by this rank.
2781 for (PetscInt k_cell = k_start; k_cell < k_end; ++k_cell) {
2782 for (PetscInt j_cell = j_start; j_cell < j_end; ++j_cell) {
2783 for (PetscInt i_cell = i_start; i_cell < i_end; ++i_cell) {
2784
2785 // Check if the cell is a fluid cell (not solid/blanked)
2786 // if (lnvert_arr[k_cell][j_cell][i_cell] > 0.1) continue; // Skip solid/blanked cells
2787
2788 // Transformation matrix [mat] is the metric tensor at the cell center,
2789 // estimated by averaging metrics from adjacent faces.
2790 PetscReal mat[3][3];
2791
2792 // PetscReal aj_center = laj_arr[k_cell+1][j_cell+1][i_cell+1];
2793
2794 mat[0][0] = 0.5 * (lcsi_arr[k_cell][j_cell][i_cell-1].x + lcsi_arr[k_cell][j_cell][i_cell].x); //* aj_center;
2795 mat[0][1] = 0.5 * (lcsi_arr[k_cell][j_cell][i_cell-1].y + lcsi_arr[k_cell][j_cell][i_cell].y); //* aj_center;
2796 mat[0][2] = 0.5 * (lcsi_arr[k_cell][j_cell][i_cell-1].z + lcsi_arr[k_cell][j_cell][i_cell].z); //* aj_center;
2797
2798 mat[1][0] = 0.5 * (leta_arr[k_cell][j_cell-1][i_cell].x + leta_arr[k_cell][j_cell][i_cell].x); //* aj_center;
2799 mat[1][1] = 0.5 * (leta_arr[k_cell][j_cell-1][i_cell].y + leta_arr[k_cell][j_cell][i_cell].y); //* aj_center;
2800 mat[1][2] = 0.5 * (leta_arr[k_cell][j_cell-1][i_cell].z + leta_arr[k_cell][j_cell][i_cell].z); //* aj_center;
2801
2802 mat[2][0] = 0.5 * (lzet_arr[k_cell-1][j_cell][i_cell].x + lzet_arr[k_cell][j_cell][i_cell].x); //* aj_center;
2803 mat[2][1] = 0.5 * (lzet_arr[k_cell-1][j_cell][i_cell].y + lzet_arr[k_cell][j_cell][i_cell].y); //* aj_center;
2804 mat[2][2] = 0.5 * (lzet_arr[k_cell-1][j_cell][i_cell].z + lzet_arr[k_cell][j_cell][i_cell].z); //* aj_center;
2805
2806 // Contravariant velocity vector `q` at the cell center,
2807 // estimated by averaging face-based contravariant velocities.
2808 PetscReal q[3];
2809 q[0] = 0.5 * (lucont_arr[k_cell][j_cell][i_cell-1].x + lucont_arr[k_cell][j_cell][i_cell].x); // U¹ at cell center
2810 q[1] = 0.5 * (lucont_arr[k_cell][j_cell-1][i_cell].y + lucont_arr[k_cell][j_cell][i_cell].y); // U² at cell center
2811 q[2] = 0.5 * (lucont_arr[k_cell-1][j_cell][i_cell].z + lucont_arr[k_cell][j_cell][i_cell].z); // U³ at cell center
2812
2813 // Solve the 3x3 system `mat * ucat = q` using Cramer's rule.
2814 PetscReal det = mat[0][0] * (mat[1][1] * mat[2][2] - mat[1][2] * mat[2][1]) -
2815 mat[0][1] * (mat[1][0] * mat[2][2] - mat[1][2] * mat[2][0]) +
2816 mat[0][2] * (mat[1][0] * mat[2][1] - mat[1][1] * mat[2][0]);
2817
2818 if (PetscAbsReal(det) < 1.0e-18) {
2819 SETERRQ(PETSC_COMM_SELF, PETSC_ERR_FLOP_COUNT, "Transformation matrix determinant is near zero at cell (%d,%d,%d) \n", i_cell, j_cell, k_cell);
2820 }
2821
2822 PetscReal det_inv = 1.0 / det;
2823
2824 PetscReal det0 = q[0] * (mat[1][1] * mat[2][2] - mat[1][2] * mat[2][1]) -
2825 q[1] * (mat[0][1] * mat[2][2] - mat[0][2] * mat[2][1]) +
2826 q[2] * (mat[0][1] * mat[1][2] - mat[0][2] * mat[1][1]);
2827
2828 PetscReal det1 = -q[0] * (mat[1][0] * mat[2][2] - mat[1][2] * mat[2][0]) +
2829 q[1] * (mat[0][0] * mat[2][2] - mat[0][2] * mat[2][0]) -
2830 q[2] * (mat[0][0] * mat[1][2] - mat[0][2] * mat[1][0]);
2831
2832 PetscReal det2 = q[0] * (mat[1][0] * mat[2][1] - mat[1][1] * mat[2][0]) -
2833 q[1] * (mat[0][0] * mat[2][1] - mat[0][1] * mat[2][0]) +
2834 q[2] * (mat[0][0] * mat[1][1] - mat[0][1] * mat[1][0]);
2835
2836 // Store computed Cartesian velocity in the GLOBAL Ucat array at the
2837 // array index corresponding to the cell's origin node.
2838 gucat_arr[k_cell][j_cell][i_cell].x = det0 * det_inv;
2839 gucat_arr[k_cell][j_cell][i_cell].y = det1 * det_inv;
2840 gucat_arr[k_cell][j_cell][i_cell].z = det2 * det_inv;
2841 }
2842 }
2843 }
2844
2845 // --- 6. Restore Array Access ---
2846 ierr = DMDAVecRestoreArrayRead(user->fda, user->lUcont, &lucont_arr); CHKERRQ(ierr);
2847 ierr = DMDAVecRestoreArrayRead(user->fda, user->lCsi, &lcsi_arr); CHKERRQ(ierr);
2848 ierr = DMDAVecRestoreArrayRead(user->fda, user->lEta, &leta_arr); CHKERRQ(ierr);
2849 ierr = DMDAVecRestoreArrayRead(user->fda, user->lZet, &lzet_arr); CHKERRQ(ierr);
2850 ierr = DMDAVecRestoreArrayRead(user->da, user->lNvert, &lnvert_arr); CHKERRQ(ierr);
2851 ierr = DMDAVecRestoreArrayRead(user->da, user->lAj, &laj_arr); CHKERRQ(ierr);
2852 ierr = DMDAVecRestoreArray(user->fda, user->Ucat, &gucat_arr); CHKERRQ(ierr);
2853
2854 LOG_ALLOW(GLOBAL, LOG_INFO, "Completed Contravariant-to-Cartesian velocity transformation. \n");
2855 PROFILE_FUNCTION_END;
2856 PetscFunctionReturn(0);
2857}

2859#undef __FUNCT__
2860#define __FUNCT__ "Cart2Contra"
2861/**
2862 * @brief Convert a spatially varying Cartesian velocity field to contravariant fluxes.
2863 */
2864PetscErrorCode Cart2Contra(UserCtx *user)
2865{
2866 PetscErrorCode ierr;
2867 DMDALocalInfo info;
2868 const Cmpnts ***ucat_arr, ***csi_arr, ***eta_arr, ***zet_arr;
2869 Cmpnts ***ucont_arr;
2870
2871 PetscFunctionBeginUser;
2872 PROFILE_FUNCTION_BEGIN;
2873
2874 ierr = DMDAGetLocalInfo(user->fda, &info); CHKERRQ(ierr);
2875 ierr = DMDAVecGetArrayRead(user->fda, user->lUcat, &ucat_arr); CHKERRQ(ierr);
2876 ierr = DMDAVecGetArrayRead(user->fda, user->lCsi, &csi_arr); CHKERRQ(ierr);
2877 ierr = DMDAVecGetArrayRead(user->fda, user->lEta, &eta_arr); CHKERRQ(ierr);
2878 ierr = DMDAVecGetArrayRead(user->fda, user->lZet, &zet_arr); CHKERRQ(ierr);
2879 ierr = DMDAVecGetArray(user->fda, user->Ucont, &ucont_arr); CHKERRQ(ierr);
2880
2881 const PetscInt i_start = PetscMax(info.xs, 1);
2882 const PetscInt j_start = PetscMax(info.ys, 1);
2883 const PetscInt k_start = PetscMax(info.zs, 1);
2884 const PetscInt i_end = PetscMin(info.xs + info.xm, info.mx - 1);
2885 const PetscInt j_end = PetscMin(info.ys + info.ym, info.my - 1);
2886 const PetscInt k_end = PetscMin(info.zs + info.zm, info.mz - 1);
2887
2888 for (PetscInt k = k_start; k < k_end; k++) {
2889 for (PetscInt j = j_start; j < j_end; j++) {
2890 for (PetscInt i = i_start; i < i_end; i++) {
2891 const Cmpnts u_xi = {
2892 0.5 * (ucat_arr[k][j][i].x + ucat_arr[k][j][i + 1].x),
2893 0.5 * (ucat_arr[k][j][i].y + ucat_arr[k][j][i + 1].y),
2894 0.5 * (ucat_arr[k][j][i].z + ucat_arr[k][j][i + 1].z)
2895 };
2896 const Cmpnts u_eta = {
2897 0.5 * (ucat_arr[k][j][i].x + ucat_arr[k][j + 1][i].x),
2898 0.5 * (ucat_arr[k][j][i].y + ucat_arr[k][j + 1][i].y),
2899 0.5 * (ucat_arr[k][j][i].z + ucat_arr[k][j + 1][i].z)
2900 };
2901 const Cmpnts u_zeta = {
2902 0.5 * (ucat_arr[k][j][i].x + ucat_arr[k + 1][j][i].x),
2903 0.5 * (ucat_arr[k][j][i].y + ucat_arr[k + 1][j][i].y),
2904 0.5 * (ucat_arr[k][j][i].z + ucat_arr[k + 1][j][i].z)
2905 };
2906 ucont_arr[k][j][i].x = csi_arr[k][j][i].x * u_xi.x + csi_arr[k][j][i].y * u_xi.y + csi_arr[k][j][i].z * u_xi.z;
2907 ucont_arr[k][j][i].y = eta_arr[k][j][i].x * u_eta.x + eta_arr[k][j][i].y * u_eta.y + eta_arr[k][j][i].z * u_eta.z;
2908 ucont_arr[k][j][i].z = zet_arr[k][j][i].x * u_zeta.x + zet_arr[k][j][i].y * u_zeta.y + zet_arr[k][j][i].z * u_zeta.z;
2909 }
2910 }
2911 }
2912
2913 ierr = DMDAVecRestoreArray(user->fda, user->Ucont, &ucont_arr); CHKERRQ(ierr);
2914 ierr = DMDAVecRestoreArrayRead(user->fda, user->lZet, &zet_arr); CHKERRQ(ierr);
2915 ierr = DMDAVecRestoreArrayRead(user->fda, user->lEta, &eta_arr); CHKERRQ(ierr);
2916 ierr = DMDAVecRestoreArrayRead(user->fda, user->lCsi, &csi_arr); CHKERRQ(ierr);
2917 ierr = DMDAVecRestoreArrayRead(user->fda, user->lUcat, &ucat_arr); CHKERRQ(ierr);
2918
2919 PROFILE_FUNCTION_END;
2920 PetscFunctionReturn(0);
2921}

2923#undef __FUNCT__
2924#define __FUNCT__ "UniformCart2Contra"
2925/**
2926 * @brief Convert a uniform Cartesian velocity (u,v,w) to contravariant fluxes in Ucont.
2927 * @details Computes the dot product of the physical velocity with each face-area vector:
2928 * U^xi = csi · (u,v,w), U^eta = eta · (u,v,w), U^zeta = zet · (u,v,w).
2929 * Writes to all owned nodes (xs..xe, ys..ye, zs..ze); boundary ghosts are
2930 * overwritten later by ApplyBoundaryConditions.
2931 * @param user UserCtx with fda, Ucont, lCsi, lEta, lZet populated.
2932 * @param u Physical Cartesian x-velocity.
2933 * @param v Physical Cartesian y-velocity.
2934 * @param w Physical Cartesian z-velocity.
2935 */
2936PetscErrorCode UniformCart2Contra(UserCtx *user, PetscReal u, PetscReal v, PetscReal w)
2937{
2938 PetscErrorCode ierr;
2939 PetscFunctionBeginUser;
2940 PROFILE_FUNCTION_BEGIN;
2941
2942 DMDALocalInfo info;
2943 Cmpnts ***ucont_arr;
2944 const Cmpnts ***csi_arr, ***eta_arr, ***zet_arr;
2945
2946 ierr = DMDAGetLocalInfo(user->fda, &info); CHKERRQ(ierr);
2947 ierr = DMDAVecGetArray(user->fda, user->Ucont, &ucont_arr); CHKERRQ(ierr);
2948 ierr = DMDAVecGetArrayRead(user->fda, user->lCsi, &csi_arr); CHKERRQ(ierr);
2949 ierr = DMDAVecGetArrayRead(user->fda, user->lEta, &eta_arr); CHKERRQ(ierr);
2950 ierr = DMDAVecGetArrayRead(user->fda, user->lZet, &zet_arr); CHKERRQ(ierr);
2951
2952 const PetscInt xs = info.xs, xe = info.xs + info.xm;
2953 const PetscInt ys = info.ys, ye = info.ys + info.ym;
2954 const PetscInt zs = info.zs, ze = info.zs + info.zm;
2955
2956 for (PetscInt k = zs; k < ze; k++) {
2957 for (PetscInt j = ys; j < ye; j++) {
2958 for (PetscInt i = xs; i < xe; i++) {
2959 ucont_arr[k][j][i].x = csi_arr[k][j][i].x * u + csi_arr[k][j][i].y * v + csi_arr[k][j][i].z * w;
2960 ucont_arr[k][j][i].y = eta_arr[k][j][i].x * u + eta_arr[k][j][i].y * v + eta_arr[k][j][i].z * w;
2961 ucont_arr[k][j][i].z = zet_arr[k][j][i].x * u + zet_arr[k][j][i].y * v + zet_arr[k][j][i].z * w;
2962 }
2963 }
2964 }
2965
2966 ierr = DMDAVecRestoreArrayRead(user->fda, user->lZet, &zet_arr); CHKERRQ(ierr);
2967 ierr = DMDAVecRestoreArrayRead(user->fda, user->lEta, &eta_arr); CHKERRQ(ierr);
2968 ierr = DMDAVecRestoreArrayRead(user->fda, user->lCsi, &csi_arr); CHKERRQ(ierr);
2969 ierr = DMDAVecRestoreArray(user->fda, user->Ucont, &ucont_arr); CHKERRQ(ierr);
2970
2971 LOG_ALLOW(GLOBAL, LOG_DEBUG, "Cart2Contra: set Ucont from Cartesian (%.3f, %.3f, %.3f).\n",
2972 (double)u, (double)v, (double)w);
2973 PROFILE_FUNCTION_END;
2974 PetscFunctionReturn(0);
2975}

2977#undef __FUNCT__
2978#define __FUNCT__ "SetupDomainCellDecompositionMap"
2979/**
2980 * @brief Internal helper implementation: `SetupDomainCellDecompositionMap()`.
2981 * @details Local to this translation unit.
2982 */
2983PetscErrorCode SetupDomainCellDecompositionMap(UserCtx *user)
2984{
2985 PetscErrorCode ierr;
2986 DMDALocalInfo local_node_info;
2987 RankCellInfo my_cell_info;
2988 PetscMPIInt rank, size;
2989
2990 PetscFunctionBeginUser;
2991 PROFILE_FUNCTION_BEGIN;
2992
2993 // --- 1. Input Validation and MPI Info ---
2994 if (!user) {
2995 SETERRQ(PETSC_COMM_SELF, PETSC_ERR_ARG_NULL, "UserCtx pointer is NULL in SetupDomainCellDecompositionMap.");
2996 }
2997 if (!user->da) {
2998 SETERRQ(PETSC_COMM_SELF, PETSC_ERR_ARG_WRONGSTATE, "user->da is not initialized in SetupDomainCellDecompositionMap.");
2999 }
3000
3001 ierr = MPI_Comm_rank(PETSC_COMM_WORLD, &rank); CHKERRQ(ierr);
3002 ierr = MPI_Comm_size(PETSC_COMM_WORLD, &size); CHKERRQ(ierr);
3003
3004 LOG_ALLOW(GLOBAL, LOG_INFO, "Setting up domain cell decomposition map for %d ranks.\n", size);
3005
3006 // --- 2. Determine Local Cell Ownership ---
3007 // Get the local node ownership information from the primary DMDA.
3008 ierr = DMDAGetLocalInfo(user->da, &local_node_info); CHKERRQ(ierr);
3009
3010 // Use the robust helper function to convert node ownership to cell ownership.
3011 // A cell's index is defined by its origin node.
3012
3013 ierr = GetOwnedCellRange(&local_node_info, 0, &my_cell_info.xs_cell, &my_cell_info.xm_cell); CHKERRQ(ierr);
3014 ierr = GetOwnedCellRange(&local_node_info, 1, &my_cell_info.ys_cell, &my_cell_info.ym_cell); CHKERRQ(ierr);
3015 ierr = GetOwnedCellRange(&local_node_info, 2, &my_cell_info.zs_cell, &my_cell_info.zm_cell); CHKERRQ(ierr);
3016
3017 // Log the calculated local ownership for debugging purposes.
3018 LOG_ALLOW(LOCAL, LOG_DEBUG, "[Rank %d] Owns cells: i[%d, %d), j[%d, %d), k[%d, %d)\n",
3019 rank, my_cell_info.xs_cell, my_cell_info.xs_cell + my_cell_info.xm_cell,
3020 my_cell_info.ys_cell, my_cell_info.ys_cell + my_cell_info.ym_cell,
3021 my_cell_info.zs_cell, my_cell_info.zs_cell + my_cell_info.zm_cell);
3022
3023 // --- 3. Allocate and Distribute the Global Map ---
3024 // Allocate memory for the global map that will hold information from all ranks.
3025 ierr = PetscMalloc1(size, &user->RankCellInfoMap); CHKERRQ(ierr);
3026
3027 // Perform the collective communication to gather the `RankCellInfo` struct from every rank.
3028 // Each rank sends its `my_cell_info` and receives the complete array in `user->RankCellInfoMap`.
3029 // We use MPI_BYTE to ensure portability across different systems and struct padding.
3030 ierr = MPI_Allgather(&my_cell_info, sizeof(RankCellInfo), MPI_BYTE,
3031 user->RankCellInfoMap, sizeof(RankCellInfo), MPI_BYTE,
3032 PETSC_COMM_WORLD); CHKERRQ(ierr);
3033
3034 LOG_ALLOW(GLOBAL, LOG_INFO, "Domain cell decomposition map created and distributed successfully.\n");
3035
3036 PROFILE_FUNCTION_END;
3037 PetscFunctionReturn(0);
3038}

3040#undef __FUNCT__
3041#define __FUNCT__ "BinarySearchInt64"
3042/**
3043 * @brief Implementation of \ref BinarySearchInt64().
3044 * @details Full API contract (arguments, ownership, side effects) is documented with
3045 * the header declaration in `include/setup.h`.
3046 * @see BinarySearchInt64()
3047 */
3048PetscErrorCode BinarySearchInt64(PetscInt n, const PetscInt64 arr[], PetscInt64 key, PetscBool *found)
3049{
3050 PetscInt low = 0, high = n - 1;
3051
3052 PetscFunctionBeginUser;
3053 PROFILE_FUNCTION_BEGIN;
3054
3055 // --- 1. Input Validation ---
3056 if (!found) {
3057 SETERRQ(PETSC_COMM_SELF, PETSC_ERR_ARG_NULL, "Output pointer 'found' is NULL in PetscBinarySearchInt64.");
3058 }
3059 if (n > 0 && !arr) {
3060 SETERRQ(PETSC_COMM_SELF, PETSC_ERR_ARG_NULL, "Input array 'arr' is NULL for n > 0.");
3061 }
3062
3063 // Initialize output
3064 *found = PETSC_FALSE;
3065
3066 // --- 2. Binary Search Algorithm ---
3067 while (low <= high) {
3068 // Use this form to prevent potential integer overflow on very large arrays
3069 PetscInt mid = low + (high - low) / 2;
3070
3071 if (arr[mid] == key) {
3072 *found = PETSC_TRUE; // Key found!
3073 break; // Exit the loop
3074 }
3075
3076 if (arr[mid] < key) {
3077 low = mid + 1; // Search in the right half
3078 } else {
3079 high = mid - 1; // Search in the left half
3080 }
3081 }
3082
3083 PROFILE_FUNCTION_END;
3084 PetscFunctionReturn(0);
3085}

3087
3088/**
3089 * @brief Internal helper implementation: `Gidx()`.
3090 * @details Local to this translation unit.
3091 */
3092static PetscInt Gidx(PetscInt i, PetscInt j, PetscInt k, UserCtx *user)
3093{
3094 PetscInt nidx;
3095 DMDALocalInfo info = user->info;
3096
3097 PetscInt mx = info.mx, my = info.my;
3098
3099 AO ao;
3100 DMDAGetAO(user->da, &ao);
3101 nidx=i+j*mx+k*mx*my;
3102
3103 AOApplicationToPetsc(ao,1,&nidx);
3104
3105 return (nidx);
3106}

3109#undef __FUNCT__
3110#define __FUNCT__ "ComputeDivergence"
3111/**
3112 * @brief Implementation of \ref ComputeDivergence().
3113 * @details Full API contract (arguments, ownership, side effects) is documented with
3114 * the header declaration in `include/setup.h`.
3115 * @see ComputeDivergence()
3116 */
3117
3118PetscErrorCode ComputeDivergence(UserCtx *user )
3119{
3120 DM da = user->da, fda = user->fda;
3121 DMDALocalInfo info = user->info;
3122
3123 PetscInt ti = user->simCtx->step;
3124
3125 PetscInt xs = info.xs, xe = info.xs + info.xm;
3126 PetscInt ys = info.ys, ye = info.ys + info.ym;
3127 PetscInt zs = info.zs, ze = info.zs + info.zm;
3128 PetscInt mx = info.mx, my = info.my, mz = info.mz;
3129
3130 PetscInt lxs, lys, lzs, lxe, lye, lze;
3131 PetscInt i, j, k;
3132
3133 Vec Div;
3134 PetscReal ***div, ***aj, ***nvert,***p;
3135 Cmpnts ***ucont;
3136 PetscReal maxdiv;
3137
3138 lxs = xs; lxe = xe;
3139 lys = ys; lye = ye;
3140 lzs = zs; lze = ze;
3141
3142 if (xs==0) lxs = xs+1;
3143 if (ys==0) lys = ys+1;
3144 if (zs==0) lzs = zs+1;
3145
3146 if (xe==mx) lxe = xe-1;
3147 if (ye==my) lye = ye-1;
3148 if (ze==mz) lze = ze-1;
3149
3150 PetscFunctionBeginUser;
3151 PROFILE_FUNCTION_BEGIN;
3152
3153 DMDAVecGetArray(fda,user->lUcont, &ucont);
3154 DMDAVecGetArray(da, user->lAj, &aj);
3155 VecDuplicate(user->P, &Div);
3156 DMDAVecGetArray(da, Div, &div);
3157 DMDAVecGetArray(da, user->lNvert, &nvert);
3158 DMDAVecGetArray(da, user->P, &p);
3159 for (k=lzs; k<lze; k++) {
3160 for (j=lys; j<lye; j++){
3161 for (i=lxs; i<lxe; i++) {
3162 if (k==10 && j==10 && i==1){
3163 LOG_ALLOW(LOCAL,LOG_INFO,"Pressure[10][10][1] = %f | Pressure[10][10][0] = %f \n ",p[k][j][i],p[k][j][i-1]);
3164 }
3165
3166 if (k==10 && j==10 && i==mx-3)
3167 LOG_ALLOW(LOCAL,LOG_INFO,"Pressure[10][10][%d] = %f | Pressure[10][10][%d] = %f \n ",mx-2,p[k][j][mx-2],mx-1,p[k][j][mx-1]);
3168 }
3169 }
3170 }
3171 DMDAVecRestoreArray(da, user->P, &p);
3172
3173
3174 for (k=lzs; k<lze; k++) {
3175 for (j=lys; j<lye; j++) {
3176 for (i=lxs; i<lxe; i++) {
3177 maxdiv = fabs((ucont[k][j][i].x - ucont[k][j][i-1].x +
3178 ucont[k][j][i].y - ucont[k][j-1][i].y +
3179 ucont[k][j][i].z - ucont[k-1][j][i].z)*aj[k][j][i]);
3180 if (nvert[k][j][i] + nvert[k+1][j][i] + nvert[k-1][j][i] +
3181 nvert[k][j+1][i] + nvert[k][j-1][i] +
3182 nvert[k][j][i+1] + nvert[k][j][i-1] > 0.1) maxdiv = 0.;
3183 div[k][j][i] = maxdiv;
3184
3185 }
3186 }
3187 }
3188
3189 if (zs==0) {
3190 k=0;
3191 for (j=ys; j<ye; j++) {
3192 for (i=xs; i<xe; i++) {
3193 div[k][j][i] = 0.;
3194 }
3195 }
3196 }
3197
3198 if (ze == mz) {
3199 k=mz-1;
3200 for (j=ys; j<ye; j++) {
3201 for (i=xs; i<xe; i++) {
3202 div[k][j][i] = 0.;
3203 }
3204 }
3205 }
3206
3207 if (xs==0) {
3208 i=0;
3209 for (k=zs; k<ze; k++) {
3210 for (j=ys; j<ye; j++) {
3211 div[k][j][i] = 0.;
3212 }
3213 }
3214 }
3215
3216 if (xe==mx) {
3217 i=mx-1;
3218 for (k=zs; k<ze; k++) {
3219 for (j=ys; j<ye; j++) {
3220 div[k][j][i] = 0;
3221 }
3222 }
3223 }
3224
3225 if (ys==0) {
3226 j=0;
3227 for (k=zs; k<ze; k++) {
3228 for (i=xs; i<xe; i++) {
3229 div[k][j][i] = 0.;
3230 }
3231 }
3232 }
3233
3234 if (ye==my) {
3235 j=my-1;
3236 for (k=zs; k<ze; k++) {
3237 for (i=xs; i<xe; i++) {
3238 div[k][j][i] = 0.;
3239 }
3240 }
3241 }
3242 DMDAVecRestoreArray(da, Div, &div);
3243 PetscInt MaxFlatIndex;
3244
3245 VecMax(Div, &MaxFlatIndex, &maxdiv);
3246
3247 LOG_ALLOW(GLOBAL,LOG_INFO,"[Step %d]] The Maximum Divergence is %e at flat index %d.\n",ti,maxdiv,MaxFlatIndex);
3248
3249 user->simCtx->MaxDivFlatArg = MaxFlatIndex;
3250 user->simCtx->MaxDiv = maxdiv;
3251
3252 for (k=zs; k<ze; k++) {
3253 for (j=ys; j<ye; j++) {
3254 for (i=xs; i<xe; i++) {
3255 if (Gidx(i,j,k,user) == MaxFlatIndex) {
3256 LOG_ALLOW(GLOBAL,LOG_INFO,"[Step %d] The Maximum Divergence(%e) is at location [%d][%d][%d]. \n", ti, maxdiv,k,j,i);
3257 user->simCtx->MaxDivz = k;
3258 user->simCtx->MaxDivy = j;
3259 user->simCtx->MaxDivx = i;
3260 }
3261 }
3262 }
3263 }
3264
3265
3266 DMDAVecRestoreArray(da, user->lNvert, &nvert);
3267 DMDAVecRestoreArray(fda, user->lUcont, &ucont);
3268 DMDAVecRestoreArray(da, user->lAj, &aj);
3269 VecDestroy(&Div);
3270
3271 PROFILE_FUNCTION_END;
3272 PetscFunctionReturn(0);
3273}

3275#undef __FUNCT__
3276#define __FUNCT__ "InitializeRandomGenerators"
3277
3278/**
3279 * @brief Implementation of \ref InitializeRandomGenerators().
3280 * @details Full API contract (arguments, ownership, side effects) is documented with
3281 * the header declaration in `include/setup.h`.
3282 * @see InitializeRandomGenerators()
3283 */
3284PetscErrorCode InitializeRandomGenerators(UserCtx* user, PetscRandom *randx, PetscRandom *randy, PetscRandom *randz) {
3285 PetscErrorCode ierr; // Error code for PETSc functions
3286 PetscMPIInt rank;
3287 PetscFunctionBeginUser;
3288 PROFILE_FUNCTION_BEGIN;
3289 MPI_Comm_rank(PETSC_COMM_WORLD, &rank);
3290
3291 // Initialize RNG for x-coordinate
3292 ierr = PetscRandomCreate(PETSC_COMM_SELF, randx); CHKERRQ(ierr);
3293 ierr = PetscRandomSetType((*randx), PETSCRAND48); CHKERRQ(ierr);
3294 ierr = PetscRandomSetInterval(*randx, user->bbox.min_coords.x, user->bbox.max_coords.x); CHKERRQ(ierr);
3295 ierr = PetscRandomSetSeed(*randx, rank + 12345); CHKERRQ(ierr); // Unique seed per rank
3296 ierr = PetscRandomSeed(*randx); CHKERRQ(ierr);
3297 LOG_ALLOW_SYNC(LOCAL,LOG_VERBOSE, "[Rank %d]Initialized RNG for X-axis.\n",rank);
3298
3299 // Initialize RNG for y-coordinate

3311 ierr = PetscRandomSetSeed(*randz, rank + 54321); CHKERRQ(ierr); // Unique seed per rank
3312 ierr = PetscRandomSeed(*randz); CHKERRQ(ierr);
3313 LOG_ALLOW_SYNC(LOCAL,LOG_VERBOSE, "[Rank %d]Initialized RNG for Z-axis.\n",rank);

3363#undef __FUNCT__
3364#define __FUNCT__ "InitializeBrownianRNG"
3365/**
3366 * @brief Internal helper implementation: `InitializeBrownianRNG()`.
3367 * @details Local to this translation unit.
3368 */
3369PetscErrorCode InitializeBrownianRNG(SimCtx *simCtx) {
3370 PetscErrorCode ierr;
3371 PetscMPIInt rank;
3372
3373 PetscFunctionBeginUser;
3374 PROFILE_FUNCTION_BEGIN;
3375
3376 ierr = MPI_Comm_rank(PETSC_COMM_WORLD, &rank); CHKERRQ(ierr);
3377
3378 // 1. Create the generator (stored in SimCtx, not UserCtx, as it is global physics)
3379 ierr = PetscRandomCreate(PETSC_COMM_WORLD, &simCtx->BrownianMotionRNG); CHKERRQ(ierr);
3380 ierr = PetscRandomSetType(simCtx->BrownianMotionRNG, PETSCRAND48); CHKERRQ(ierr);
3381
3382 // 2. CRITICAL: Set interval to [0, 1).
3383 // This is required for the Gaussian math to work.
3384 ierr = PetscRandomSetInterval(simCtx->BrownianMotionRNG, 0.0, 1.0); CHKERRQ(ierr);
3385
3386 // 3. Seed based on Rank to ensure spatial randomness
3387 // Multiplying by a large prime helps separate the streams significantly
3388 unsigned long seed = (unsigned long)rank * 987654321 + (unsigned long)time(NULL);
3389 ierr = PetscRandomSetSeed(simCtx->BrownianMotionRNG, seed); CHKERRQ(ierr);
3390 ierr = PetscRandomSeed(simCtx->BrownianMotionRNG); CHKERRQ(ierr);
3391
3392 LOG_ALLOW(LOCAL, LOG_VERBOSE, "[Rank %d] Initialized Brownian Physics RNG.\n", rank);
3393
3394 PROFILE_FUNCTION_END;
3395 PetscFunctionReturn(0);
3396}

3400#undef __FUNCT__
3401#define __FUNCT__ "TransformScalarDerivativesToPhysical"
3402/**
3403 * @brief Implementation of \ref TransformScalarDerivativesToPhysical().
3404 * @details Full API contract (arguments, ownership, side effects) is documented with
3405 * the header declaration in `include/setup.h`.
3406 * @see TransformScalarDerivativesToPhysical()
3407 */
3408 void TransformScalarDerivativesToPhysical(PetscReal jacobian,
3409 Cmpnts csi_metrics,
3410 Cmpnts eta_metrics,
3411 Cmpnts zet_metrics,
3412 PetscReal dPhi_dcsi,
3413 PetscReal dPhi_deta,
3414 PetscReal dPhi_dzet,
3415 Cmpnts *gradPhi)
3416{
3417 // Gradient X component
3418 gradPhi->x = jacobian * (dPhi_dcsi * csi_metrics.x + dPhi_deta * eta_metrics.x + dPhi_dzet * zet_metrics.x);
3419
3420 // Gradient Y component
3421 gradPhi->y = jacobian * (dPhi_dcsi * csi_metrics.y + dPhi_deta * eta_metrics.y + dPhi_dzet * zet_metrics.y);
3422
3423 // Gradient Z component
3424 gradPhi->z = jacobian * (dPhi_dcsi * csi_metrics.z + dPhi_deta * eta_metrics.z + dPhi_dzet * zet_metrics.z);
3425}
3426
3427#undef __FUNCT__
3428#define __FUNCT__ "TransformDerivativesToPhysical"
3429/**
3430 * @brief Internal helper implementation: `TransformDerivativesToPhysical()`.
3431 * @details Local to this translation unit.
3432 */
3433static void TransformDerivativesToPhysical(PetscReal jacobian, Cmpnts csi_metrics, Cmpnts eta_metrics, Cmpnts zet_metrics,
3434 Cmpnts deriv_csi, Cmpnts deriv_eta, Cmpnts deriv_zet,
3435 Cmpnts *dudx, Cmpnts *dvdx, Cmpnts *dwdx)
3436{
3437 // Derivatives of the first component (u)
3438 dudx->x = jacobian * (deriv_csi.x * csi_metrics.x + deriv_eta.x * eta_metrics.x + deriv_zet.x * zet_metrics.x);
3439 dudx->y = jacobian * (deriv_csi.x * csi_metrics.y + deriv_eta.x * eta_metrics.y + deriv_zet.x * zet_metrics.y);
3440 dudx->z = jacobian * (deriv_csi.x * csi_metrics.z + deriv_eta.x * eta_metrics.z + deriv_zet.x * zet_metrics.z);
3441 // Derivatives of the second component (v)
3442 dvdx->x = jacobian * (deriv_csi.y * csi_metrics.x + deriv_eta.y * eta_metrics.x + deriv_zet.y * zet_metrics.x);
3443 dvdx->y = jacobian * (deriv_csi.y * csi_metrics.y + deriv_eta.y * eta_metrics.y + deriv_zet.y * zet_metrics.y);
3444 dvdx->z = jacobian * (deriv_csi.y * csi_metrics.z + deriv_eta.y * eta_metrics.z + deriv_zet.y * zet_metrics.z);
3445 // Derivatives of the third component (w)
3446 dwdx->x = jacobian * (deriv_csi.z * csi_metrics.x + deriv_eta.z * eta_metrics.x + deriv_zet.z * zet_metrics.x);
3447 dwdx->y = jacobian * (deriv_csi.z * csi_metrics.y + deriv_eta.z * eta_metrics.y + deriv_zet.z * zet_metrics.y);
3448 dwdx->z = jacobian * (deriv_csi.z * csi_metrics.z + deriv_eta.z * eta_metrics.z + deriv_zet.z * zet_metrics.z);
3449}

3451#undef __FUNCT__
3452#define __FUNCT__ "ComputeScalarFieldDerivatives"
3453/**
3454 * @brief Internal helper implementation: `ComputeScalarFieldDerivatives()`.
3455 * @details Local to this translation unit.
3456 */
3457PetscErrorCode ComputeScalarFieldDerivatives(UserCtx *user, PetscInt i, PetscInt j, PetscInt k,
3458 PetscReal ***field_data, Cmpnts *grad)
3459{
3460 PetscErrorCode ierr;
3461 Cmpnts ***csi, ***eta, ***zet;
3462 PetscReal ***jac;
3463 PetscReal d_csi, d_eta, d_zet;
3464
3465 PetscFunctionBeginUser;
3466
3467 // 1. Get read-only access to metrics
3468 ierr = DMDAVecGetArrayRead(user->fda, user->lCsi, &csi); CHKERRQ(ierr);
3469 ierr = DMDAVecGetArrayRead(user->fda, user->lEta, &eta); CHKERRQ(ierr);
3470 ierr = DMDAVecGetArrayRead(user->fda, user->lZet, &zet); CHKERRQ(ierr);
3471 ierr = DMDAVecGetArrayRead(user->da, user->lAj, &jac); CHKERRQ(ierr);
3472
3473 // 2. Compute derivatives in computational space (Central Difference)
3474 // Assumes ghosts are available at i+/-1
3475 d_csi = 0.5 * (field_data[k][j][i+1] - field_data[k][j][i-1]);
3476 d_eta = 0.5 * (field_data[k][j+1][i] - field_data[k][j-1][i]);
3477 d_zet = 0.5 * (field_data[k+1][j][i] - field_data[k-1][j][i]);
3478
3479 // 3. Transform to physical space
3480 TransformScalarDerivativesToPhysical(jac[k][j][i],
3481 csi[k][j][i], eta[k][j][i], zet[k][j][i],
3482 d_csi, d_eta, d_zet,
3483 grad);
3484
3485 // 4. Restore arrays
3486 ierr = DMDAVecRestoreArrayRead(user->fda, user->lCsi, &csi); CHKERRQ(ierr);
3487 ierr = DMDAVecRestoreArrayRead(user->fda, user->lEta, &eta); CHKERRQ(ierr);
3488 ierr = DMDAVecRestoreArrayRead(user->fda, user->lZet, &zet); CHKERRQ(ierr);
3489 ierr = DMDAVecRestoreArrayRead(user->da, user->lAj, &jac); CHKERRQ(ierr);
3490
3491 PetscFunctionReturn(0);
3492}
3493
3494#undef __FUNCT__
3495#define __FUNCT__ "ComputeVectorFieldDerivatives"
3496/**
3497 * @brief Internal helper implementation: `ComputeVectorFieldDerivatives()`.
3498 * @details Local to this translation unit.
3499 */
3500PetscErrorCode ComputeVectorFieldDerivatives(UserCtx *user, PetscInt i, PetscInt j, PetscInt k, Cmpnts ***field_data,
3501 Cmpnts *dudx, Cmpnts *dvdx, Cmpnts *dwdx)
3502{
3503 PetscErrorCode ierr;
3504 Cmpnts ***csi, ***eta, ***zet;
3505 PetscReal ***jac;
3506 PetscFunctionBeginUser;
3507
3508 // 1. Get read-only access to the necessary metric data arrays
3509 ierr = DMDAVecGetArrayRead(user->fda, user->lCsi, &csi); CHKERRQ(ierr);
3510 ierr = DMDAVecGetArrayRead(user->fda, user->lEta, &eta); CHKERRQ(ierr);
3511 ierr = DMDAVecGetArrayRead(user->fda, user->lZet, &zet); CHKERRQ(ierr);
3512 ierr = DMDAVecGetArrayRead(user->da, user->lAj, &jac); CHKERRQ(ierr);
3513
3514 // 2. Calculate derivatives in computational space using central differencing
3515 Cmpnts deriv_csi, deriv_eta, deriv_zet;
3516 deriv_csi.x = (field_data[k][j][i+1].x - field_data[k][j][i-1].x) * 0.5;
3517 deriv_csi.y = (field_data[k][j][i+1].y - field_data[k][j][i-1].y) * 0.5;
3518 deriv_csi.z = (field_data[k][j][i+1].z - field_data[k][j][i-1].z) * 0.5;
3519
3520 deriv_eta.x = (field_data[k][j+1][i].x - field_data[k][j-1][i].x) * 0.5;
3521 deriv_eta.y = (field_data[k][j+1][i].y - field_data[k][j-1][i].y) * 0.5;
3522 deriv_eta.z = (field_data[k][j+1][i].z - field_data[k][j-1][i].z) * 0.5;
3523
3524 deriv_zet.x = (field_data[k+1][j][i].x - field_data[k-1][j][i].x) * 0.5;
3525 deriv_zet.y = (field_data[k+1][j][i].y - field_data[k-1][j][i].y) * 0.5;
3526 deriv_zet.z = (field_data[k+1][j][i].z - field_data[k-1][j][i].z) * 0.5;
3527
3528 // 3. Transform derivatives to physical space
3529 TransformDerivativesToPhysical(jac[k][j][i], csi[k][j][i], eta[k][j][i], zet[k][j][i],
3530 deriv_csi, deriv_eta, deriv_zet,
3531 dudx, dvdx, dwdx);
3532
3533 // 4. Restore access to the PETSc data arrays
3534 ierr = DMDAVecRestoreArrayRead(user->fda, user->lCsi, &csi); CHKERRQ(ierr);
3535 ierr = DMDAVecRestoreArrayRead(user->fda, user->lEta, &eta); CHKERRQ(ierr);
3536 ierr = DMDAVecRestoreArrayRead(user->fda, user->lZet, &zet); CHKERRQ(ierr);
3537 ierr = DMDAVecRestoreArrayRead(user->da, user->lAj, &jac); CHKERRQ(ierr);
3538
3539 PetscFunctionReturn(0);
3540}

3554PetscErrorCode DestroyUserVectors(UserCtx *user)
3555{
3556 PetscErrorCode ierr;
3557 PetscFunctionBeginUser;
3558
3559 // --- Group A: Primary Flow Fields (Always allocated at all levels) ---
3560 if (user->Ucont) { ierr = VecDestroy(&user->Ucont); CHKERRQ(ierr); }
3561 if (user->lUcont) { ierr = VecDestroy(&user->lUcont); CHKERRQ(ierr); }
3562 if (user->Ucat) { ierr = VecDestroy(&user->Ucat); CHKERRQ(ierr); }
3563 if (user->lUcat) { ierr = VecDestroy(&user->lUcat); CHKERRQ(ierr); }
3564 if (user->P) { ierr = VecDestroy(&user->P); CHKERRQ(ierr); }
3565 if (user->lP) { ierr = VecDestroy(&user->lP); CHKERRQ(ierr); }
3566 if (user->Nvert) { ierr = VecDestroy(&user->Nvert); CHKERRQ(ierr); }
3567 if (user->lNvert) { ierr = VecDestroy(&user->lNvert); CHKERRQ(ierr); }
3568
3569 // --- Group A2: Derived Flow Fields (Conditional) ---
3570 if(user->Diffusivity) {ierr = VecDestroy(&user->Diffusivity); CHKERRQ(ierr);}
3571 if(user->lDiffusivity){ierr = VecDestroy(&user->lDiffusivity); CHKERRQ(ierr);}
3572 if(user->DiffusivityGradient){ierr = VecDestroy(&user->DiffusivityGradient); CHKERRQ(ierr);}
3573 if(user->lDiffusivityGradient){ierr = VecDestroy(&user->lDiffusivityGradient); CHKERRQ(ierr);}
3574
3575 // --- Group B: Solver Work Vectors (All levels) ---
3576 if (user->Phi) { ierr = VecDestroy(&user->Phi); CHKERRQ(ierr); }
3577 if (user->lPhi) { ierr = VecDestroy(&user->lPhi); CHKERRQ(ierr); }
3578
3579 // --- Group C: Time-Stepping Vectors (Finest level only) ---
3580 if (user->Ucont_o) { ierr = VecDestroy(&user->Ucont_o); CHKERRQ(ierr); }
3581 if (user->Ucont_rm1) { ierr = VecDestroy(&user->Ucont_rm1); CHKERRQ(ierr); }
3582 if (user->Ucat_o) { ierr = VecDestroy(&user->Ucat_o); CHKERRQ(ierr); }
3583 if (user->P_o) { ierr = VecDestroy(&user->P_o); CHKERRQ(ierr); }
3584 if (user->Nvert_o) { ierr = VecDestroy(&user->Nvert_o); CHKERRQ(ierr); }
3585 if (user->lUcont_o) { ierr = VecDestroy(&user->lUcont_o); CHKERRQ(ierr); }

3587 if (user->lNvert_o) { ierr = VecDestroy(&user->lNvert_o); CHKERRQ(ierr); }
3588
3589 // --- Group D: Grid Metrics - Face Centered (All levels) ---
3590 if (user->Csi) { ierr = VecDestroy(&user->Csi); CHKERRQ(ierr); }
3591 if (user->Eta) { ierr = VecDestroy(&user->Eta); CHKERRQ(ierr); }
3592 if (user->Zet) { ierr = VecDestroy(&user->Zet); CHKERRQ(ierr); }
3593 if (user->Aj) { ierr = VecDestroy(&user->Aj); CHKERRQ(ierr); }

3597 if (user->lAj) { ierr = VecDestroy(&user->lAj); CHKERRQ(ierr); }
3598
