3656 if (user->Bcs.Uch) { ierr = VecDestroy(&user->Bcs.Uch); CHKERRQ(ierr); }
3657
3658 // --- Group J: Post-Processing Vectors (Finest level, postprocessor mode) ---
3659 if (user->P_nodal) { ierr = VecDestroy(&user->P_nodal); CHKERRQ(ierr); }
3660 if (user->Ucat_nodal) { ierr = VecDestroy(&user->Ucat_nodal); CHKERRQ(ierr); }
3661 if (user->Qcrit) { ierr = VecDestroy(&user->Qcrit); CHKERRQ(ierr); }
3662 if (user->Psi_nodal) { ierr = VecDestroy(&user->Psi_nodal); CHKERRQ(ierr); }
3663
3664 // --- Group K: Interpolation Vectors (Lazy allocation) ---
3665 if (user->CellFieldAtCorner) { ierr = VecDestroy(&user->CellFieldAtCorner); CHKERRQ(ierr); }
3666 if (user->lCellFieldAtCorner) { ierr = VecDestroy(&user->lCellFieldAtCorner); CHKERRQ(ierr); }
3667
3668 // --- Group L: Statistical Averaging Vectors (If allocated) ---
3669 if (user->Ucat_sum) { ierr = VecDestroy(&user->Ucat_sum); CHKERRQ(ierr); }
3670 if (user->Ucat_cross_sum) { ierr = VecDestroy(&user->Ucat_cross_sum); CHKERRQ(ierr); }
3671 if (user->Ucat_square_sum) { ierr = VecDestroy(&user->Ucat_square_sum); CHKERRQ(ierr); }
3672 if (user->P_sum) { ierr = VecDestroy(&user->P_sum); CHKERRQ(ierr); }
3673
3674 // --- Group M: Implicit Solver Temporary Vectors (Destroyed after use, but check anyway) ---
3675 if (user->Rhs) { ierr = VecDestroy(&user->Rhs); CHKERRQ(ierr); }
3676 if (user->dUcont) { ierr = VecDestroy(&user->dUcont); CHKERRQ(ierr); }
3677 if (user->pUcont) { ierr = VecDestroy(&user->pUcont); CHKERRQ(ierr); }
3678
3679 // --- Group N: Poisson Solver Vectors (Destroyed after solve, but check anyway) ---
3680 if (user->B) { ierr = VecDestroy(&user->B); CHKERRQ(ierr); }
3681 if (user->R) { ierr = VecDestroy(&user->R); CHKERRQ(ierr); }
3682
3683 LOG_ALLOW(LOCAL, LOG_DEBUG, "All vectors destroyed for UserCtx.\n");
3684 PetscFunctionReturn(0);
3685}
3686#undef __FUNCT__
3687#define __FUNCT__ "DestroyUserContext"
3688/**
3689 * @brief Internal helper implementation: `DestroyUserContext()`.
3690 * @details Local to this translation unit.
3691 */
3692PetscErrorCode DestroyUserContext(UserCtx *user)
3693{
3694 PetscErrorCode ierr;
3695 PetscFunctionBeginUser;
3696
3697 if (!user) {
3698 LOG_ALLOW(LOCAL, LOG_WARNING, "DestroyUserContext called with NULL user pointer.\n");
3699 PetscFunctionReturn(0);
3700 }
3701
3702 LOG_ALLOW(LOCAL, LOG_INFO, "Destroying UserCtx at level %d...\n", user->thislevel);
3703
3704 // --- Step 1: Destroy Boundary Condition System ---
3705 // This handles all BC handlers and their private data.
3706 ierr = BoundarySystem_Destroy(user); CHKERRQ(ierr);
3707 LOG_ALLOW(LOCAL, LOG_DEBUG, " Boundary system destroyed.\n");
3708
3709 // --- Step 2: Destroy All Vectors ---
3710 // Handles ~74 Vec objects with proper NULL checking.
3711 ierr = DestroyUserVectors(user); CHKERRQ(ierr);
3712 LOG_ALLOW(LOCAL, LOG_DEBUG, " All vectors destroyed.\n");
3713
3714 // --- Step 3: Destroy Matrix and Solver Objects ---
3715 // Destroy pressure-Poisson matrices and solver.
3716 if (user->A) {
3717 ierr = MatDestroy(&user->A); CHKERRQ(ierr);
3718 LOG_ALLOW(LOCAL, LOG_DEBUG, " Matrix A destroyed.\n");
3719 }
3720 if (user->C) {
3721 ierr = MatDestroy(&user->C); CHKERRQ(ierr);
3722 LOG_ALLOW(LOCAL, LOG_DEBUG, " Matrix C destroyed.\n");
3723 }
3724 if (user->MR) {
3725 ierr = MatDestroy(&user->MR); CHKERRQ(ierr);
3726 LOG_ALLOW(LOCAL, LOG_DEBUG, " Matrix MR destroyed.\n");
3727 }
3728 if (user->MP) {
3729 ierr = MatDestroy(&user->MP); CHKERRQ(ierr);
3730 LOG_ALLOW(LOCAL, LOG_DEBUG, " Matrix MP destroyed.\n");
3731 }
3732 if (user->ksp) {
3733 ierr = KSPDestroy(&user->ksp); CHKERRQ(ierr);
3734 LOG_ALLOW(LOCAL, LOG_DEBUG, " KSP solver destroyed.\n");
3735 }
3736 if (user->nullsp) {
3737 ierr = MatNullSpaceDestroy(&user->nullsp); CHKERRQ(ierr);
3738 LOG_ALLOW(LOCAL, LOG_DEBUG, " MatNullSpace destroyed.\n");
3739 }
3740
3741 // --- Step 4: Destroy Application Ordering ---
3742 if (user->ao) {
3743 ierr = AODestroy(&user->ao); CHKERRQ(ierr);
3744 LOG_ALLOW(LOCAL, LOG_DEBUG, " AO destroyed.\n");
3745 }
3746
3747 // --- Step 5: Destroy DM Objects ---
3748 // Destroy in reverse order of dependency: post_swarm, swarm, fda2, fda, da
3749 if (user->post_swarm) {
3750 ierr = DMDestroy(&user->post_swarm); CHKERRQ(ierr);
3751 LOG_ALLOW(LOCAL, LOG_DEBUG, " post_swarm DM destroyed.\n");
3752 }
3753 if (user->swarm) {
3754 ierr = DMDestroy(&user->swarm); CHKERRQ(ierr);
3755 LOG_ALLOW(LOCAL, LOG_DEBUG, " swarm DM destroyed.\n");
3756 }
3757 if (user->fda2) {
3758 ierr = DMDestroy(&user->fda2); CHKERRQ(ierr);
3759 LOG_ALLOW(LOCAL, LOG_DEBUG, " fda2 DM destroyed.\n");
3760 }
3761 if (user->da) {
3762 ierr = DMDestroy(&user->da); CHKERRQ(ierr);
3763 LOG_ALLOW(LOCAL, LOG_DEBUG, " da DM destroyed.\n");
3764 }
3765
3766 // --- Step 6: Free PetscMalloc'd Arrays ---
3767 // Free arrays allocated with PetscMalloc1
3768 if (user->RankCellInfoMap) {
3769 ierr = PetscFree(user->RankCellInfoMap); CHKERRQ(ierr);
3770 user->RankCellInfoMap = NULL;
3771 LOG_ALLOW(LOCAL, LOG_DEBUG, " RankCellInfoMap freed.\n");
3772 }
3773 if (user->KSKE) {
3774 ierr = PetscFree(user->KSKE); CHKERRQ(ierr);
3775 user->KSKE = NULL;
3776 LOG_ALLOW(LOCAL, LOG_DEBUG, " KSKE array freed.\n");
3777 }
3778
3779 LOG_ALLOW(LOCAL, LOG_INFO, "UserCtx at level %d fully destroyed.\n", user->thislevel);
3780 PetscFunctionReturn(0);
3781}

3783#undef __FUNCT__
3784#define __FUNCT__ "FinalizeSimulation"
3785/**
3786 * @brief Implementation of \ref FinalizeSimulation().
3787 * @details Full API contract (arguments, ownership, side effects) is documented with
3788 * the header declaration in `include/setup.h`.
3789 * @see FinalizeSimulation()
3790 */
3791PetscErrorCode FinalizeSimulation(SimCtx *simCtx)
3792{
3793 PetscErrorCode ierr;
3794 PetscFunctionBeginUser;
3795
3796 if (!simCtx) {
3797 LOG_ALLOW(GLOBAL, LOG_WARNING, "FinalizeSimulation called with NULL SimCtx pointer.\n");
3798 PetscFunctionReturn(0);
3799 }
3800
3801 LOG_ALLOW(GLOBAL, LOG_INFO, "========================================\n");
3802 LOG_ALLOW(GLOBAL, LOG_INFO, "Beginning simulation memory cleanup...\n");
3803 LOG_ALLOW(GLOBAL, LOG_INFO, "========================================\n");
3804
3805 // ============================================================================
3806 // PHASE 1: DESTROY MULTIGRID HIERARCHY (All UserCtx structures)
3807 // ============================================================================
3808
3809 ierr = DestroySolutionConvergenceState(simCtx); CHKERRQ(ierr);
3810
3811 if (simCtx->usermg.mgctx) {
3812 LOG_ALLOW(GLOBAL, LOG_INFO, "Destroying multigrid hierarchy (%d levels)...\n",
3813 simCtx->usermg.mglevels);
3814
3815 // Destroy each UserCtx from finest to coarsest (reverse order is safer)
3816 for (PetscInt level = simCtx->usermg.mglevels - 1; level >= 0; level--) {
3817 UserCtx *user = simCtx->usermg.mgctx[level].user;
3818 if (user) {
3819 LOG_ALLOW(LOCAL, LOG_INFO, " Destroying level %d of %d...\n",
3820 level, simCtx->usermg.mglevels - 1);
3821 ierr = DestroyUserContext(user); CHKERRQ(ierr);
3822
3823 // Free the UserCtx structure itself
3824 ierr = PetscFree(user); CHKERRQ(ierr);
3825 simCtx->usermg.mgctx[level].user = NULL;
3826 }
3827
3828 // Destroy the MGCtx-level packer DM
3829 if (simCtx->usermg.mgctx[level].packer) {
3830 ierr = DMDestroy(&simCtx->usermg.mgctx[level].packer); CHKERRQ(ierr);
3831 LOG_ALLOW(LOCAL, LOG_DEBUG, " MGCtx[%d].packer destroyed.\n", level);
3832 }
3833 }
3834
3835 // Free the MGCtx array itself
3836 ierr = PetscFree(simCtx->usermg.mgctx); CHKERRQ(ierr);
3837 simCtx->usermg.mgctx = NULL;
3838 LOG_ALLOW(GLOBAL, LOG_INFO, "All multigrid levels destroyed.\n");
3839 }
3840
3841 // ============================================================================
3842 // PHASE 2: DESTROY USERMG-LEVEL OBJECTS
3843 // ============================================================================
3844
3845 if (simCtx->usermg.packer) {
3846 ierr = DMDestroy(&simCtx->usermg.packer); CHKERRQ(ierr);
3847 LOG_ALLOW(LOCAL, LOG_DEBUG, "UserMG.packer DM destroyed.\n");
3848 }
3849
3850 if (simCtx->usermg.snespacker) {
3851 ierr = SNESDestroy(&simCtx->usermg.snespacker); CHKERRQ(ierr);
3852 LOG_ALLOW(LOCAL, LOG_DEBUG, "UserMG.snespacker SNES destroyed.\n");
3853 }
3854
3855 // ============================================================================
3856 // PHASE 3: DESTROY SIMCTX-LEVEL OBJECTS
3857 // ============================================================================
3858
3859 LOG_ALLOW(GLOBAL, LOG_INFO, "Destroying SimCtx-level objects...\n");
3860
3861 // --- PetscViewer for logging ---
3862 if (simCtx->logviewer) {
3863 ierr = PetscViewerDestroy(&simCtx->logviewer); CHKERRQ(ierr);
3864 LOG_ALLOW(LOCAL, LOG_DEBUG, " logviewer destroyed.\n");
3865 }
3866
3867 // --- Particle System DM ---
3868 if (simCtx->dm_swarm) {
3869 ierr = DMDestroy(&simCtx->dm_swarm); CHKERRQ(ierr);
3870 LOG_ALLOW(LOCAL, LOG_DEBUG, " dm_swarm destroyed.\n");
3871 }
3872
3873 // --- BoundingBox List (Array of BoundingBox structs) ---
3874 if (simCtx->bboxlist) {
3875 ierr = PetscFree(simCtx->bboxlist); CHKERRQ(ierr);
3876 simCtx->bboxlist = NULL;
3877 LOG_ALLOW(LOCAL, LOG_DEBUG, " bboxlist freed.\n");
3878 }
3879
3880 // --- Boundary Condition Files (Array of strings) ---
3881 if (simCtx->bcs_files) {
3882 for (PetscInt i = 0; i < simCtx->num_bcs_files; i++) {
3883 if (simCtx->bcs_files[i]) {
3884 ierr = PetscFree(simCtx->bcs_files[i]); CHKERRQ(ierr);
3885 }
3886 }
3887 ierr = PetscFree(simCtx->bcs_files); CHKERRQ(ierr);
3888 simCtx->bcs_files = NULL;
3889 LOG_ALLOW(LOCAL, LOG_DEBUG, " bcs_files array freed (%d files).\n", simCtx->num_bcs_files);
3890 }
3891
3892 // --- Brownian Motion RNG ---
3893 if (simCtx->BrownianMotionRNG) {
3894 ierr = PetscRandomDestroy(&simCtx->BrownianMotionRNG); CHKERRQ(ierr);
3895 LOG_ALLOW(LOCAL, LOG_DEBUG, " BrownianMotionRNG destroyed.\n");
3896 }
3897 // --- Post-Processing Parameters ---
3898 // pps is allocated with PetscNew and contains only static char arrays and basic types.
3899 // No internal dynamic allocations need to be freed.
3900 if (simCtx->pps) {
3901 ierr = PetscFree(simCtx->pps); CHKERRQ(ierr);
3902 simCtx->pps = NULL;
3903 LOG_ALLOW(LOCAL, LOG_DEBUG, " PostProcessParams freed.\n");
3904 }
3905
3906 // --- IBM/FSI Objects ---
3907 // Note: These are initialized to NULL and currently have no dedicated destroy functions.
3908 // If these modules are extended with cleanup routines, call them here.
3909 if (simCtx->ibm != NULL) {
3910 LOG_ALLOW(GLOBAL, LOG_WARNING, " WARNING: simCtx->ibm is non-NULL but no destroy function exists. Potential memory leak.\n");
3911 }
3912 if (simCtx->ibmv != NULL) {
3913 LOG_ALLOW(GLOBAL, LOG_WARNING, " WARNING: simCtx->ibmv is non-NULL but no destroy function exists. Potential memory leak.\n");
3914 }
3915 if (simCtx->fsi != NULL) {
3916 LOG_ALLOW(GLOBAL, LOG_WARNING, " WARNING: simCtx->fsi is non-NULL but no destroy function exists. Potential memory leak.\n");
3917 }
3918
3919 // --- Logging Allowed Functions (Array of strings) ---
3920 // Note: The logging system maintains its own copy via set_allowed_functions(),
3921 // so freeing simCtx->allowedFuncs will NOT affect LOG_ALLOW functionality.
3922 if (simCtx->allowedFuncs) {
3923 for (PetscInt i = 0; i < simCtx->nAllowed; i++) {
3924 if (simCtx->allowedFuncs[i]) {
3925 ierr = PetscFree(simCtx->allowedFuncs[i]); CHKERRQ(ierr);
3926 }
3927 }
3928 ierr = PetscFree(simCtx->allowedFuncs); CHKERRQ(ierr);
3929 simCtx->allowedFuncs = NULL;
3930 LOG_ALLOW(LOCAL, LOG_DEBUG, " allowedFuncs array freed (%d functions).\n", simCtx->nAllowed);
3931 }
3932
3933 // --- Profiling Critical Functions (Array of strings) ---
3934 if (simCtx->profilingSelectedFuncs) {
3935 for (PetscInt i = 0; i < simCtx->nProfilingSelectedFuncs; i++) {
3936 if (simCtx->profilingSelectedFuncs[i]) {
3937 ierr = PetscFree(simCtx->profilingSelectedFuncs[i]); CHKERRQ(ierr);
3938 }
3939 }
3940 ierr = PetscFree(simCtx->profilingSelectedFuncs); CHKERRQ(ierr);
3941 simCtx->profilingSelectedFuncs = NULL;
3942 LOG_ALLOW(LOCAL, LOG_DEBUG, " profilingSelectedFuncs array freed (%d functions).\n", simCtx->nProfilingSelectedFuncs);
3943 }
3944
3945 // ============================================================================
3946 // PHASE 4: FINAL SUMMARY
3947 // ============================================================================
3948
3949 LOG_ALLOW(GLOBAL, LOG_INFO, "========================================\n");
3950 LOG_ALLOW(GLOBAL, LOG_INFO, "Simulation cleanup completed successfully.\n");
3951 LOG_ALLOW(GLOBAL, LOG_INFO, "All PETSc objects have been destroyed.\n");
3952 LOG_ALLOW(GLOBAL, LOG_INFO, "========================================\n");
3953
3954 ierr = PetscFree(simCtx); CHKERRQ(ierr);
3955 PetscFunctionReturn(0);
3956}
